jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Platforms, Director
jobs.description:
Join us as a Technical Product Manager - AI Platform
  
  

* You’ll be responsible for managing the development and implementation of technology-driven products
* The role focuses on understanding customer needs, overseeing the product lifecycle, and collaborating with technical and non-technical teams to ensure successful product delivery that aligns with business objectives
* You’ll gain valuable senior stakeholder exposure as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents and leadership skills
* We're offering this role at director level

What you'll do
  
  
We’ll look to you to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of technology products, from roadmap ownership and feature prioritization to launch and post-release evaluation. You’ll ensure strategic alignment through clear documentation and effective stakeholder communication, while proactively managing risks and fostering cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
You’ll also provide technical guidance to engineering teams, articulate customer pain points, and define performance metrics to measure success. We’ll also look to you to lead and mentor team members, supporting hiring efforts, and enabling agile decision-making to maintain momentum and
  
  
deliver impactful, customer-centric solutions.
  
  
**Additionally, You’ll Be**

* Delivering a product roadmap that aligns with business objectives and technological advancements
* Ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Leading the product development lifecycle from concept to delivery with a high-performing engineering team
* Making data-driven decisions that improve product performance and user satisfaction
* Providing regular reporting on product performance, development progress, and market trends

The skills you'll need
  
  
We’re on the lookout for a strategic thinker with a passion for technology and innovation. You’ll have extensive experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field with strong leadership abilities, capable of motivating and influencing cross-functional teams.You’ll need at least seventeen years of total experience, with strong expertise in setting product vision, defining product strategy and roadmaps, and aligning development with strategic outcomes.
  
  
You’ll bring extensive experience in designing large-scale cloud architectures and distributed systems across AWS, GCP, and Azure, along with deep expertise in GenAI platform architecture, agentic systems, cloud-native technologies, and hands-on platform engineering. You’ll also be experienced in creating financial forecasts for products and features, contributing to platform-level budgeting, and driving focus and efficiency through disciplined prioritisation and agile decision-making.
  
  
**You’ll Also Have**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in project management tools and Agile or Scrum methodologies
* Familiarity with software development processes and technologies
* The ability to work in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Digital Channels Cash Product Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).
* Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
* Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**

* Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
* Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
* Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
* Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.

**Product execution and prioritisation**

* Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
* Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
* Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
* Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
* Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.

**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**

* Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
* Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
* Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**

* Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.
* Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.
* Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.

**People and talent**

* Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.
* Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.
* Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.

**Risk, controls and governance**

* Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.
* Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.
* Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* Cash and Payments Product Strategy
* Digital Channels and Corporate Connectivity
* Product Commercialisation and Value Proposition

**Other Skills**

* Portfolio Prioritisation and Investment Discipline
* Client and Market Insight
* Senior Stakeholder Influence
* People Leadership and Product Team Development

**Motivations**

* Shaping client-channel strategy and turning complex Cash and Payments needs into scalable propositions with visible commercial and client value.
* Leading across business, product and technology boundaries to resolve competing priorities and deliver high-impact outcomes across markets.
* Building empowered Product Owner teams that combine deep channel expertise with strategic thinking, disciplined execution and strong client focus.

**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**

* 15+ years of senior-level experience in Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments or enterprise digital channels, including product strategy, proposition development, commercialisation and execution.
* Deep experience in corporate connectivity and more than one client channel, with working knowledge of H2H, SWIFT, APIs and corporate Web banking.
* Strong Cash and Payments domain understanding across domestic and cross-border payments, real-time and bulk payments, payroll, receivables, liquidity, statements and reporting.
* Working command of ISO 20022 payment and reporting messages, legacy MT formats, local clearing formats, and ERP or treasury management system integration.
* Demonstrated experience building business cases, prioritising investments and managing multiple initiatives across countries, products and channels.
* Strong experience in Portfolio management at scale, running a large backlog with many initiatives in parallel, while sharing limited delivery capacity across countries and demand types.
* Proven leadership of Product Owners or Product Managers and senior-level influence across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance.

**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, finance, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. No role-specific certification is mandatory.
  
  
**Languages:**
English: professional fluency. Additional languages are advantageous where relevant to the role’s market coverage.
  
  
**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding

jobs.title: Product Management - Investments Advisory - Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in the Product Management team to partner with the Business.
  
  
As a Product Manager in the Product Management team, you will be responsible for the product vision and strategies to come up with innovative solutions to problems that are valuable (our users choose to use them), viable (the solution works for the business), usable (the users can figure out how to use) and feasible.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Understand client and advisor needs. Invests in a deep understanding of the business opportunity, advisor & client needs and competitive landscape. Dive into research to uncover what matters most, ensuring every feature is relevant, useful, and ahead of the curve.
* Be passionate about AI & Innovation - Bring relentless passion for AI and innovation to the Private Bank every day. Focus on delivering standout client and product experiences. Collaborate closely with developers and UX designers to create intuitive, differentiated solutions. Prioritize features that deliver client impact and business goals, within complex control requirements.
* Inspire adoption – define and track KPIs for usage & impact (both quantitative & qualitative) metrics. Focus on constantly aligning our AI powered digital solutions with user needs to maximize AI adoption and impact across the Private Bank.
* Drives the product development lifecycle - define requirements (in partnership with cross-functional teams), ensuring sprint inputs and outputs are as envisioned, and providing direction and smart trade off decisions for the scrum team. Collaborates with others across broader teams to deliver end-to-end product and experience.
* Embody true “customer-obsession”. Put customer obsession at the heart of everything—leverage user data, performance metrics, industry trends, and all forms of feedback to shape design and roadmap decisions.
* Set the standard for piloting and rolling out new capabilities - define objectives, scope, communication, training, support, and feedback/metrics to ensure successful adoption.
* Develop and maintain deep relationships with delivery partners including senior leaders, Digital, Technology, Design, Operations, Servicing, Legal, Risk & Control functions across the International Region
* Work hand-in-hand with Technology and Design, but you'll also be out front—engaging with Advisors and Business Management throughout the product lifecycle to make sure we're always building the right thing, the right way.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in Digital or financial services, with experience leading strategic or transformational change in wealth management, digital banking, or a related business.
* A proven innovator with an ability to think differently, reframe problems and uncover opportunities to turn emerging ideas into meaningful outcomes.
* Experience managing product delivery across multiple workstreams, balancing shifting priorities and complexities to successfully deliver new products to market.
* Experience in KPI frameworks such as OKRs or HEART to communicate measures of success.
* Excellent leadership skills – ability to guide teams and influence peers to build consensus.
* Strong understanding of different technological development methodologies (e.g., Agile) and design techniques with ability to successfully lead regardless of approach.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Jupiter**

Jupiter is a money app for people who are building their lives in India. From one app you can open a savings account with our partner bank, pay on UPI, save towards goals in Pots, borrow, buy insurance, invest, and see where your money actually goes. Our Edge+ CSB Bank RuPay credit card works on UPI and earns Jewels, our rewards currency, on the brands people already shop with.

We are a product company at heart. We obsess over small details, we read what customers tell us, and we would rather do fewer things properly than many things badly.

**Why this role exists**

AI is already part of how Jupiter works. Our product team uses an in-house assistant that reads our Confluence, Figma, Amplitude, Databricks and support tickets to answer questions and draft PRDs, right inside Slack. Engineering has a bot that turns a Jira ticket into a draft pull request. Marketing has a creative studio that designs ads, critiques its own work against a checklist and tells us what every run cost.

Those started as tools for us. The next step is bigger: putting AI in front of customers in a product that handles their money, where a confident wrong answer is not a small bug. We are looking for a PM who wants to own that problem, with the judgement to know where AI helps and the discipline to prove it before it ships.

**What you will do**

* **Find the problems worth solving with AI.**
  Explaining a declined payment, making sense of a card bill, help that actually closes the ticket, a Money tab that answers questions in plain words. You will also say no to the ideas where a better screen would do the job.
* **Own products end to end.**
  Problem, PRD, evals, launch, and the numbers after launch. You stay with it until it works for customers, not until it is merged.
* **Write the evals before the feature.**
  Define what good looks like with real examples, build the test sets with engineering, and decide the score that is good enough to ship. When the model changes, you know within a day whether things got better or worse.
* **Design for the moments AI gets it wrong.**
  What the assistant says when it does not know, when it hands over to a person, and how a customer corrects it. These moments decide whether people trust us.
* **Keep it safe and compliant.**
  Work with compliance, risk and our partner banks so everything we build respects RBI guidelines, the DPDP Act and our partners' policies. Customer data stays where it belongs.
* **Treat cost and speed as product decisions.**
  Know what each conversation costs, pick the right model for each job, and cut what does not earn its keep.
* **Raise the bar for the whole team.**
  Help other PMs, designers and analysts use AI well in their own work, and keep improving the internal tools they already rely on.

**Your first 90 days**

* **By day 30:**
  you use Jupiter every day, have read a few hundred support conversations, have sat with ops and compliance, and know our internal AI tools by using them.
* **By day 60:**
  you have picked one customer problem, made the case for it with real data, and put a working prototype in front of colleagues.
* **By day 90:**
  you have an eval set, a launch plan with guardrails, and a small rollout to real customers with one clear success metric.

**You will do well here if you**

* Have 4 to 8 years in product, with at least one AI or ML product shipped to real users. A demo does not count; something people used does.
* Can explain in plain words how language models fail (making things up, prompt injection, behaviour shifting between model versions) and how you would design around each.
* Are comfortable writing prompts, reading a model's outputs in bulk and spotting the pattern in what went wrong.
* Use data without being asked. You can write SQL, build a funnel in Amplitude, and tell a real change from noise.
* Write clearly. Your PRDs are short, specific and something an engineer can build from.
* Care about the person on the other side of the screen, especially when the subject is their money.

**Good to have**

* Experience in fintech, payments, lending or another regulated space.
* You have built with the Claude or OpenAI APIs yourself, even on a side project.
* Hands-on time with retrieval (RAG), agents that use tools, or eval tooling.
* You can sketch a flow in Figma before a designer picks it up.

**What you will work with**

* Claude and other frontier models through our AI gateway, and MCP to connect agents to our systems.
* Amplitude, Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma and Sense UI, our design system.
* A React Native app, and engineers, designers and analysts who like to move quickly and measure what they ship.

**How we work**

* Small teams own outcomes, not tickets.
* Decisions are written down with the reasoning, so anyone can pick up the thread later.
* We are honest about results. If a launch did not work, we say so and fix it.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Aspora**
People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.
  
  
Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.
  
  
We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.
  
  
**About The Role**
People build lives across borders, and Aspora helps the Indian diaspora send money home and grow wealth in India. Growth here is won in a user’s first three months: a friend’s referral, a first transfer, a return next month. This role exists to turn that journey into a growth engine that compounds with every new cohort. You will own growth for our product, working closely with design, engineering, data and our CLM team.
  
  
You decide which bets to make, how big they should be, and when to stop one that isn’t working. What you build will shape how fast Aspora grows, and the growth playbook we take into every new market
  
  
Location
  
  
In Office || Bangalore
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* This is a role with full ownership of the journey at the heart of Aspora’s core business.
* Diagnose where growth leaks. Go deep into funnels on every launch and older bet, and publish insights the whole team acts on.
* Own the number and the path. Check the numbers daily, hold a clear view on opportunity areas, and open new growth threads.
* Grow referral and activation. Ship reward constructs and product bets that bring more users in and get them to a first transfer.
* Make new users stay. Lift retention in the first three months by turning a first transfer into a monthly habit.
* Size every bet to matter. Set the payback before launch, read the result honestly, and call it early when a bet isn’t working.
* Build trust after every transfer. Shape the post-transfer experience so customers feel informed and in control, even when timing slips.

What We’re Looking For
  
  
You’re not someone who measures a quarter by features shipped. You measure it by the number you moved, and you can show exactly how.
  
  

* You’ve moved a growth number. You owned an acquisition, activation or retention metric in a consumer app and can walk through what moved it.
* You live in the data. You write your own SQL or analytics queries and read an experiment properly: control groups, sample checks, significance.
* You’ve run rewards with a payback. You designed referral, cashback or incentive programmes with the unit economics worked out before launch.
* You ship experiments end to end. Hypothesis, launch, readout and the next iteration, more than once, on dates you agreed and kept.
* You go to the source. You’ve turned user calls, session replays or research into a product decision that changed what shipped.
* You know consumer products. You’ve built product or growth at a consumer app, and Indian consumer fintech experience is a strong plus.
* You own the goal, not the task. You hold the number, the path to it and the next thread to pull, without waiting to be asked.
* Most importantly, you want a number that is clearly yours, in a business where every cohort you keep compounds.

Why Aspora?
  
  

* Own growth end to end, the core of Aspora’s business, with a number that is clearly yours.
* Set the growth playbook Aspora carries into new markets and the products we build on top of remittance.
* Full ownership from day one, not a slice of someone else’s roadmap.
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora’s long-term vision.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Summary
  
  
Client Services provides a world-class service experience to Visa's clients that begins with pre-sales and continues through onboarding, implementation of new products and services, issue resolution and service optimization.
  
  
The Client Services Digital and AI organization is dedicated to transforming and automating business processes across the end-to-end client service journey, making client and employee interactions with Visa straightforward, intuitive, and rewarding through the design, development, and delivery of enhanced digital experiences. As a member of the Digital and AI team, you will play a pivotal role in driving process improvement, automation, and digitization across Client Services, spanning onboarding, implementation, configuration, testing, licensing, service delivery, issue resolution, and optimization processes.
  
  
We are seeking a Product Analyst to support the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery of high-impact digital, AI, and automation products that improve processes across Client Services. This role will help identify and prioritize opportunities, translate complex user and business needs into scalable product capabilities and clear requirements, support technical solutioning, align cross-functional stakeholders, and contribute to measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a skilled product professional with product management experience, strong technical fluency, and demonstrated success applying rigorous critical thinking to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems. They have experience contributing to digital, automation, or AI-enabled products from discovery and prototyping through production, adoption, and continuous improvement. They will contribute to shaping the future of Client Services platforms and solutions, ensuring exceptional client and employee experiences, operational efficiency, responsible AI outcomes, resilient operations, and seamless integration with Visa systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for digital, AI, and automation products within a defined product area or process domain in Client Services, contributing to discovery, user research, business-case development, requirements definition, prioritization, responsible AI and risk controls, experimentation, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate and contribute to cross-functional collaboration across business, product, technology, operations, design, data science, risk, legal, compliance, and regional teams; surface trade-offs, follow through on decisions, and help maintain delivery momentum.
* Build fluency in the payments ecosystem and Client Services capabilities, workflows, systems, data, controls, and operational dependencies to inform product analysis and execution within assigned process areas.
* Help define measurable product outcomes and KPIs; analyze adoption, user experience, operational performance, model quality, risk, and value realization; and use data and feedback to support prioritization and investment recommendations.
* Apply structured critical thinking and developing systems thinking to Client Services challenges: help frame problems, test assumptions, synthesize qualitative and quantitative evidence, evaluate alternatives and risks, recommend product decisions, and clearly articulate the rationale and expected business impact.
* Translate user, business, operational, and technical needs into structured product requirements, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and validation scenarios; identify gaps, dependencies, edge cases, and unresolved decisions before delivery.
* Support the development of AI-enabled and automated products in partnership with product leaders and engineering, including use-case analysis, evaluating appropriate AI, automation, and human-intervention patterns, rapid prototyping, data and model readiness, evaluation criteria, human oversight, privacy and security controls, production deployment, observability, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Contribute to digital platform capabilities and workflow solutions that translate complex client and operational processes into intuitive, scalable product experiences, including requirements intake, process and solution design, business rules, decisioning, validation, approvals, integrations, execution, and continuous improvement.
* Prepare and communicate product recommendations, delivery status, risks, dependencies, and performance insights to cross-functional and senior stakeholders, escalating issues through product leadership as needed.

**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications
  
  

* 2 or more years of relevant product, business analysis, program, technology, operations, or related experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 1 or more years with an Advanced Degree (e.g., MBA, MS), including experience contributing to digital, platform, automation, or AI-enabled products or capabilities.
* Required: Demonstrated critical-thinking, analytical, and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame business problems with guidance, challenge assumptions, evaluate qualitative and quantitative evidence, assess options and risks, and translate insights into recommendations and clear requirements.
* Required: Experience using AI technologies or contributing to AI-enabled products, including analyzing viable use cases, supporting prototypes, documenting data and model requirements, helping establish evaluation and success metrics, partnering with engineering or data science teams, and applying responsible AI, privacy, security, and human-oversight practices. Familiarity with generative AI and/or agentic AI is required.
* Required: Experience using, analyzing, or supporting enterprise digital, workflow, automation, or AI-enabled products, including documenting product requirements, complex business rules and workflows, data and integration needs, controls, validation criteria, and capabilities that simplify complex client and operational processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, JD, MD).
* Experience contributing to enterprise software, workflow, platform, automation, or AI products with multiple integrations, stakeholder groups, or operational dependencies, preferably in a client onboarding, implementation, or service-delivery environment.
* Working technical knowledge of enterprise systems, APIs, data architecture, integrations, cloud services, AI/ML concepts, model evaluation, and production monitoring, with the ability to analyze system dependencies and support feasibility and trade-off discussions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Payments
jobs.description:
Constantinople delivers a new era of AI-native banking. Constantinople provides banks with a fully-managed software and AI operational platform, which brings together customer experience, product, data, operations, compliance and infrastructure in a single platform.
  
  
Constantinople’s AI-native platform eliminates the need for expensive infrastructure, and replaces manual operational and compliance processes with AI at scale. By removing the operational complexity of banking, Constantinople enables our client banks to focus on their customers and the business of banking.
  
  
**The Role**
You will own the Payments product itself: the platform capability every client bank runs on, rather than the launch of any single client. Your job is to make Payments serviceable, manageable and competitive at scale across all of our client banks, current and future, as part of normal business-as-usual operation.
  
  
You will work closely with Software Engineering, Solution Engineering, Product Design, Operations, Risk and Compliance, and the Client Delivery team.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the Payments product roadmap and prioritisation.
* Own new Payments platform capability, including its timeline and delivery commitments. You will build it as reusable capability for all of our clients on the platform, including new payment rail integrations, for example NPP , PayTo and BECS bulk payments in Australia, and their equivalents in other jurisdictions.
* Own payment orchestration and routing logic, and bulk and batch payment processing.
* Build out the requirements for scheme and payment rail connectivity, and work with the Technology team in owning the technical architecture: adapter design per rail and country, gateway integrations, and how payment state is managed across the platform.
* Own the configuration model, which gathers the specifications needed to streamline implementation for each new client that joins the platform.
* Work with second line to continue to develop the fraud and risk control framework for Payments across jurisdictions, and own its implementation.
* Own the serviceability and management of Payments functionality at scale, with every process automated end to end so no manual processing is needed, supported by self-service tooling for Operations and, where appropriate, clients, and designed to work for both day-to-day operations and risk and compliance oversight.
* Own client-facing reporting that gives client banks everything they need to understand and run their own payments business, including reconciliation, settlement and transaction reporting available to all clients.
* Evolve the Payments offering to stay competitive with modern fintech payments providers, both for our current market position and as the market moves, while helping build a best-in-class Product team that values collaboration, meaningful work and impact.

**Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with significant time on payments products.
* You have built payment rail integrations or payment platform capability, and know how scheme and rail connectivity works in practice.
* You have a background in payment processing systems, messaging standards such as ISO 20022, and API-based integrations.
* You have worked with second line to develop and implement fraud and financial crime controls for payment products.
* You have designed payment processes and tooling together with Operations and Risk and Compliance, and you understand the regulatory requirements for payments in the markets we serve.
* You have built reusable platform capability for multiple clients, supported by a configuration model that streamlines implementation for each new client.
* You have a bias toward action, a problem-solving mindset, and a willingness to do whatever it takes to solve complex challenges.
* You explain technical detail clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* You have a track record of driving alignment across technical teams, business partners and external vendors.
* You cut through ambiguity to produce strategic insight and spot opportunities.
* Startup experience is valued highly.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with more than one country's payment schemes.
* Experience at a modern fintech payments provider or a payments platform serving financial institutions.
* Experience building internal operations tooling.

**Application Process**
If this sounds like the kind of opportunity you've been looking for, select the 'Apply Now' button below to submit your cover letter and resume. Use your cover letter to introduce us to you; we want to know who you are, what you've worked on and why you think you'd be a great addition to the Constantinople team.
  
  
**Inclusion**
*To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*
*We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us. We will treat your request as confidentially as possible. In your email, please include your name and preferred method of contact, and we will respond as soon as possible.*

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Product Portfolio & Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

This role is responsible to lead portfolio-wide execution and governance across strategic product and technology programs. The role provides a single senior orchestration point across Business, Product, Engineering, QA, Production Support, Cloud / Infrastructure, InfoSec, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance and partners. The incumbent must combine strong subject command with executive presence, structured problem solving and the authority to challenge commitments, resolve cross-functional conflicts and drive timely decisions.

  

**Key Responsiblities:**

  

**a) Portfolio strategy translation:** Convert approved business and product priorities into an integrated execution plan, with outcomes, milestones, dependencies, decision points, investment needs and accountable owners.

  

**b) Executive stakeholder management:** Build trusted relationships with senior Business and Technology leaders. Frame issues clearly, align divergent viewpoints, secure decisions and maintain confidence through fact-based, proactive communication and tracking with proper timelines and RCAs as applicable.

  

**c) Integrated planning and prioritization:** Lead, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly and rolling planning across product pillars. Reconcile capacity, regulatory commitments, business-critical dates, technical dependencies and vendor plans; expose trade-offs for leadership decision.

  

**d) Governance and decision architecture:** Design and chair reviews, SteerCos and escalation forums. Ensure each forum has a clear purpose, accurate inputs, decision rights, actions, owners and closure discipline.

  

**e) Delivery assurance:** Independently assess programme health beyond reported RAG status. Validate critical path, milestones, resource assumptions, quality gates, readiness and benefits dependencies.

  

**f) Cross-programme dependency management:** Identify shared services, platform, data, API, security, infrastructure and partner dependencies; assign ownership and resolve sequencing conflicts before they affect delivery.

  

**g) Risk, issue and escalation management:** Maintain an executive RAID view, drive mitigation and trigger escalation at the right point. Distinguish decisions, risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies; prevent silent slippage.

  

**h) Commercial and vendor governance:** Govern delivery obligations, milestones, resource commitments, change requests, SLA performance, commercials and escalations for implementation and managed-service partners.

  

**i) Financial governance:** Track approved business cases, programme budgets, forecasts, purchase dependencies, change costs and benefit assumptions in partnership with Finance and procurement owners.

  

**j) Release and operational governance:** Ensure major releases have business, QA, Engineering, security, infrastructure, support and rollback readiness. Review recurring incidents, RCA closure and stability actions without taking over functional ownership.

  

**k) Regulatory and audit readiness:** Ensure traceability of mandatory commitments, approvals, evidence, controls, risks and closure for regulatory, compliance and audit programmes.

  

**l) Capability and standards:** Establish consistent planning, status reporting, RAID, dependency, release-readiness and decision-log standards. Coach Program Managers to become outcome-led leaders rather than coordinators.

  

**Requirements:**

  

* Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Finance or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is desirable.
* Programme / project certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum or equivalent is desirable, but demonstrated delivery leadership is more important than certification alone.
* Proven leadership of multiple, concurrent, high-complexity programmes involving business, product, engineering, operations and external partners.
* Strong understanding of lending journeys and lifecycle, including acquisition, underwriting, disbursement, servicing, collections, customer channels and partner integrations.
* Working command of agile, hybrid and milestone-based delivery; ability to challenge plans, dependencies, solution assumptions and release readiness.
* Experience with executive governance, programme financials, vendor contracts, implementation partners, risk management and organisational change.
* Ability to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, environments, security, cloud / infrastructure and production support sufficiently to ask the right questions and drive accountable closure.
* Experience in regulated financial services is strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Power Electronics Design Engineer / Project Design Lead** to drive the design, development, and commercialization of advanced power conversion products.

**1. Power Electronics Design and Development**

* Lead the design and development of power conversion products, including Online UPS, DC-DC Converters, DC-AC Inverters, Bidirectional Converters, Battery Chargers, Power Supplies, and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).
* Define system architecture, product specifications, electrical requirements, and suitable power conversion topologies.
* Design and optimize switching power converters using Buck, Boost, Buck-Boost, Flyback, Forward, Half-Bridge, Full-Bridge, LLC Resonant, Phase-Shifted Full-Bridge, and Power Factor Correction (PFC) topologies.
* Perform component selection and design calculations for power semiconductors, MOSFETs, IGBTs, SiC/GaN devices, magnetics, capacitors, thermal management, and protection circuits.
* Drive improvements in power density, conversion efficiency, reliability, performance, and cost.

**2. Control Systems and Digital Power Electronics**

* Develop and optimize control algorithms for power electronic converters and electrical power systems.
* Work closely with embedded engineering teams on DSP, MCU, and FPGA-based control implementation.
* Design and tune current control loops, voltage control loops, digital control systems, and battery charging strategies.
* Support the integration of hardware, firmware, and control systems to achieve product performance and stability requirements.

**3. End-to-End Product Development**

* Manage the complete product development lifecycle, from concept development, feasibility assessment, and system architecture through detailed design, prototyping, testing, validation, certification, and production release.
* Drive New Product Introduction (NPI), design reviews, design verification, and product qualification.
* Apply Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Reliability, and cost optimization principles.

**4. Technical and Project Leadership**

**5. Testing, Validation, and Compliance**

**6. Innovation and Technology Development**

**Preferred candidate profile**

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in power electronics design, converter topologies, control systems, magnetics, and product validation, along with the ability to lead engineering projects from concept to production

  

**Required Technical Skills**

**Core Power Electronics**

* Power Electronics Design and Development
* Online UPS Design Single Phase and Three Phase
* DC-DC Converter Design
* DC-AC Inverter Design
* Bidirectional Power Converters
* Switching Power Supply (SMPS) Design
* Battery Chargers and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
* Power Factor Correction (PFC)
* Analog and Digital Power Electronics
* Power Semiconductor Devices: MOSFET, IGBT, SiC, and GaN
* High-Frequency Magnetics Design
* Thermal Management and Electrical Protection
* Power Conversion Efficiency and Reliability Optimization

**Control and Embedded Systems**

* Digital Power Control
* Current Loop and Voltage Loop Design
* DSP, MCU, and FPGA-Based Control Systems
* Battery Charging Algorithms
* Battery Management Systems (BMS) relevant exposure

**Simulation and Engineering Tools**

**Product Development and Quality**

  

**Exposure required:**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in power electronics design, electrical power conversion, or related engineering domains.
* Master's degree in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electrical Drives, Energy Systems, or a related specialization.
* Strong hands-on experience in the design and development of power electronic converters and associated control systems.
* Demonstrated experience in taking engineering products from concept and design through prototyping, validation, and production.
* Experience leading technical activities, engineering projects, or cross-functional product development teams.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Data Centre Power Infrastructure and critical power systems.
* Online UPS, high-power converters, and three-phase power conversion systems.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales - Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

  

**Location:** Bangalore, India

**Function:** Enterprise Sales / Strategic Account Management

**Market Coverage:** India & Southeast Asia (SEA)

**Experience:** 5 to 9+ Years

  

**Role Purpose:**

  

The Enterprise Sales Capital Markets (Farmer / Strategic Account Management) role will be responsible for managing, retaining, and growing Azentio's existing Capital Markets customer relationships across India and Southeast Asia.

  

The role will focus on understanding each customer's business priorities, technology landscape, operational challenges, and transformation roadmap, and identifying how Azentio's broader portfolio can address those evolving needs.

  

A key expectation is to identify whitespace within existing accounts and drive incremental revenue growth through cross-selling and upselling opportunities across Azentio's product portfolio, while protecting existing revenue, expanding account penetration, and building long-term strategic customer relationships.

  

The successful candidate must possess strong BFSI domain expertise and proven experience in managing strategic BFSI accounts, with a demonstrated track record of driving business growth, achieving sales targets, and expanding customer relationships within this segment.

The individual should bring strong business and sales acumen, consultative selling capabilities, commercial awareness, and the ability to identify and convert opportunities into incremental revenue. Experience in managing large enterprise accounts, driving complex sales cycles, developing C-level relationships, and positioning technology solutions across the BFSI landscape will be essential. The candidate should also be comfortable operating in a dynamic and relatively unstructured environment, taking end-to-end ownership of accounts and proactively creating new business opportunities

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Strategic Account Management & Growth**

  

* Manage a portfolio of existing Capital Markets customers across India and SEA.
* Develop comprehensive account plans covering existing products, revenue, stakeholder relationships, customer priorities, whitespace, competitive presence, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Own account growth and develop clear strategies for increasing Azentio's share of wallet within strategic customers.
* Identify opportunities across business units, functions, geographies, and technology environments within existing accounts.
* Build a sustainable account-level pipeline for cross-sell, upsell, renewals, extensions, and new requirements.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape within each strategic account.

  

**Understanding Customer Needs & Consultative Selling**

  

* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business strategy, operational model, technology landscape, and transformation priorities.
* Engage customers proactively rather than waiting for requirements or RFPs to emerge.
* Conduct structured discovery sessions with business and technology stakeholders to uncover new requirements.
* Understand the underlying business problem and map the appropriate Azentio products and capabilities to the customer's needs.
* Develop solution propositions and business cases aligned to customer objectives.
* Position Azentio as a strategic technology partner, rather than a single-product vendor.

  

**Portfolio Selling, Cross-Sell & Upsell**

  

* Develop a strong understanding of Azentio's broader BFSI portfolio and its relevance to Capital Markets customers.
* Identify whitespace opportunities within existing customer accounts.
* Drive cross-sell and upsell by connecting customer business requirements with relevant Azentio solutions.
* Identify opportunities for additional products, modules, licenses, users, geographies, upgrades, integrations, or transformation initiatives.
* Work with Product and Pre-Sales teams to build integrated propositions where multiple Azentio capabilities can address customer requirements.
* Develop and maintain an account-level upsell and cross-sell roadmap for key customers."

  

**Customer Relationship & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Develop trusted relationships with senior business, operations, technology, procurement, and leadership stakeholders.
* Expand relationships beyond existing contacts and build multiple stakeholder connections within each account.
* Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), customer reviews, and strategic account discussions to assess customer satisfaction, identify growth opportunities, and drive account expansion.
* Understand stakeholder priorities, influence levels, decision-making processes, and potential relationship risks.
* Maintain strong customer engagement through regular meetings, workshops, market visits, and executive interactions.
* Act as the commercial relationship owner and customer advocate within Azentio.

  

**Renewals, Retention & Commercial Expansion**

  

* Protect and grow existing account revenue through proactive management of renewals, extensions, upgrades, and commercial opportunities.
* Engage customers ahead of renewal cycles to identify potential risks and expansion opportunities.
* Drive commercial negotiations for renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Identify competitive threats, customer dissatisfaction, or relationship risks early and develop appropriate retention strategies.
* Partner with internal teams to ensure customer commitments are addressed and commercial relationships remain healthy.
* Balance customer requirements with commercial quality, margins, contractual terms, and long-term account value.

  

**India & Southeast Asia Account Development**

  

* Manage and grow assigned strategic accounts across India and Southeast Asia.
* Develop an understanding of market-specific customer dynamics and business practices.
* Build strong customer relationships through regular in-person engagement.
* Candidates who bring strong market intelligence, industry insights, competitive awareness, and an understanding of emerging business opportunities across India and Southeast Asia, enabling them to identify new growth avenues and add strategic value to Azentio's business, will have an advantage
* Travel extensively across India and Southeast Asia based on customer and business requirements.

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

  

* Collaborate closely with Pre-Sales, Product Management, Delivery, Customer Success, Support, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Leadership.
* Coordinate product demonstrations, solution workshops, customer presentations, RFP/RFI responses, and commercial proposals.
* Work closely with Delivery and Customer Success teams to understand ongoing projects and identify potential account opportunities or risks.
* Provide structured customer and market feedback to Product teams.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders to ensure a consistent approach to strategic customers. Salesforce Hygiene, Pipeline Management & Sales Governance

  

The candidate should be expected to:

  

* Maintain the highest standards of Salesforce (SFDC) hygiene, ensuring timely and accurate updates of account information, sales opportunities, deal values, pipeline stages, probability, expected closure dates, and customer engagement activities.
* Maintain a healthy and actionable sales pipeline, with clear visibility into opportunity progression, next steps, dependencies, potential risks, and closure plans.
* Consistently adopt and apply the MEDDPICC sales qualification methodology across strategic opportunities to ensure structured opportunity assessment and deal governance.
* Maintain accurate and realistic revenue forecasts, booking projections, and closure estimates.
* Participate in mandatory weekly sales review calls with management, providing updates on pipeline movement, opportunity progression, MEDDPICC qualification status, revenue outlook, challenges, and action plans.
* Take complete ownership

To support the delivery and execution of the end-to-end Rewards Product journey by managing product requirements, digital integrations, and reward fulfillment processes, thereby enhancing customer engagement and supporting overall business growth.

* Assist in defining reward journeys, eligibility rules, and fulfillment workflows aligned with business objectives and product guidelines.

  .

  .

Nice to Have :

jobs.description:
**What You'll Do**

* Own the vision and the roadmap :
* Turn the company vision into a product strategy and a roadmap the whole company can plan against.
* Help us prioritize opportunities as we expand the product, go up-market, and explore new possibilities.
* Own product metrics end to end : turnaround time, accuracy, coverage, adoption and revenue per product line.
* Develop and execute the product strategy and roadmap to move the needle on ARR, Retention, and ACV, in collaboration with the GTM teams.
* Stay close to customers and regulators :
* Spend time every week with credit, risk, legal and operations teams at banks, NBFCs and HFCs. Know their workflows better than they do.
* Track RBI, NHB and CERSAI direction and public infrastructure such as ULI, and build ahead of it instead of reacting to it.
* Sit in on key enterprise deals and renewals, and bring back what the product needs to win the next one.
* Ship, hands-on :
* Write specs, prototype with AI tools and review output quality yourself. This is a player-coach role.
* Partner with Engineering, Data Acquisition and Data Science to balance speed with platform reliability and compliance-grade accuracy.
* Make AI a product advantage : document understanding in 14 languages, title reasoning and automated risk signals that a credit officer can trust and audit.
* Drive adoption and ARR with GTM and Sales :
* Co-own adoption and ARR targets with the Sales and GTM leads. A product is not shipped until customers are using it and paying for it.
* Work on positioning, messaging and launch content, so the market understands what each product does and why it matters to a lender.
* Equip Sales and Customer Success with demos, proof points, ROI cases and competitive answers, and join key pitches, renewals and expansion conversations.
* Run a tight loop on win/loss reasons, usage data and customer feedback, and use it to grow usage and revenue within existing accounts.
* Own pricing and monetization :
* Leverage experience in B2B SaaS to make informed decisions around monetization, pricing, and product enhancements that help grow ARR and ACV.
* Lead and grow the team :
* Hire, coach and raise the bar for product managers and designers.
* Set a lightweight operating rhythm for discovery, prioritization, releases and feedback loops with Sales and Delivery.
* Represent product to the board, investors, customers and ecosystem partners.
* Foster a culture of low ego, high impact, and continuous learning.

**What We're Looking For**

* 10+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading product managers.
* You have owned a B2B platform, API or data product end to end and scaled it from early traction to a large customer base.
* Experience selling into or building for regulated enterprises, ideally banks, NBFCs or insurers, with long sales cycles and compliance reviews.
* First-principles thinking : you can break an ambiguous problem into bets, and show the data behind your calls.
* High agency and low ego. You do whatever part of the PM job the week demands.
* AI-native in how you work and what you build. You have shipped products where ML or LLM output quality was the product.
* Experience with data products where coverage, freshness and accuracy are the core metrics.
* Comfort with pricing and packaging for enterprise and usage-based API models.
* A track record of hiring and growing strong PMs.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience taking a B2B data asset into a consumer or partner-led product.
* Background in lending, mortgage, credit risk, collateral or fintech infrastructure.
* You have been a founder or an early leader at a company through Series A to C.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* Impact : property is India's largest asset class and its least liquid. Your work decides how fast credit reaches homeowners, small businesses and farmers.
* A real moat to build on : a property dataset and identity layer that took years to assemble, with live banking customers already using it.
* Ownership : a leadership seat, direct access to founders, board and customers, and meaningful equity.
* Compensation and benefits : Competitive salary, ESOPs, health cover, leave policy and other benefits.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Trading
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
The Senior Product Manager-Trading will collaborate with the other Trading Product Managers and Trading Product Leads to help guide the vision for Trading, OMS, and IBOR products. We are building this product suite anew and collaborating with our design team to improve the advisor/trader facing workflows and build engaging experiences that scale. You will execute product vision, implement strategy, and collaborate with a cross-functional team in a manner that improves their efficiency and productivity.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Possess a solid understanding of Trading, Rebalancing, and OMS systems used in the US and European wealth management industry. You understand trading products in terms of their users, business value, technical landscape, data, vendors, and can relate these to other areas of the Addepar ecosystem
* Document and communicate goals for the product and drive an innovative product roadmap that conveys the team vision and goals to our clients
* Build consensus with the team to prioritize and define increments of work based on level of effort, interdependencies, and other relevant criteria
* Assist in adjusting strategy in response to changing company, business, market, and technical needs.
* Identify appropriate users, partners, competitors, and market trends from which to elicit input and draw inspiration

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of relevant work experience and education in product management, software development, user workflows, and efficiently leading teams
* Fundamental knowledge in finance, trading, and investments, specifically with trading for wealth management firms
* Ability to communicate finance domain knowledge, problems and knowledge well both in person and in writing for internal development and sales teams as well for clients and 3rd party data partners
* Ability to partner with engineering to define the functional and technical implementation to tackle a business problem. This includes understanding of high level data development concepts, data modelling and the ability to write and review technical requirements documents
* Practical knowledge of agile thinking and lean practices; project management, and a strong ability to guide teams through project iterations
* A superpower for identifying the appropriate tools, people and techniques to accomplish objectives

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

jobs.title: Collateral Store - Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Join us as a “Collateral Store - Business Analyst" at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
To be successful as a “Collateral Store - Business Analyst ", you should have experience with:
  
  
**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience working across the full project lifecycle, with a proven track record of successfully delivering complex business and technology projects.
* Strong Business Analysis experience, including requirement elicitation, analysis, documentation, validation, and management throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Excellent requirement gathering skills, with the ability to translate business needs into clear Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirements, User Stories, Use Cases, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments, preferably Scrum/Kanban, with strong working knowledge of JIRA and Confluence.
* Strong understanding of AI and Generative AI (GenAI) concepts, with the ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve business processes, operational efficiency, controls, and decision-making.
* Experience using GenAI tools such as Microsoft Copilot to accelerate BA activities including requirement analysis, requirement documentation, user-story creation, test scenario generation, summarisation, and impact analysis.
* Ability to define and document AI/GenAI use cases and requirements, including business objectives, expected outcomes, data requirements, human-in-the-loop controls, validation criteria, and success measures.
* Good understanding of AI risks and governance considerations, including data privacy, security, hallucination/accuracy, explainability, human oversight, and responsible use of AI.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to perform gap analysis, impact analysis, root-cause analysis, and As-Is/To-Be process analysis.
* Ability to work with business and technology stakeholders to identify process automation and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Strong SQL Server and MongoDB knowledge, with good SQL query-writing skills for data analysis, investigation, reconciliation, and validation of business requirements.
* Ability to review C# code and extract/understand existing business logic, particularly when documenting legacy application behaviour and defining future-state requirements.
* Experience supporting UAT, including preparation of test scenarios, acceptance criteria, traceability of requirements to test cases, defect analysis, and business sign-off.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills with the ability to facilitate workshops, requirement walkthroughs, solution discussions, and prioritisation sessions.
* Excellent collaboration skills and experience working with cross-functional and cross-region teams, including Business, Operations, Product Owners, Developers, Architects, QA, and Support teams.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to challenge requirements constructively and recommend practical solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate.

**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**

* Previous Investment bank experience.
* Understanding of OTC derivatives, Futures, Repos etc and other traded products.

This role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Walk-in || Jr. Software Support Engineer LMS
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Jr. Software Support Engineer LMS

**Department:** Learning & Development

**Location:** Pune

**Employment Type:** Contractual

**Experience Required:** 2 to 3 Years

**Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Computer Applications

(BCA/MCA)

  

**1. Job Purpose**

The Jr. Software Support Engineer will support the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and operational

functioning of the organisations LMS. The role includes managing user accounts and course assignments,

maintaining accurate reports, preparing and uploading digital learning content, conducting learning platform testing,

supporting system enhancements and migration activities, and resolving platform-related queries from trainers and

other stakeholders.

  

The role requires attention to detail, technical troubleshooting skills, data accuracy, and effective coordination with

internal teams to ensure reliable platform operations and continuous improvement.

  

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**A. Learning Platform Administration and Operational Support**

* Create and maintain user accounts, ensuring accurate user profiles, roles, locations, and project mappings.
* Manage course enrolments, programme assignments, user deactivations, and other learning platform

administrative activities.

* Monitor platform activities and screenshots as per the defined schedule.
* Track and resolve platform access and assignment-related issues within established timelines.
* Maintain records of platform activities and conduct periodic operational compliance checks.
* Ensure accurate batch and programme mapping across the platform.

**B. Reporting and Data Management**

* Extract, validate, consolidate, and maintain platform data for operational and management reporting.
* Prepare and submit weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc reports within defined timelines.
* Maintain trackers for user accounts, course assignments, enrolments, completions, and other platform activities.
* Verify report accuracy against source data and investigate discrepancies.
* Maintain appropriate report version control and documentation.
* Provide timely and accurate data to support internal reviews and management decisions.

**C. Digital Content Development and Assessment Management**

* Convert and upload learning content in SCORM-compatible formats, where required.
* Create quizzes, assessments, and question banks aligned with course learning objectives.
* Map assessments to relevant courses and configure scoring, pass/fail criteria, and completion triggers.
* Test uploaded content for compatibility, functionality, and playback before publishing.
* Incorporate feedback and content revisions within agreed timelines.
* Maintain content quality standards and ensure accurate course configuration.

**D. Quality Assurance and Learning Platform Testing**

* Prepare and execute test cases for learning platform releases, updates, and enhancements.
* Identify, document, and report software defects, errors, and functional issues.
* Conduct retesting after bug fixes and validate enhancements before deployment.
* Perform regression testing to confirm that existing platform functionalities continue to work as expected.
* Validate data migration, including user records, course completions, and assessment scores, where applicable.
* Maintain test documentation, defect trackers, and quality assurance reports.
* Coordinate with developers and relevant stakeholders to support issue resolution and platform stability.

**E. Stakeholder Support and Continuous Improvement**

* Provide technical and operational support to trainers and internal stakeholders for learning platform-related

queries.

* Troubleshoot user access, course assignment, assessment, and platform usage issues.
* Maintain a query tracker documenting issue details, status, resolution, and closure.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate team and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
* Guide trainers on platform processes and the correct use of learning tools.
* Participate in mandatory internal training and undertake regular technical upskilling.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform processes, documentation, reporting, and user experience.

**F. Skills and Competencies Required**

* Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms.
* Basic understanding of SCORM content, e-learning modules, and online assessments.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to conduct functional testing, document defects, and validate fixes.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and quality assurance practices.
