jobs.title: Digital Marketing Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

  

Our Make Web Media is looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Digital Marketing Project Coordinator to manage client communication and coordinate with internal teams for the smooth execution of digital marketing projects. The candidate will be responsible for client onboarding, understanding project requirements, coordinating with Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, Graphic Design and Website Development teams, tracking project progress, managing deadlines, handling client queries and ensuring timely project delivery. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication, organizational and follow-up skills, along with a basic understanding of digital marketing and the ability to manage multiple client accounts efficiently.

  

**Role & responsibilities**

  

**1. Client Communication & Relationship Management**

* Communicate with clients regularly to understand their requirements, expectations and feedback.
* Handle client calls, WhatsApp communication and emails professionally.
* Collect content requirements, approvals, feedback, images, videos and other necessary inputs from clients.
* Share updates regarding ongoing activities, deliverables and pending approvals.
* Maintain professional relationships with clients and ensure timely responses to their queries.

**2. Internal Team Coordination**

* Coordinate between clients, digital marketing executives, graphic designers and other internal departments.
* Communicate client requirements clearly to the concerned team members.
* Follow up on pending tasks, creatives, content approvals and campaign-related requirements.
* Ensure that deliverables are completed within the agreed timelines.
* Track daily tasks and maintain proper records of client communication and work progress.

**3. Content Planning & Creation**

* Plan monthly social media content calendars for clients.
* Create engaging and relevant content for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and other social media platforms.
* Write captions, social media posts, ad copies, headlines and promotional content.
* Develop content ideas for static posts, carousels, reels and video creatives.
* Understand client businesses and prepare content according to their target audience, brand positioning and marketing objectives.
* Coordinate with graphic designers and video editors to get creatives developed.

**4. Social Media & Digital Marketing Coordination**

* Coordinate social media posting schedules and ensure timely publishing.
* Follow up on content approvals and pending creative requirements.
* Monitor social media deliverables and maintain monthly content trackers.
* Support the digital marketing team with campaign content, client inputs and creative requirements.
* Prepare basic client updates and activity reports.

**5. Reporting & Task Management**

* Maintain client-wise task trackers and content calendars.
* Ensure all client requirements and feedback are documented.
* Monitor pending tasks and proactively follow up with the concerned team members.
* Escalate delays, client concerns and execution-related issues to management.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

* 1-3 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Client Servicing, Social Media Management or a similar role.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong content writing and copywriting abilities.
* Understanding of Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and other social media platforms.
* Ability to plan social media content calendars and generate creative content ideas.
* Comfortable communicating with clients through calls, WhatsApp and emails.
* Good coordination, follow-up and task management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets, Google Docs, MS Office and basic digital marketing tools.
* Knowledge of creative concepts will be an added advantage.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail and professional communication are essential.

jobs.description:
**ZS**   is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it , our most valuable asset is our people. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning; bold ideas; courage an d passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.   
  
   
  
   
  
**Our most valuable asset is our people**  .   
  
At **ZS**  we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are and   
  
make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are part of your success here. Learn more about our diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces, obtaining the resources they need to thrive, and sharing the messages they are passionate about.   
   
ZS’s Digital and Technology group focuses on driving end to end Digital Transformation that includes Digital Strategy, Human centered Design, exploiting emerging technologies, and purposeful change management to improve customer and company results. The types of solutions include Digital Strategy and Advisory services, end to end Transformation Management, Enterprise Data, Analytics and AI, Intelligent Automation, reimagining business processes with digital first lens and building Digital Products, Solutions and Digital Platforms leveraging Big Data Technologies, AI/ML and Advance Analytics, Digital Platform configuration and integrations. We provide a complete spectrum of technology solutions, from strategy and roadmap definition to full scale implementation and on-going operations. Our team possesses deep expertise in leading digital transformation, enterprise data analytic and AI, Data science and advanced analytics and building end to end digital.   
  
   
  
**Manager- Enterprise Architect in Tech and Cloud Advisory**     
  
ZS's Technology Advisory Group ensures our future information, technology and architectural landscape is built to plan and evolve as our business grows, striving to balance future-proofing our end-to-end technology stack while accelerating the speed of innovation and streamlining the delivery of business capability.- This role will be responsible for supporting the growth and development of our Technology Advisory Practice within the ZS Technology Services business.   
    
     
    
  The successful candidate will work closely with ZS practice leadership and be responsible for evolving our practice, enriching our practice assets and collaterals, building, and managing client relationships, generating new business engagements, and providing thought leadership in the Technology and Architecture Area.   
    
  **What You’ll Do**
- Design robust and scalable solutions consistent with ZS and industry practices; take advantage of the existing assets and maintaining a balance between architecture requirements and specific client needs
- Drive technical architecture and design discussions with internal and client groups to brainstorm and finalize technology solutions
- Collaborate with the Architecture & Engineering expertise centre leadership to define technology roadmap and work with delivery team to put together a plan for technical implementation with and stay on track
- Stay current on latest technology trends and architecture patterns, and lead the effort to develop ZS POV for strategic decision-making
- Engage with clients to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions.
- Advance ZS’ technology offerings by innovating and scaling tech assets, driving feasibility analysis to select technologies/platforms that provide the best solution
- Define and establish a technical strategy, standards, and guidelines in the data architecture domain
- Groom junior team members and maintain a culture of rapid learning and explorations to drive innovations / POCs on emerging technologies and architecture patterns
- Participate and support the business development activities.
  
**What You’ll Bring**     
- Bachelor's degree with specialization in Computer Science, IT or other computer related disciplines
- 8+ years of relevant experience in designing semantic architecture at an enterprise-scale.
- Strong engineering mindset to build highly available and robust architecture frameworks, technology solutions and reusable assets
- Expertise in one or more of initiatives like cloud strategy, IT transformation, and application portfolio assessment.
- Excellent communication and client engagement skills and ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
- Experience in providing architecture alternatives, product evaluation and recommendations, POVs for implementation/adoption .
- Experience in scaling technology solutions aimed at solving complex business problems.
- Knowledge of all phases of solution development for large-scale solutions and experience working in agile teams with short release cycles.
- Strong technical team leadership, mentorship and collaboration abilities.
  
**Perks & Benefits:**    
ZS offers a comprehensive total rewards package including health and well-being, financial planning, annual leave, personal growth and professional development. Our robust skills development programs, multiple career progression options and internal mobility paths and collaborative culture empowers you to thrive as an individual and global team member.   
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.   
  
**Travel:**    
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.   
  
**Considering applying**    
At ZS, we're building a diverse and inclusive company where people bring their passions to inspire life-changing impact and deliver better outcomes for all. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job and recognize the value that candidates with all backgrounds, including non-traditional ones, bring. If you are interested in joining us, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements listed above.   
  
ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.   
  
**To Complete Your Application:**    
Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment.An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.   
  
NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

jobs.title: Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Job Summary**

This role exists to support sustainable retail portfolio growth by making prudent, timely and consistent credit decisions for mortgage and wealth management products. The role evaluates customers’ creditworthiness, risk exposure, affordability and application quality to ensure lending decisions align with the Bank’s credit policies, risk appetite, regulatory obligations and business objectives.
  
  
The role balances risk management with customer experience by ensuring credit applications are assessed accurately, efficiently and consistently. It contributes to portfolio quality, operational effectiveness and business growth through sound underwriting judgement, risk assessment and continuous process improvement.
  
  
The role also supports the evolution of credit operations by identifying opportunities to improve turnaround times, strengthen controls, support product launches and contribute to operational initiatives that enhance service delivery and decision-making effectiveness. Where applicable, the role provides operational guidance, supports team capability development and helps maintain underwriting consistency across the function.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Credit Assessment & Underwriting**  
• Assess retail mortgage and wealth management applications to deliver prudent credit decisions that balance customer needs with portfolio risk objectives.
  
• Evaluate customer financial profiles, affordability, repayment capacity and credit history to determine appropriate lending outcomes.
  
• Apply credit policies, underwriting standards and delegated authorities consistently to support high-quality credit decision-making.
  
• Escalate complex or higher-risk cases appropriately to ensure sound risk governance and decision integrity.
  
**Credit Risk & Fraud Management**  
• Identify, assess and mitigate credit and fraud risks that may affect portfolio quality or customer outcomes.
  
• Apply regulatory requirements and internal risk controls to ensure lending decisions remain compliant and defensible.
  
• Detect indicators of potential fraud, misrepresentation or suspicious activity and initiate appropriate escalation processes.
  
• Support a strong risk culture through disciplined application of credit policies and controls.
  
**Operational Excellence & Process Improvement**  
• Improve underwriting efficiency by identifying process enhancements that reduce turnaround times while maintaining control effectiveness.
  
• Contribute to operational initiatives that enhance service quality, productivity and customer experience.
  
• Support the implementation of new products, policy changes and process enhancements to ensure operational readiness.
  
• Use operational insights and performance trends to recommend improvements in credit assessment and workflow management.

**Business Support & Stakeholder Collaboration**  
**• Partner with Product, Sales, CRM, Fraud Risk, Lending Operations and support teams to facilitate effective credit assessment and application processing.**  
**• Provide underwriting expertise that supports business growth initiatives, marketing campaigns and new product introductions.**  
**• Resolve credit-related queries and exceptions by collaborating with relevant stakeholders to achieve balanced customer and risk outcomes.**  
**• Contribute operational insights to projects and initiatives that improve the effectiveness of the end-to-end lending process.**  
**Governance, Compliance & Controls**  
**• Ensure credit decisions and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements, Bank policies and internal control standards.**  
**• Maintain accurate documentation and audit readiness to support transparency and regulatory compliance.**  
**• Apply anti-money laundering and financial crime prevention requirements, escalating suspicious activities where appropriate.**  
**• Support governance activities that strengthen underwriting consistency, policy adherence and operational risk management.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Priority Skills**  
**• Application Processing**  
**• Banking Strategy**  
**• Compliance Audit**  
**• Compliance Monitoring**  
**• Continuous Improvement**  
**• Financial Services**  
**Other skills**  
**• Create Credit Policy**  
**• Credit Administration**  
**• Credit Management**  
**• Operational Monitoring**  
**• Risk Assessment**  
**• Stakeholder Engagement**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Building trusted, long‑term relationships that deliver sustainable, risk‑adjusted growth.**

**• Aligning products, regions and stakeholders around clear strategic priorities.**  
**• Applying sector‑ and segment‑specific knowledge and judgment to solve complex client problems and create value, leveraging data and AI‑enabled insights to deepen client understanding, sharpen focus and drive commercial impact.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Experience in regulated financial services environments where risk, compliance and customer outcomes are closely managed.**

**• Exposure to retail lending, mortgage, wealth management or consumer banking products involving structured credit assessment frameworks.**  
**• Experience in high-volume processing environments requiring strong judgement, prioritisation and attention to detail.**  
**• Exposure to cross-functional collaboration involving Product, Sales, Operations, Risk and Control functions.**  
**• Experience supporting operational improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, service quality and control effectiveness.**  
**• Business English**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

* **Proactive wellbeing support** **through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.**

**Location:** Marol, Andheri East, Mumbai (Work from Office)

**Website:** https://www.evolutionco.com/

**About EvolutionCo**

EvolutionCo is a team of 60+ digital professionals building enterprise web applications, portals and digital platforms for leading brands such as HDFC, Cisco, Mahindra and Unilever. Our BFSI practice delivers digital banking and insurance experiences for banks and financial institutions. We have an Employee First culture and care about your growth.The Role You’ll be the link between BFSI clients and our design and engineering teams. You’ll take a business need, such as a corporate banking portal, a customer onboarding journey or a loan or insurance calculator, and turn it into clear, buildable requirements. You’ll stay with it through delivery and UAT.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and analyse requirements from banking and insurance stakeholders through workshops, calls and process walkthroughs
* Write BRDs, FSDs, user stories and acceptance criteria that UX, UI, development and QA teams can work from without confusion
* Map current and future-state business processes and user journeys for banking products and digital channels
* Create wireframes and basic prototypes to validate flows with clients before design begins
* Translate BFSI processes (onboarding and KYC, account services, payments, lending, cash management, insurance journeys) into clear functional specs
* Work with UX, UI, Frontend, Backend and QA teams, answer their queries and manage requirement changes
* Review builds against requirements, prepare UAT scenarios and support clients through UAT sign-off
* Track deliverables and flag risks or scope changes to the Project Manager early
* Prepare clear status updates, reports and presentations for clients and internal leadership

**Must-Have Requirements**

* 2 to 4 years as a Business Analyst, with at least 1.5 to 2 years in BFSI (banking, insurance, NBFC or fintech)
* Working knowledge of corporate or retail banking: accounts, payments, loans, trade finance or cash management (any one or two areas is fine)
* Familiarity with BFSI basics such as KYC/AML, RBI guidelines, and internet or mobile banking journeys
* Hands-on experience writing BRD/FRD/FSD and user stories
* Strong written and verbal communication, and comfort handling client calls
* Good command of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Ownership, attention to detail and a record of delivering on commitments

**Good to Have (not mandatory)**

* Experience with enterprise portals, web applications or digital banking platforms
* Basic wireframing in Figma, Balsamiq or similar
* Familiarity with Jira or similar tools
* Exposure to Agile/Scrum delivery
* Experience working with a bank or an agency serving BFSI clients

**What You’ll Get**

* Work on live enterprise BFSI projects with direct client exposure
* A close-knit team with real room to grow into senior BA and product roles
* An Employee First culture

Pay: Up to ₹600,000.00 per year

**Job Summary**
---------------

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).

• Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
  
• Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**  
• Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
  
• Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
  
• Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
  
• Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.
  
**Product execution and prioritisation**  
• Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
  
• Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
  
• Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
  
• Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
  
• Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.
  
**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**  
• Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
  
• Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
  
• Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**  
**• Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.**  
**• Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.**  
**• Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.**  
**People and talent**  
**• Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.**  
**• Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.**  
**• Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.**  
**Risk, controls and governance**  
**• Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.**  
**• Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.**  
**• Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
**• Cash and Payments Product Strategy**  
**• Digital Channels and Corporate Connectivity**  
**• Product Commercialisation and Value Proposition**  
**Other Skills**  
**• Portfolio Prioritisation and Investment Discipline**  
**• Client and Market Insight**  
**• Senior Stakeholder Influence**  
**• People Leadership and Product Team Development**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Shaping client-channel strategy and turning complex Cash and Payments needs into scalable propositions with visible commercial and client value.**

**• Leading across business, product and technology boundaries to resolve competing priorities and deliver high-impact outcomes across markets.**  
**• Building empowered Product Owner teams that combine deep channel expertise with strategic thinking, disciplined execution and strong client focus.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Key Experiences**  
**• 15+ years of senior-level experience in Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments or enterprise digital channels, including product strategy, proposition development, commercialisation and execution.**  
**• Deep experience in corporate connectivity and more than one client channel, with working knowledge of H2H, SWIFT, APIs and corporate Web banking.**  
**• Strong Cash and Payments domain understanding across domestic and cross-border payments, real-time and bulk payments, payroll, receivables, liquidity, statements and reporting.**  
**• Working command of ISO 20022 payment and reporting messages, legacy MT formats, local clearing formats, and ERP or treasury management system integration.**  
**• Demonstrated experience building business cases, prioritising investments and managing multiple initiatives across countries, products and channels.**  
**• Strong experience in Portfolio management at scale, running a large backlog with many initiatives in parallel, while sharing limited delivery capacity across countries and demand types.**  
**• Proven leadership of Product Owners or Product Managers and senior-level influence across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance.**  
**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):** **Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, finance, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. No role-specific certification is mandatory.**

**Job Summary**
---------------

* Own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for corporate client Statements, Advice and Transactional Reporting across S2B Web, Host-to-Host, SWIFT and API channels.

• Develop a coherent omnichannel reporting experience that enables clients to discover, configure, receive, download and reconcile account information consistently, regardless of the channel used.
  
• Drive convergence of reporting journeys, data definitions, formats, entitlements and service standards across channels, while accommodating channel-specific client needs and integration models.
  
• Translate client, business, regulatory and servicing needs into secure, resilient and scalable prior-day and intraday reporting capabilities, using client usage analytics to improve adoption, simplify the estate and guide lifecycle decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Product Strategy, Vision and Roadmap**  
• Define and maintain the global product vision, target-state architecture principles and multi-year roadmap for statements, account reporting, transaction reporting and advices across digital channels.
  
• Prioritise investments using client value, adoption, revenue enablement, regulatory obligations, service risk, architecture health and total cost of ownership; develop business cases and measurable outcomes.
  
• Benchmark market capabilities and emerging standards, converting insights into differentiated propositions and sequenced capability increments.

**Client Reporting Proposition and Standards**  
• Own the catalogue of prior-day and intraday statements, debit/credit advices, balance and transaction reports, including channel availability, eligibility, formats, service levels and client-facing documentation.
  
• Guide support for relevant reporting standards and formats, including SWIFT MT940/MT942, ISO 20022 camt.052/camt.053/camt.054, BAI2, CSV, PDF, XML and API payloads, with clear versioning and migration plans.
  
• Ensure consistent semantics, reconciliation behaviour, balances, value dates, transaction codes, references and data lineage across Web, H2H, SWIFT and API delivery.
  
**End-to-End Product Ownership and Agile Delivery**  
• Convert strategy and client needs into epics, capabilities, user stories, acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements; own backlog ordering and make transparent scope and trade-off decisions.
  
• Lead discovery, solution shaping, design reviews, sprint planning, demonstrations, UAT, release readiness, production rollout and benefits validation with Technology, Architecture, Operations and servicing teams.
  
• Embed security, privacy, entitlement, auditability, accessibility, performance, availability, scalability and observability requirements from inception.

**Client Experience, Adoption and Commercialisation**  
**• Use research, servicing insights and journey mapping to simplify report discovery, subscription, configuration, scheduling, delivery, download and exception handling.**  
**• Partner with Sales, Implementation, Client Service and country/cluster teams on client propositions, complex solutioning, migration, launch communications, training and adoption campaigns.**  
**• Define and monitor success measures such as active clients, report delivery and download utilisation, migration progress, digital adoption, service availability, failure rates, latency and client feedback.**

**Data, Architecture and Service Resilience**  
**• Maintain an accurate current-state view of source systems, data flows, transformation rules, interfaces, loaders, schedulers and upstream/downstream dependencies, including ownership and service levels.**  
**• Drive convergence toward reusable data services and a common reporting architecture across Cash and, where relevant, Trade and FSS, reducing duplication and inconsistent client outcomes.**  
**• Own product response to incidents and recurring defects, ensuring root-cause analysis, corrective actions, resilience improvements and prioritisation of technical debt and single points of failure.**

**Risk, Governance and Lifecycle Management**  
**• Operate product governance across new capabilities, material changes and report retirement, including approvals, client impact assessment, migration, records retention, regulatory and compliance review, and operational readiness.**  
**• Maintain product standards, controls, risks, dependencies, decision records and audit evidence; ensure issues are escalated and remediated with clear ownership and closure criteria.**  
**• Use usage and cost analysis to identify reports for growth, consolidation or decommissioning, validating recommendations with product, country, technology, operations and client stakeholders.**

**Stakeholder Leadership and Decision Making**  
**• Act as the accountable product subject-matter expert, aligning senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Sales, Implementation and Client Service.**  
**• Communicate complex data and technology topics clearly to executive and delivery audiences; facilitate decisions, resolve competing priorities and maintain momentum across globally distributed teams.**  
**• This is an individual-contributor Product Owner role with matrix leadership responsibility across multidisciplinary delivery teams and strategic partners.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
**• Digital Product Strategy and Lifecycle Management**  
**• Transaction Banking Statements and Reporting**  
**• Agile Product Ownership and Backlog Management**  
**• Data Architecture, Integration and ISO 20022/SWIFT Standards**  
**• Risk, Controls and Operational Resilience**  
**Other Skills**  
**• Client Experience, Commercialisation and Adoption**  
**• Data Analytics and Product Performance Management**  
**• Stakeholder Management and Executive Communication**  
**• Service Management, Incident and Problem Management**  
**• Market and Competitive Analysis**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Solving complex client reporting and reconciliation challenges**

**• Driven to ensure data integrity and consistency across channels and transaction types, with aligned definitions, mappings, balances, references and reconciliation outcomes that clients can trust.**  
**• Building a coherent omnichannel experience across S2B Web, H2H, SWIFT and API**  
**• Leading collaboratively in regulated, globally distributed environments**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Key Experiences**  
**• Typically 10+ years of relevant experience in transaction banking, cash management, corporate digital channels, data/reporting products or complex banking technology delivery.**  
**• Demonstrated Product Owner or Product Manager experience owning strategy, roadmap, backlog and end-to-end delivery for enterprise digital products.**  
**• Strong domain experience in corporate account information, statements, transaction reporting, advices or cash-management reporting across Web, H2H, SWIFT and/or API channels.**  
**• Practical experience with SWIFT account reporting and ISO 20022 cash-management messages; familiarity with MT940/942 and camt.052/053/054 is strongly preferred.**

**• Track record of leading cross-functional delivery, UAT, releases, migrations, production incident remediation and lifecycle rationalisation in a regulated environment.**

jobs.description:
Date live: 11/17/2026

Business Area: USCB Operations

Area of Expertise: Banking Operations

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000134989

  

Step into the role of Operations Analyst at Barclays where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. Join us in our mission to safeguard our business and our customers from financial crime risks.

  
  

* Have the ability to work in a “permanent night shift”, work in office 5 days a week through training and period to full production which is four to six months. (Note: The USCB Bank Operation works in the window from 4 PM IST to 5 AM IST next day across 7 days a week)
* Need to have understanding of US credit card product knowledge across US Consumer Banking.
* Review and process customer requests by conducting in-depth due diligence, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and safeguarding our clients and organization with expertise and care.
* Analyze documents received via mail, fax, and digital uploads and ensure correct action and routing.
* Identify the nature and purpose of documents and initiate appropriate actions, including case creation where required.
* Locate and validate customer accounts using enterprise systems including Salesforce, TSYS, MetaStor, and ActiveStore.
* Verify customer identity using parameters such as name, address, account number, and additional security details.
* Open, update, and close cases accurately in Salesforce with detailed audit‑ready notes.
* Ensure all cases are processed within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) across multiple partner queues.
* Identify risk indicators such as account status issues or fraud flags and route cases to relevant teams as required.
* Compliance with internal policies and audit standards
  

  
  

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

This role is based out of Noida**.**

**Purpose of the role**

To support business areas with day-to-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution.

**Accountabilities**

* Support various business areas with day-to-day initiatives including processing, reviewing, reporting, trading, and issue resolution.
* Collaboration with teams across the bank to align and integrate operational processes.
* Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations in operational processes.
* Development and implementation of operational procedures and controls to mitigate risks and maintain operational efficiency.
* Development of reports and presentations on operational performance and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in banking operations.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through operational excellence and customer service
* Perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard
* No people leadership roles at this grade.
* Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of team members.
* Identify escalation of policy breaches as required.
* Take responsibility for customer service and operational execution tasks.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Gain and maintain an understanding of own role, how the team integrates to achieve overall objectives, alongside knowledge of the work of other teams within the function.
* Work within well-defined procedures that may involve a variety of work routines.
* Demonstrate an understanding of the procedures.
* Evaluate and select the appropriate alternatives from defined options.
* Make judgements based on the analysis of factual information.
* Build relationships with stakeholders and customers to identify and address their needs, in support of a smooth operating process, handling sensitive issues as required.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.description:
Global Servicing (GS) oversees consumer travel and concierge experiences, all customer service functions supporting the company's global consumer, banking, merchant, and commercial customers, as well as the critical enablement capabilities that power our products and services. GS is committed to delivering the world's best customer experience every day by building on American Express's legacy of service excellence, leveraging innovative technologies to drive transformation, and bringing a human touch to every customer interaction.

We are seeking an innovative and forward-thinking **Digital Product Manager, Global Servicing Automation** to help transform how we work through automation, emerging technologies, and intelligent process design.

This role will serve as a Product Owner for Global Servicing Automation, supporting the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and delivery of capabilities that simplify operations, reduce manual effort, improve quality, and enhance customer and colleague experiences.

The successful candidate will bring a passion for innovation, strong product ownership skills, and a continuous improvement mindset. As an automation ambassador, they will develop expertise in enterprise automation platforms, including the Automation and Case Management Ecosystem (ACE), while exploring emerging AI and non-AI capabilities to identify scalable, reusable solutions.

This is an opportunity for a curious, independent thinker who challenges the status quo, thrives in ambiguity, and enjoys turning innovative ideas into meaningful business outcomes.

  

* 3+ years of relevant experience in digital product management, product ownership, automation, process improvement, customer servicing, technology, or related disciplines.
* Experience translating business requirements into product features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs.
* Working knowledge of Agile product development methodologies and experience partnering with business and technology teams to deliver solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and independently drive results.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and overcome barriers in a matrixed organization.
* Strong communication, organizational, and presentation skills with a high degree of initiative, ownership, and accountability.
* Passion for innovation, emerging technologies, automation, and challenging the status quo to improve how work gets done.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience serving as a Product Owner or Digital Product Manager supporting an enterprise technology platform.
* Experience implementing automation solutions, including workflow automation, case management, robotic process automation, or AI-enabled capabilities.
* Knowledge of customer servicing processes and experience in a large-scale contact center environment.
* Experience redesigning processes to improve efficiency, quality, and customer experience.
* Experience working in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience developing business cases, managing complex initiatives, or supporting Agile product delivery.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, or a related field; equivalent professional experience considered.  

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will be a trusted Product Owner and automation ambassador who brings innovative ideas to life, makes timely decisions, and works effectively across teams to deliver meaningful results.

They will help Global Servicing move beyond automating existing tasks to **reimagining how work gets done** —creating simpler, smarter, and more scalable processes that empower colleagues and elevate the customer experience.

From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

  

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives

**VP of Product, Tokenized Deposits**

Full-time

**About DCM**

DCM Corp Limited builds interbank infrastructure for tokenized deposits in emerging markets. Our entry point is the payment itself: ISO 20022-native messaging with tokenized settlement, running alongside banks' existing core systems rather than replacing them. Our technology already runs a national interbank payment network in production. DCM is the exclusive implementation provider of tokenized deposit solutions for the ADI Foundation, the Abu Dhabi-based foundation backed by IHC, bringing these solutions to banks across MENA and sub-Saharan Africa.

**The role**

You will own the product: strategy, roadmap, and the way we implement it with banks. You will build and lead the product function, working closely with the leadership team.

**What you will do**

* Own the roadmap for our two products: Side-core, a layer that runs alongside a bank's core, and PMP (Payment Messaging Processing), an ISO 20022-native messaging and settlement platform
* Watch the market and shape where the product goes next: regulation, competing platforms, bank demand, and initiatives like CBDC and interbank ledger projects
* Develop the product line beyond current deployments (new capabilities, new deployment models, new markets) with a clear case for each
* Decide what is standard product and what is customization, and hold that line with clients
* Define our standard implementation approach with banks, from first workshop to pilot to production
* Turn what we learn at each client into product, with one prioritized backlog across all projects
* Work with engineering and partners to deliver, and take responsibility for acceptance

**What you bring**

* Tokenized money shipped to production (tokenized deposits, stablecoins or DLT-based settlement) in a regulated setting
* A product delivered to banks or payment operators as clients: workshops, scoping, pilot, production, security reviews
* Strong command of payments infrastructure and ISO 20022
* A record of growing a product line: finding what the market needs next and shipping it, not only running an existing roadmap
* 12+ years of experience, at least 5 leading products for B2B infrastructure
* Experience owning a product when engineering sits in another organization
* Comfortable acting as solution architect on early client projects
* Fluent English; based in the UAE or willing to travel

**Nice to have**

* MENA or African market experience, Arabic
* Familiarity with interbank ledger initiatives (Swift, regional networks) and EVM chains
* Product experience under SOC 2 or ISO 27001/27017/27018
* Public speaking or published work on tokenization

**What we offer**

* Real ownership of the product of a company bringing tokenized deposits to banks in new markets
* A competitive package for a senior hire
* A seat in decisions about what we build and who we build it for.

This is a product leadership role, not simply a more senior Product Manager title. You'll own the Growth tribe, covering Onboarding and Payments, line manage the Onboarding and Payments Product Managers and report directly to the VP of Product.

The product team has moved to a tribe model, and this role creates the leadership layer each tribe needs. You'll own the tribe's strategy, outcomes and the quality of its product management, staying close enough to the work to challenge discovery, prioritisation and decisions, and making client onboarding and payments smooth, secure and efficient.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the Growth tribe's strategy, priorities and key outcomes across Onboarding and Payments.
* Line manage the Onboarding and Payments Product Managers, set expectations, coach them and keep the standard of their work high.
* Turn the wider product strategy into a clear vision and plan for the tribe, and evolve it as evidence and priorities change.
* Make sure the team talks to customers, uses internal insight and product analytics, and grounds its recommendations in evidence.
* Build a culture of hypothesis-led development and proportionate experimentation before committing significant engineering time.

* Lead the payments domain, including deposit and withdrawal journeys, PSP performance, routing, cascading and risk constraints.
* Work with Engineering, Business Analysis, UX/UI, Data, Operations, Compliance and Commercial to take validated ideas through delivery.
* Bring urgency and accountability: spot flat metrics or weak execution early, step in and keep senior stakeholders informed.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* A B2C product background. Candidates with a B2B product background will not be considered.
* Product leadership experience as a Group or Lead Product Manager, or as a Senior Product Manager already leading people and owning a wider product area.
* Genuine line management of Product Managers. This is not an individual contributor role.
* Payments experience is required: deposits and withdrawals, payment journeys, PSPs and gateways, routing, cascading, payment success and risk constraints.
* Strong onboarding, activation, conversion or other growth funnel experience.
* Specific examples of customer discovery, analytics, experimentation and measurable outcomes.
* The confidence to defend a product view with evidence in front of senior stakeholders.
* Retail FX or CFD trading experience is an asset but not essential. Strong backgrounds in fintech, payments, digital banking, wallets, crypto or iGaming are relevant.

**The Type of Person We're Looking For**

* A charismatic leader with strong stakeholder management skills.
* A strategic thinker who is still hands-on.

Prepare business and functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, process maps, wireframes and prototypes. Make sure onboarding changes are documented and approved through the bank's governance and change processes.

T

The
**Senior Product Manager – Consumer Products**

The role will lead product strategy, market research, proposition development, product launches, portfolio management, and continuous improvement. * Own the end to end product lifecycle from market research and business case development through launch, optimization, and product rationalization.
* Develop short, medium, and long term product roadmaps covering product features, digital journeys, underwriting, technology initiatives, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer research, segmentation, competitor analysis, and market reviews to identify new opportunities and enhance existing products.
* Define product propositions, pricing, features, eligibility criteria, and customer value propositions in line with market needs and business objectives.
* Monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, utilization, retention, revenue, profitability, and customer experience.

**Product Development & Digital Transformation**

* Define product requirements, customer journeys, business processes, and functional specifications in collaboration with Technology and Operations.

* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate product journeys, improve turnaround times, and enhance digital capabilities.
* Partner with Technology, Data, and Analytics teams to leverage automation, AI, and advanced analytics to improve product performance and customer outcomes.

**Commercial & Financial Management**

* Establish product level financial objectives and monitor revenue, costs, profitability, portfolio growth, and key performance indicators.
* Develop business cases and financial models for new products, product enhancements, pricing changes, campaigns, and strategic initiatives.
* Recommend pricing, fees, promotions, and product economics that balance customer value, competitiveness, risk, and profitability.
* Monitor product P&L and identify opportunities to improve portfolio contribution and sustainable returns.

**Credit, Risk & Governance**

* Partner with Credit Risk to define and optimize product eligibility, underwriting, credit policy, risk appetite, and decisioning requirements.
* Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency, approval rates, utilization, attrition, and other relevant risk and performance indicators.

* Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Distribution teams to develop product positioning, go to market strategies, campaigns, and customer acquisition initiatives.
* Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, activation, engagement, utilization, retention, cross sell, and customer lifetime value.
* Use customer insights, behavioural data, and portfolio analytics to identify opportunities for targeted propositions and improved customer experiences.
* Monitor campaign and proposition performance and recommend improvements based on measurable business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Operations, Risk, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, Legal, AML, Data & Analytics, Collections, Sales, and other stakeholders to deliver customer centric solutions.
* Build strong relationships across the organization and influence stakeholders to achieve product objectives.
* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned products, providing guidance on product strategy, proposition, economics, customer journeys, and portfolio performance.

**Knowledge & Skill Requirements**

* Strong expertise in consumer financial product management, particularly credit cards, personal loans, instalment products, and other consumer lending solutions.
* Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, including proposition development, acquisition, onboarding, activation, usage, retention, and portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit, underwriting, pricing, portfolio risk, and lending economics.
* Good knowledge of card issuing, card processing, payment schemes, digital lending, credit decisioning, and digital onboarding platforms.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and product performance analysis.
* Strong understanding of digital product development, customer experience, data analytics, AI, and automation.
* Strong analytical, project management, problem solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of the UAE consumer finance and regulatory environment, including relevant CBUAE requirements and applicable card scheme requirements.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
* Professional certification in Product Management, Agile, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience
* 10 to 12 years of progressive experience in product management within banking, consumer finance, fintech, payments, or related financial services.
* Strong experience managing consumer lending and/or card products across the complete product lifecycle.
* Proven track record of developing and launching products, enhancing existing propositions, and delivering measurable improvements in revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, or portfolio performance.
* Demonstrated experience in product strategy, roadmap development, pricing, business case development, and product performance management.
* Experience leading digital transformation initiatives involving digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, automation, or customer experience enhancement.
* Experience working cross functionally with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other control functions.
* Experience working within a regulated financial services environment, preferably within the UAE or GCC.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Visa is evolving its consumer-facing platforms to create stronger customer value propositions, enable new product solutions, and support sustainable growth across CEMEA.

* Ability to translate strategy into execution, converting recommendations into product roadmaps, business requirements and implementation priorities.
* Strong analytical capabilities, including market sizing, financial modelling, performance analysis, scenario development and synthesis of complex data into actionable insights.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics, develop high-quality decision materials and influence senior stakeholders across matrixed, multicultural organizations.

You will lead a dedicated team focused only on P2P and local transfers and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, data, marketing, legal, compliance and our banking partners to deliver a seamless and scalable experience in the UAE and KSA.
  
  
What you will be doing
  
  

* Own the strategy and roadmap for money moving between people inside the country: P2P between wallets, local bank transfers and instant payments.
* Launch new local payment rails and partner integrations end to end, from discovery and regulatory requirements to scale.
* Invent creative, viral social money mechanics that people love to use and share: request money, split the bill, QR, payment links and sending to people who don't have a wallet yet.
* Grow the network by turning millions of Tabby app users into active senders and recipients.
* Work closely with legal, compliance, risk and core banking teams so products meet local regulations and security standards without killing innovation, because we are about balance.
* Lead the launch of local transfers in KSA together with local partners.
* Shape how the team works together with the Team Lead: planning, rituals and a predictable delivery cadence.
* Set and track KPIs (senders, transfer frequency, recipients per user, retention) and run experiments to move them.
* Keep an ear to the ground on market trends, user behaviour and best-in-class P2P products to keep us ahead of the game.
* Plan launches with marketing and communications teams to ensure clear messaging and user adoption.

What you will need
  
  

* UAE residence or ready for relocation
* 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager with hands-on expertise in P2P payments, wallets, instant payments or mobile banking
* Proven track record of launching and growing consumer payment products with measurable results
* Experience delivering products with banks, payment rails or other regulated partners
* Resilience and ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment
* Fluency in English

**Benefits**

* Ownership & Impact: A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* Culture: Collaborative, inclusive, and driven environment where your voice matters.
* Flexibility: Enjoy flexible working hours designed to optimize productivity and balance.
* Growth: Participate in the company’s employee stock options program and shape your career trajectory.
* Support: Comprehensive health insurance, generous PTO and a Flexible Benefits budget to meet your personal needs.

We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals (whatever they may be).
  
  
If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you!

We offer a truly great place to work - but don’t take our word for it, our own team have said the following:

jobs.description:
**Key Accountabilities**

* Audit planning and governance
  + Establish and maintain the Internal Audit Charter, audit methodology and risk-based annual audit plan for Board/Audit Committee approval.
  + Maintain an audit universe covering all licensed activities, corporate functions, systems and material third-party arrangements.
  + Coordinate with du Group Audit on methodologies, specialist support and assurance coverage while maintaining accountability to du Pay’s Board.
  + Identify resource and specialist requirements, including technology, cybersecurity and financial crime expertise.
* Operational and regulatory assurance
  + Audit wallet operations, payments, cards, digital remittances, finance, treasury, settlement and customer service.
  + Assess customer fund safeguarding, float management, reconciliations, liquidity, applicable capital and guarantee requirements, and regulatory reporting.
  + Independently assess AML/CFT, sanctions screening, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring and suspicious reporting controls.
  + Review consumer protection, customer disclosures, complaints handling, fraud controls and compliance with licence conditions.
  + Assess technology governance, cybersecurity, access management, data protection, outsourcing, business continuity and disaster recovery.
* Partner products and distribution
  + Audit governance and controls supporting lending, investment and insurance partnerships.
  + Review partner due diligence, contractual responsibilities, regulatory permissions, service standards, audit rights and ongoing oversight.
  + Assess customer journeys, disclosures, consent, fees, commissions, complaints ownership and escalation arrangements.
  + Examine controls over relevant money flows, including loan disbursements and repayments, investment subscriptions and withdrawals, and insurance premiums and refunds.
  + Evaluate whether du Pay’s activities remain within its permitted role and whether responsibilities between du Pay and each partner are clearly allocated.
  + Provide independent observations on material launches and changes without assuming management responsibility for product approval or control design.
* Reporting and remediation
  + Issue clear audit reports identifying findings, root causes, risk implications and practical recommendations.
  + Present significant findings and emerging risks to the Board/Audit Committee and management.
  + Track agreed actions and independently validate remediation before closing findings.
  + Escalate overdue material issues, restrictions on audit access and threats to independence.
  + Support regulatory examinations and external audits with appropriate evidence and coordination.
Authority and independence
The Internal Audit Manager will have unrestricted access to relevant employees, records, systems and governance forums, together with direct access to the Board/Audit Committee. The position will remain independent of operational activities, compliance monitoring and risk ownership.  

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business, information systems or a related discipline.
* CIA, ACA, ACCA, CPA or an equivalent professional qualification; CISA is an advantage.
* Typically, 8–12 years of relevant audit experience, including responsibility for financial services audits.
* Strong UAE experience in fintech, payments, banking, remittances or exchange business.
* Knowledge of CBUAE requirements relevant to SVF, RPSCS and digital remittances.
Experience auditing technology, AML/CFT, safeguarding and outsourced or partner-delivered services.  

Skills

* Strong analytical judgement.
* Professional integrity.
* Board-level communication skills.
* Ability to satisfy applicable regulatory fitness, propriety and appointment requirements.

jobs.description:
**Principal Investor Relations Officer**

**Job #:**

req39473

  

**Organization:**

IFC

GH

Open-Ended Staff (OPEN-OP)

Sao Paulo, Brazil; Dubai, United Arab Emirates; Hong Kong, China; Frankfurt, Germany; Paris, France; Mumbai, India; Tokyo, Japan; Mexico City, Mexico; or Johannesburg, South Africa

  

**Required Language(s):**

English

  

**Preferred Language(s):**

Relevant local language required (French, Spanish, German, Cantonese/Mandarin, Japanese, Portuguese, Hindi)

  

**Closing Date:**

11/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

* Risk and control: Comply with applicable Credit, Compliance, AML, sanctions, fraud, operational-risk, conduct, data-privacy and information-security requirements; identify and escalate exceptions, control issues and client concerns promptly.
* Market and product insight: Monitor sector developments, competitor activity and client trends; share practical insights and identify opportunities for new products, improved structures and better client journeys.
Process improvement and learning: Build strong technical and sector knowledge, support improvements to workflows and reporting, and complete required learning, coaching and on-the-job development activities.

The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.
* Client orientation: Professional, responsive and service-focused, with the confidence to support client meetings and follow through with reliably on commitments.

* Digital and systems capability: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to learn CRM, workflow, digital-banking, pipeline and reporting systems. The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.
* Curious, accountable, adaptable and commercially minded, with a willingness to learn and operate under pressure while maintaining strong conduct and control standards.
* Must be a strong team player who is eager to learn and has good communication skills.
Must be organized, reliable, and able to work under a manager's guidance.  

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Experience: Graduate or early career profile; 0-2 years of relevant experience in banking, transaction banking, client service, sales support, operations or a related area is preferred.
* Arabic capability is advantageous.

  

About Us

**About Us:**

  

First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) is the largest bank in the UAE and one of the world's largest and safest financial institutions. We offer a comprehensive range of personal and private banking services, including credit cards, Islamic banking, investments, loans, and mortgages. Our commitment to excellence and innovation drives us to provide top-tier financial solutions to our clients.

  

**Life at FAB:**

  

Working at FAB means being part of a team of talented and passionate individuals with a shared vision to support the ambitions of our stakeholders to "Grow Stronger." We embrace the needs of our customers across the globe with a sense of responsibility and confidence driven by extensive expertise that can only be delivered by an ambitious world-class organization

  

**Career Development:**

  

FAB offers unique career choices, a chance to innovate, craft solutions for the future, and express yourself in a performance-based culture that will unleash the best in you. Whether you are an experienced professional or just starting your career, FAB provides a range of learning and development initiatives to support all employees through training and skill development.

  

**Our Values:**

  

At FAB, we place our customers at the core of our activities, live our values each day in every way, celebrate achievements, and empower each other to deliver leading solutions. We have structured plans for the recruitment and career progression of Emirati talent to enable them to make a mark in the financial and banking sector both regionally and globaly that rewards your hard work and dedication.

  

Join our team and be part of a journey to shape the future of banking.

### **Requirements**

Analytical mindset with proficiency in data tools (Excel, SQL, SAS, etc.).

Excellent communication and project management skills.
