**Description**

At the International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

Private sector financial development is essential to the promotion of successful and sustainable economies in low- and middle-income countries around the world. Infrastructure plays a key role in sustained economic growth by providing critical public services to the citizens in a country as well as a platform for efficient operation of businesses that create jobs. The private sector plays an increasingly important role in the financing and delivery of infrastructure and public services, including through Corporate Finance Services.

IFC’s transaction advisory services department (CTA) is housed in the World Bank Group’s Client’s and Products Vice Presidency (CCPVP) and consists of two business lines:

* PPP Transaction Advisory (C3P) offers transaction advisory services to governments design, structure PPP transactions in infrastructure to help client governments partner with the private sector to deliver affordable and high-quality infrastructure.
* Corporate Finance Services (CFS) has three key product offerings: (1) M&A Advisory: supporting investment departments in business development and creating investment opportunities; (2) Equity Mobilization Program (EMP): supporting third party equity mobilization alongside IFC investment; (3) Asset monetization involving listed or listing public entities.

CTA has mobilized $6.6B for FY25 which translates into around 17% of IFC’s total core mobilization, of which CFS mobilized over $1.5B of this amount. The department is expected to continue playing a leading role in mobilizing private capital for the WBG.

CFS is seeking a (Senior) Investment Officer with strong M&A experience to help support the execution of our business strategy in the Middle East, Turkey and Central Asia Region. The position will be based in Dubai, UAE and will report to the Global Manager, CFS. The (Senior) Investment Officer will support the CFS regional teams with global capacity, with the objective of facilitating business development and executing transactions

**Duties and accountabilities:**

* Contribute to the development and implementation of CFS’s strategy, working closely with regional and World Bank Group teams to advance business priorities and support delivery against WBG strategic objectives, with a particular focus on the MCA region.
* Collaborating with regional leads to originate, structure, and execute EMP and M&A advisory mandates across the MCA region, including buy-side and sell-side transactions, restructuring advisory, and EMP services.
* Lead the origination and execution of strategic pre-IPO advisory mandates across the five regions, working closely with relevant regional, industry, and advisory teams.
* Advise clients on listing readiness, process, timing, and regulatory considerations, including the assessment of corporate and balance sheet structures, valuation and business plans; development of listing roadmaps and timetables; broker selection and prospectus review; preparation of management teams and Boards for listing; and coordination with relevant corporate governance advisory teams, as appropriate.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with regional and industry counterparts, identifying opportunities for collaboration that strengthen business development, enhance transaction delivery, and support IFC’s corporate and regional objectives.
* Develop and manage strong client relationships, working closely with multi-regional clients and relevant IFC teams to develop transaction strategies and provide advice on bankability, funding feasibility, financial modeling, business planning, and restructuring.
* Provide senior-level oversight and guidance on the preparation of key transaction materials and project documentation, including transaction marketing materials, information memoranda, due diligence and transaction structuring reports, and transaction contracts and agreements, ensuring high-quality analytical and transaction outputs.
* Mentor and support junior colleagues, providing guidance on transaction execution, client engagement, and business development, and helping strengthen team capabilities and delivery against business objectives.
* Contribute to strengthening IFC’s positioning and visibility in the CFS space, leveraging IFC’s regional presence, client relationships, and broader communications strategy to support market development and business origination.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or another relevant field, with at least 8 years of relevant professional experience, preferably 12 or more years of experience in investment banking, corporate finance, M&A advisory, or other relevant areas.
* Seasoned in equity transactions, as a principal investor, an advisor, or underwriter, including in an investment bank, VC, PE type institution.
* Transaction advisory experience in buy side mandates, sell side mandates, restructuring mandates, preferably in the disruptive technology space.
* Track record of delivering targeted results on M&A, Restructuring and IPO mandates under stressful timetables and environment.
* Proven success in developing strong client relationships and executing mandates across-borders and in difficult environments.
* Experience taking companies public on major international stock exchanges such as the New York stock exchange, London Stock exchange etc, is plus.
* Strong track record of business delivery, demonstrated investment experience, superior business judgment and established professional credibility.
* Excellent team player and demonstrated ability to work effectively with a dispersed team in a dynamic and multicultural environment.
* Ability to work collaboratively with superior facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong written and verbal communications skills. English is mandatory, and Arabic and/or Russian would be an asset
* Ability to represent IFC externally and to develop and manage relationships with clients, media, donors, and other stakeholders.
* Ability to use commercially available LLM tools like Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot for research, analysis, and drafting in investment, validate outputs against primary sources, and remain accountable for recommendations
* Commitment to development and alignment with the World Bank Group and IFC's mission, strategy, and values.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience work

jobs.title: Technology - Application Development, Full Time Analyst, Bahrain - Seef 2027
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**You are the brain behind our work …**

At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Full Time Technology Analyst Program is where forward-thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact on the most global financial institution!

Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.

**We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…**

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The 2-year Analyst Program starts in July and begins with a robust training program. Here at Citi, rotational programs are intended to help you build a broad skillset and accelerate your career growth by gaining exposure to more than one team. Our rotational program will help you discover the best fit for your skills and long-term career goals at Citi.

**Your time here will look like this...**

You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.

  
  

While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:

* **Back-End Development:** Java, Python, Spring Framework
* **Front-End Development:** Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)
* **Generative AI & AI Agents****:** GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
* **Data Analytics:** Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.
  

  

No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:

* **Global Exposure**: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.

* **Continuous Learning:** Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.

* **Real Impact**: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.

**To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria:**

* Graduation between Dec 2026 and July 2027.

* Educational background: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.

* A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.

* Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.

* Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.

* Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.

* Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.

* Work Authorization: Authorized to work in Bahrain without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

**Who we think will be a great fit...**

A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.

This program is ideal for those who:

* Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.

* Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.

  

-

---------------------

Management Development Programs

-

**Job Family:**
---------------

Undergraduate

-

**Time Type:**
--------------

Full time

-

**Most Relevant Skills**
------------------------

Please see the requirements listed above.

-

**Other Relevant Skills**
-------------------------

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

-

The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.About the RoleThis PM and Market Leader of India will oversee the newly announced pillar for WhatsApp, treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks, and build as we go. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live in India since 2020 and growing; the existing WhatsApp payments team moves across as the pillar's foundation.As a Product Leader at WhatsApp, you will use your experience building products from early concept through launch in fast-moving environments and your full range of product development skills to produce intuitive, user-friendly features. You’ll be expected to push the boundaries of what’s possible in a mobile app, while sharing in our commitment to quality and attention to detail. This is a role for someone who can hold both the ceiling and the floor: sets an ambitious long-term vision for what WhatsApp can become in India.
  
  
Director, Product Management - WhatsApp India Responsibilities:
  
  

* Drive product strategy and development for one of the highest-priority initiatives across WhatsApp and Meta
* Establish a shared vision across the company (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger) and ensure that all teams are clear on the overall strategy, the problem to be solved, timeline, and required contributions
* Ability to move fast to drive alignment and execution – Turn high volumes of different actions into repeatable processes and playbooks, and get alignment within and across teams through both influence and framing clear escalations when team priorities conflict
* Manage multiple products and priorities, scale teams, and ensure org is effective, healthy and set up for success by establishing clear and measurable goals – Collaborate, navigate and influence product teams across WhatsApp
* Consumer, Business, Privacy, Growth and Messaging Services, and the broader Meta organization (including Instagram and Facebook)
* Drive executional excellence and analytical rigor across teams – Drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions to reduce operational overhead, streamline decision-making and accelerate overall execution
* Manage business reviews (i.e., weekly/monthly business reviews, functional reviews, and other key meetings), staff meetings, and all hands meetings
* Lead reviews of dashboards and reports for stakeholders and team members to drive transparency and track improvements
* Proactively identify issues and needs, escalate as needed, and devise processes to resolve them
* Coordinate working groups for areas of ownership that we need to establish, but which cut across organizational lines
* At times, you may be specifically tasked to own a workstream, or to dive deep into different parts of the organization
* Lead org-wide projects to create business value, aligning multiple stakeholders across Meta, including various product teams, go-to-market, Finance, Operations, Research, and Family of Apps

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* 15+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years leading PM teams (managing managers)
* Strong technical judgment and ability to partner with ML/ranking teams on signal quality, bidding systems, and delivery optimization
* Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of bets at different maturity stages — from 0-to-1 incubation to billion-dollar scaled products — simultaneously
* Exceptional cross-functional leadership: ability to drive alignment across engineering, data science, design, sales, partnerships, and policy
* Experience applying analytical rigor and data-driven decision-making, including defining and optimizing product metrics and data-driven decision-making, with experience in defining and optimizing metrics

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* B.A. or B.S. in Computer Science or a related field (Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Business)
* Experience in building and scaling early-stage growth efforts
* Proficiency in using AI tools as part of day-to-day product development and general productivity workflow
* Track record of successfully executing the strategy in the APAC region
* Experience working with payment infrastructure in emerging markets

About Meta:
  
  
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

Compiles and evaluates research on the market's product requirements and identifies enhancements to current features and functionality. Establishes marketing strategies, including product direction, advertising, packaging, pricing, expense budgets, profit plans and future product development, to manage a product or product category's life cycle. Interfaces with engineers, designers, suppliers and customers to develop product requirements and specifications. Prepares and coordinates product introductions and updates.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Electronics Solutions division of Nordson delivers cutting-edge engineering and applications excellence to the world’s semiconductor, automotive electronics, printed circuit boards and precision assembly manufacturer with innovative fluid dispensing and surface treatment solutions. As part of the Growth and Strategy group for this $250M++ division, the Technical Product Manager (TPM) is responsible for the development, and performance of a product line.
  
  
The TPM oversee the product’s lifecycle, from conception (working with Market Manager and New Product Development Engineering) to discontinuation. This may include supervising Product Line Specialists who are located in the factory/manufacturing sites where the product is made. The TPM provides leadership within the organization to ensure competitiveness of assigned products and development of strategies to grow revenue profitably.

* Using the NBS Next Phase Gate process in the development of new products, provide leadership in Phases 0-2 i.e. #0 Project Request; #1 Planning/Feasibility; #2 Proj Requirements where clear technical and commercial requirements are articulated and documented for NPD Engineering.

* Lead cross-functional efforts for creating competitive offerings.
* Maintain and communicate internally the competitive landscape of our market/products

+ Build internal knowledge of the competitive landscape by supporting MEKKO updates.
+ Develop and maintain tools/processes to collect the latest competitive information and analyzing data to advise on pricing, strategies, future opportunities, etc.
+ Produces competitive analysis materials comparing product with its key competitors for features and pricing in different geographies
+ Lead quarterly competitive reviews/updates
+ Participates in development of market share assessment and price/performance positioning as needed for existing and new products

* Monitor customer satisfaction and contribute to Operations/Sustaining Continuous Improvement projects, Quality and Cost of Poor Quality programs, etc.

We are seeking an experienced product leader to drive the strategy and development of technology-enabled learning products. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the individual will translate insights into scalable, user-centric products that improve learning experiences and outcomes.

* Define experience principles, product flows and interaction requirements across digital platforms and supporting touchpoints.

* Work with Programme, Product Operations, Analytics and Knowledge Management teams to assess and validate innovations.

* Monitor product health indicators and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

* Build strong working relationships with cross-functional teams, senior stakeholders and external partners.
* Facilitate collaboration between Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics and Programme teams.
* Drive clarity, accountability and alignment in complex and evolving product environments.

* Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
* Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission

**Bengaluru**

Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

* Prepare capex and investment evaluation models (ROI, payback, IRR) to support management decisions.

Working Capital, Treasury & Banking Oversight

* Support negotiation of borrowing costs, banking terms and insurance with banks and financial institutions.

Tax, Statutory Compliance & Governance

* Coordinate with tax advisors on assessments, notices, transfer pricing and tax planning.
* Prepare Board packs and support Board/committee meetings and secretarial requirements.

  

Internal Controls & Risk Management

* Strengthen spend controls, contract compliance tracking and recovery of claims/liquidated damages from vendors and customers.
* Identify financial and operational risks and recommend corrective actions to leadership.

  

Investor Reporting, Fundraising & Transactions

* Own investor reporting, MIS packs and compliance with shareholder agreement covenants.
* Lead finance workstreams for fundraising, due diligence, valuation queries and data rooms.
* Support M&A, restructuring or entity consolidation from a finance and reporting perspective.

  

Team Leadership, Systems & Process Building

* Build, lead and mentor a high-performing finance & accounts team across locations.
* Design finance SOPs and policies suitable for a fast-scaling organization.
* Drive ERP implementation/optimization, automation and real-time dashboards for leadership visibility.
* Compress closure and MIS timelines through process standardization and automation.

* Strong command of Ind AS; exposure to IFRS / US GAAP is a plus.
* Hands-on experience in financial closure, consolidation and audit management.
* Proven FP&A, budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling skills.
* Sound knowledge of Indian direct and indirect taxation, Companies Act and FEMA.
* Working knowledge of working capital management, banking and trade finance.
* Experience with ERP systems (SAP / ZOHO) and advanced MS Excel; BI dashboard tools a plus.

* Experience in manufacturing, textiles, export-import or capital-intensive industries preferred.
* Exposure to fundraising, investor due diligence or M&A transactions is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Business Finance Manager
jobs.description:
**Role:**

We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant to lead Business Finance (FP&A and Commercial Finance) at Whizzo Textiles, a fast-growing Series A startup in B2B technical textiles with cross-border operations and high working capital cycles. Reporting to the Founders/CFO, the role will own business planning, budgeting and forecasting, management reporting, unit economics and commercial decision support, acting as a strategic finance partner to sales, operations, supply chain and leadership.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

Business Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

* Lead the annual operating plan (AOP), monthly rolling forecasts and long-range (3-5 year) business plans.
* Build and maintain the company's financial model covering revenue, margins, opex, capex, cash flow and funding needs.
* Set budgets with business heads and track actuals vs budget/forecast with clear variance explanations.
* Run scenario and sensitivity analysis on raw material prices, FX, volumes and capacity utilization.

  

Management Reporting & Performance Analysis

* Own monthly MIS and leadership dashboards covering P&L, cash flow, working capital and key business KPIs.
* Analyse business performance by product, customer, geography and plant; highlight risks and opportunities.
* Prepare monthly business review packs for leadership and inputs for Board and investor presentations.
* Define and track KPIs such as gross margin, contribution margin, EBITDA, cash burn and cash conversion cycle.

  

Commercial Finance & Unit Economics

* Build product-wise and customer-wise profitability and unit economics models.
* Support pricing decisions, quotations and contract evaluation, including raw material and FX cost pass-through.
* Evaluate new customers, markets and product lines from a margin, credit and working capital perspective.
* Track contract terms, price revisions and recovery of cost escalations from customers.

  

Cost Management & Capital Allocation

* Drive cost optimization and procurement savings initiatives with operations and supply chain.
* Build standard costing and analyze production cost variances (material, conversion, yield, wastage).
* Evaluate capex and capacity expansion proposals using ROI, payback and IRR, and track post-investment performance.

  

Working Capital & Cash Planning

* Forecast working capital needs across inventory, receivables and payables in line with business growth.
* Partner with the Treasury & Banking team on cash flow forecasts, funding requirements and banking limits.
* Monitor DSO, DIO and DPO and drive initiatives to shorten the cash conversion cycle.

  

Fundraising & Strategic Support

* Support fundraising with business plans, investor models, data rooms and due diligence queries.
* Provide financial analysis for strategic initiatives such as new plants, partnerships or acquisitions.

  

Process Building & Automation

* Design the planning and reporting calendar, templates and SOPs for a fast-scaling organization.
* Drive automation of MIS and dashboards using ERP and BI tools; reduce manual reporting effort.
* Mentor and develop junior team members in FP&A and business analysis.

  
  

**Skills & Competencies required:**

* Strong financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis skills.
* Good understanding of accounting principles, financial statements and manufacturing cost structures.
* Commercial acumen with the ability to turn numbers into clear business recommendations.
* Advanced MS Excel and PowerPoint; experience with ERP systems and BI tools (Power BI / Tableau) is a plus.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with business heads and leadership.
* High ownership, attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment.

  
  

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA); MBA Finance / CFA is an added advantage.
* 4- 6 years of post-qualification experience in FP&A, business finance or commercial finance.
* Experience in manufacturing, textiles or export-import industries preferred.
* Startup or high-growth company experience is a strong plus.
* Exposure to fundraising, investor reporting or Board presentations is a plus.

  
  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPI):**

* Timely and accurate AOP, forecasts and monthly MIS as per the reporting calendar.
* Forecast accuracy (actuals vs forecast variance within 5%).
* Quality and actionability of business insights and recommendations to leadership.
* Gross margin and contribution margin improvement through pricing and cost initiatives.
* Improvement in working capital cycle (DSO, DIO, DPO).
* Cost savings delivered through cost optimization initiatives.
* Automation of MIS and dashboards and reduction in reporting turnaround time.

jobs.title: Head of Technology / VP Engineering
jobs.description:
**Hiring: Head of Technology / VP Engineering**

**Company:**
KGIL Fintech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (SwipeLoan)

**Location:**
Hinjawadi, Pune | Work from Office

**Experience:**
10–15+ years in Technology, Software Engineering, Architecture and Engineering Leadership

**CTC:**
₹18–24 LPA, depending on experience and technical expertise

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**About KGIL**

KGIL is building a diversified technology ecosystem with products spanning fintech, digital lending, credit solutions and emerging consumer internet businesses.

Through SwipeLoan and our expanding portfolio of digital platforms, we aim to develop and scale technology-driven businesses across multiple industries.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on technology leader with
**CTO-level capabilities**
who can take complete ownership of technology strategy, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity and product development across our growing ecosystem.

This is not a conventional IT management role.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently evaluating new business concepts, selecting appropriate technology stacks, designing scalable systems, building engineering teams and delivering end-to-end technology solutions.

We are looking for a technology generalist with deep engineering expertise who is comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, architectures and business domains.

The candidate should have the technical judgment and leadership ability to build products using both existing and emerging technologies, without being restricted to any single programming language or framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Technology Ownership**

* Own the complete technology function across existing and future KGIL platforms.
* Define long-term technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering roadmaps.
* Independently translate business ideas into technical requirements, architecture and execution plans.
* Take responsibility for technology decisions from product conceptualisation to development, deployment, scaling and maintenance.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the Founder & CEO.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, development timelines, resource requirements and infrastructure costs for new businesses.
* Ensure all platforms are secure, scalable, reliable and commercially efficient.

**2. Multi-Technology & Full-Stack Engineering Leadership**

Lead engineering across multiple technology stacks, including but not limited to:

* **Backend:**
  PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Python, Django, FastAPI, Java, Spring Boot, Go and other relevant technologies.
* **Frontend:**
  React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and modern frontend frameworks.
* **Mobile Applications:**
  Flutter, React Native, native Android and iOS development.
* **Databases:**
  MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and other SQL/NoSQL technologies.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  AWS, cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless systems and CI/CD.
* **Integrations:**
  REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, third-party APIs, payment gateways and external services.
* **AI & Automation:**
  AI/ML integrations, LLM-based applications, intelligent automation and data-driven product capabilities.

The candidate is not expected to write production code in every language personally but must possess sufficient architectural and technical depth to evaluate, guide and manage engineering teams working across different technology stacks.

**3. New Product Development & Technology Expansion**

* Lead technology development for new businesses across fintech and non-fintech industries.
* Evaluate new product ideas and recommend the most suitable technology stack for each business.
* Design and deliver MVPs, scalable applications and enterprise-grade platforms.
* Lead development of consumer applications, marketplaces, subscription platforms, SaaS products, social networking applications and e-commerce solutions.
* Build reusable technology components, shared services and APIs wherever commercially appropriate.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, third-party platforms and outsourcing opportunities.
* Ensure new product launches meet defined timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Support rapid experimentation, prototyping and product-market validation.

**4. Technology Architecture & Scalability**

* Design scalable, secure and high-performance application architectures.
* Make informed decisions between monolithic, modular and microservices architectures.
* Establish standards for API design, database architecture, system integrations and data management.
* Implement performance optimisation, caching, monitoring and system observability.
* Plan infrastructure capacity for high-volume applications and rapid user growth.
* Ensure appropriate system resilience, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements.
* Identify and resolve technical debt and architectural limitations.

**5. Engineering Team Leadership & Recruitment**

* Lead existing backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps and AI/ML teams.
* Independently recruit developers, architects and technical specialists based on business requirements.
* Build and manage multiple engineering teams working on different products simultaneously.
* Establish clear reporting structures, engineering ownership and accountability.
* Define development standards, code review processes and technical documentation requirements.
* Conduct technical interviews and assess candidate capabilities across different technology stacks.
* Mentor engineering leads and develop future technology leaders.
* Manage internal development teams, freelancers, technology vendors and outsourced partners.

**6. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Cybersecurity**

* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, production environments and system monitoring.
* Manage AWS infrastructure and evaluate alternative cloud services where appropriate.
* Establish robust CI/CD, release management and automated testing processes.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, access controls and secure development practices.
* Oversee incident response, disaster recovery and infrastructure reliability.
* Coordinate technical security requirements relating to ISO 27001, applicable data protection laws and regulatory obligations.
* Ensure company-controlled access to source code, repositories, servers, cloud accounts and technology assets.
* Monitor infrastructure expenditure and implement cost optimisation initiatives.

**7. Fintech & Third-Party Integrations**

* Oversee technology integrations with banks, NBFCs, credit bureaus, KYC providers, Account Aggregators, payment gateways and other financial technology service providers.
* Ensure reliability, security and performance of partner APIs.
* Support lending journeys, credit eligibility systems, subscription payments and automated financial workflows.
* Coordinate with business and compliance teams on technology-related regulatory requirements.

**8. Product, Business & Leadership Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Founder & CEO to evaluate and execute new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Finance, Business Development and Operations teams.
* Provide technical recommendations in business planning and strategic discussions.
* Prepare technology budgets, development roadmaps and resource allocation plans.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies and investment requirements clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Take independent ownership of technical execution while keeping management informed of major decisions.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Mandatory**

* 10–15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 4–5 years in engineering leadership or architecture roles.
* Strong hands-on software engineering background with experience designing and scaling production app

**About the Role**

KGIL Fintech Solutions is looking for an experienced lending professional to establish and lead our First Loss Default Guarantee (FLDG/DLG) business vertical.

The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying and onboarding lending partners, structuring commercially viable FLDG arrangements, managing portfolio performance, building operational processes and scaling the business independently.

We are looking for someone with strong relationships across banks, NBFCs, fintech companies and lending institutions, combined with practical experience in credit risk, lending operations and portfolio management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. FLDG Business Development**

* Establish and independently scale the FLDG business vertical.
* Identify banks and NBFCs interested in eligible DLG-supported lending arrangements.
* Develop new lending products and commercial opportunities.
* Negotiate partnership agreements and commercial structures.
* Build a sustainable and profitable lending portfolio.

**2. Strategic Lending Partnerships**

* Establish relationships with senior decision-makers across banks and NBFCs.
* Maintain relationships with existing lending institutions.
* Identify additional opportunities in digital lending, loan distribution and co-lending arrangements where applicable.

* Support business continuity across lending partnership channels when required.

**3. End-to-End FLDG Operations**

* Coordinate partner onboarding, underwriting criteria and credit policies.
* Oversee loan sourcing, disbursement coordination and portfolio monitoring.
* Work with regulated lending partners on approved DLG structures.
* Monitor portfolio performance, delinquency, defaults and guarantee utilisation.
* Coordinate reconciliation, claims, collections reporting and settlements with relevant teams.
* Develop operational SOPs and reporting dashboards.

**4. Risk & Portfolio Management**

* Analyse portfolio-level credit risk and profitability.
* Track delinquency buckets, vintage performance and loss trends.
* Recommend appropriate risk controls and portfolio eligibility criteria.
* Coordinate with lending partners' credit and risk teams.
* Ensure the business operates within approved risk limits.

**5. Team Building**

* Recruit and lead a dedicated FLDG business team.
* Build capabilities in alliances, lending operations and portfolio MIS.
* Establish department-level targets and reporting systems.

* Ensure FLDG arrangements comply with applicable RBI digital lending requirements.
* Coordinate agreement execution with Legal and Compliance.
* Maintain complete portfolio records, lender reconciliations and supporting documentation.
* Ensure clear accountability for guarantees, commercial obligations and portfolio performance.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 10–15 years of experience in NBFCs, banks, fintech or digital lending.
* Direct experience managing FLDG/DLG arrangements or credit-risk-sharing programmes.
* Strong existing relationships with banks and NBFCs.
* Knowledge of unsecured personal loans, business loans and digital lending.
* Understanding of credit underwriting, portfolio risk, collections and lending operations.
* Proven experience negotiating commercial lending partnerships.
* Ability to independently establish and manage a business vertical.
* Strong leadership, analytical and execution capabilities.

**Preferred Background**

Candidates currently working as AVP, VP, Business Head, Lending Partnerships Head, FLDG Head or Credit Partnerships Head in an NBFC, bank, fintech or lending platform.

**Our expectation:**
An entrepreneurial business leader who can establish a new lending vertical, generate sustainable revenue, manage risk and build a strong team from the ground up.

jobs.title: Head of Product – Distribution & Revenue Generation
jobs.description:
**Overview**

The Head of Product, Distribution & Revenue Generation is a senior product leadership role responsible for the strategy and delivery of Access Hospitality's distribution and revenue-generation capability across the APAC region – spanning Channel Management, Booking Engine, Rate Shopping, Connectivity, Revenue Management Systems, Review Management and Digital Marketing Services. This role succeeds Gavin Jeddo, Founder of STAAH, and carries the responsibility of preserving and extending the credibility STAAH has built with OTA, channel and technology partners across the region while integrating the product into Access's broader Accommodation platform strategy.

Reporting to the MD, India / Hospitality Capability Centre with a dotted line into the Head of Product, Accommodation (UK), this leader owns the regional distribution and revenue product roadmap and is the primary internal and external voice for how independent hotels and hotel chains in APAC drive bookings, optimise rate and channel mix, and reduce dependency on costly OTA distribution. The role sits within Access's Federated Product, Shared Capability operating model – balancing HCC and regional market/partner depth with alignment to the global Accommodation platform and the 2027 AI-native migration priority. The role is based in Pune and will work closely with product engineering leadership based across Pune, UK, US and NZ, with some travel required.

The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on accommodation-technology domain expertise – built inside an OTA, PMS company, channel manager, revenue management system or adjacent part of the accommodation technology stack – combined with the commercial instincts to connect product decisions directly to distribution cost, direct booking share and revenue outcomes for customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Distribution & Revenue Product Strategy**

* Own the regional product vision, strategy and roadmap for Channel Management, Booking Engine, Rate Shopping, Connectivity and Revenue Management Systems, aligned to APAC commercial priorities and the global Accommodation platform direction
* Define a coherent distribution and revenue product architecture that enhances our customers positioning whilst maximising visibility and yield across the channels that matter in APAC markets
* Set prioritisation frameworks that balance direct booking growth, channel partner breadth, rate/revenue optimisation and customer retention
* Lead product investment decisions in partnership with engineering and finance, grounded in commercial impact – distribution cost reduction, RevPAR/ADR uplift and channel yield
* Monitor the competitive OTA, channel management and revenue management landscape across APAC (including region-specific players and metasearch/OTA dynamics) to continuously sharpen product positioning

**AI-Native Distribution & Revenue Capabilities**

* Lead the product strategy for AI-native and agentic capability within the distribution and revenue suite – including automated rate optimisation, dynamic pricing recommendations, AI-assisted channel mix decisioning and automated review response
* Embed AI across the product suite where it demonstrably improves revenue or reduces manual effort – intelligent rate shopping insights, forecasting-driven pricing, and automation of routine channel and connectivity management tasks
* Work with engineering leadership to ensure AI/agentic features sit on a scalable, interoperable data foundation and connect cleanly into the global Accommodation platform migration
* Define packaging, pricing and migration pathways so customers can adopt new distribution and revenue capability with confidence

**Commercial & Customer Outcomes**

* Partner with the GM APAC, the Head of Product UK, Head of Engineering APAC and regional commercial leadership to ensure the roadmap directly supports direct booking mix growth, distribution cost reduction and NRR/GRR performance
* Own product-led metrics including channel adoption, connectivity partner coverage, feature usage and customer satisfaction, using these to inform roadmap and GTM decisions
* Engage directly with key hotel and hotel-group customers across APAC to validate roadmap direction, and directly with OTA, GDS and channel partners to maintain and extend commercial relationships built under STAAH's founder-led model
* Support pricing and packaging strategy across the distribution and revenue product portfolio, including tiering for digital marketing services and RMS capability

**Product Delivery & Quality**

* Lead a regional product management team, setting clear standards for discovery, prioritisation, delivery and iteration across the distribution and revenue product lines
* Work in close partnership with the STAAH and SHR engineering organisations to ensure delivery velocity, quality and alignment with the broader platform vision
* Establish product governance rhythms consistent with the HCC's Service Catalogue / SLA and Communities of Practice model, including roadmap reviews and launch readiness criteria
* Ensure product releases are accompanied by strong GTM readiness, including partner and sales enablement, documentation and customer communication

**Cross-functional & Regional Leadership**

* Partner with regional Go-to-Market and commercial teams to translate distribution and revenue product capability into propositions that resonate with APAC hoteliers
* Collaborate with the Hospitality CPO and global Accommodation product leadership to align the regional roadmap with the broader platform strategy and 2027 migration
* Work with STAAH's product engineering leadership to ensure technical foundations support the distribution and revenue roadmap, and act as the connective product leader across engineering sites

* Roadmap delivery cadence and on-time release achievement

**Essential Experience**

* Proven track record as a senior product leader within accommodation technology – an OTA, a PMS company, a channel manager/connectivity provider, a revenue management system vendor, a GDS, or a booking engine / CRS / IBE product organisation

* Strong commercial acumen with direct experience connecting product decisions to distribution cost, direct booking share, pricing and packaging outcomes

jobs.title: Lead Product Management – Technical – AI Transformation
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Management – Technical – AI Transformation
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
The Services Business represents over a third of Mastercard revenues and is a key differentiator for Mastercard. Services use our unique and proprietary data, technology, insights and expertise to deliver solutions that meet the needs of our customers. Services is critical for the sustained, long-term growth of Mastercard.
  
  
Within the Services organization, this role sits within the Business & Markets Insights (BMI) organization. The Business & Market Insights vertical is focused on creating products and solutions that create value for customers through Analytics, Insights, Business Experimentation, and Payment Consulting & Innovation.
  
  
Under BMI, Payment Performance Intelligence Program's Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products to include AI intelligence. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the AI product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements.
  
  
This individual will partner closely with other members of the Global Product Management team including data scientists to support development of Gen AI chatbot use cases & agentic services and ensuring product priorities are well-aligned with strategic objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long-term vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Support the definition and execution of the AI product roadmap for Payment Performance Intelligence, contributing to strategy and investment discussions led by senior product leadership.
* Own delivery of assigned AI product areas end to end, from discovery and requirements through development, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Help identify and validate high-value use cases for GenAI, chatbots, agentic services, predictive insights, and self-service analytics.
* Translate customer needs, market inputs, and business objectives into clear user stories, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Work day to day with Data Science, Engineering, and Platform teams to groom the backlog, unblock dependencies, and maintain sprint velocity.
* Coordinate with Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance partners to ensure products meet regulatory and responsible AI requirements.
* Recommend prioritization based on customer value, commercial impact, technical feasibility, and effort, escalating trade-offs where needed.
* Define and track success metrics for owned features, reporting progress, risks, and adoption to stakeholders.
* Prepare and present roadmap updates, demos, and release communications to internal stakeholders and customer-facing teams.
* Mentor junior product managers and associates, and contribute to improving agile practices and product documentation standards across the team.

**All About You**

* Solid experience in agile product management for analytics, data insights, AI-enabled, or financial services products.
* Working knowledge of GenAI use cases, predictive insights, self-service analytics, and the data foundations required to support them.
* Demonstrated ability to convert customer problems into requirements, user stories, and measurable product outcomes.
* Experience collaborating across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and driving execution in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience mentoring or guiding peers and junior team members is preferred; formal people management experience is not required.
* Highly organized and analytical, with strong attention to detail in backlog management and delivery tracking.
* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, or equivalent experience required; technical background, payments experience, or product certification preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**We are seeking an Appian Developer to build a banking operations portal that helps bank employees onboard customers and open accounts. You will develop the screens and workflows employees use to find customers, review their existing banking relationships, collect Know Your Customer (KYC) information, prepare documents for signature, and track each application through account opening.**

**You will work with banking operations, product, compliance, and integration teams to translate business requirements into Appian applications that employees can use in their daily work.**

**Key responsibilities**

* **Build Appian SAIL interfaces, record types, process models, and expression rules for customer onboarding and account opening.**

* **Integrate the portal with core banking, KYC, document management, and e-signature platforms. Support KYC risk-rating retrieval, document template selection and prefill, signature tracking, and storage of signed documents against the correct customer record.**
* **Implement role-based access, sensitive data masking, and audit trails for employee actions and approvals.**
* **Test workflows and integrations, troubleshoot failures, and support user acceptance testing, deployment, and production issue resolution.**

**Required qualifications**

* **Hands-on experience developing and deploying Appian applications using SAIL, record types, process models, and expression rules.**
* **Experience integrating Appian with external systems using connected systems, integration objects, REST APIs, and JSON.**
* **Working knowledge of SQL, relational data modeling, and relationships between business records.**
* **Experience implementing application security and handling integration errors, retries, and exceptions.**
* **Ability to work directly with business users to clarify requirements and translate operational steps into usable screens and workflows.**

**Preferred qualifications**

* **Experience integrating Appian screens with identity verification, document management, or e-signature platforms.**
* **Appian Developer certification.**

jobs.title: Manager, IT Delivery
jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Manager, IT Delivery is responsible for leading high-performing data and technology teams and delivering strategic data initiatives that generate measurable business value.
  
  
This role combines people leadership, product delivery, stakeholder management, and operational oversight. The manager will lead teams operating across data engineering, data platforms, data warehousing, data lakes, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
  
  
The manager will have end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership and communication capabilities, experience managing product-oriented teams, and a sound understanding of modern data ecosystems. The role requires the ability to translate business priorities into executable delivery plans, develop engineering talent, manage delivery commitments, and ensure the scalability, quality, security, and reliability of data solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop high-performing data and technology teams, including hiring, performance management, workforce planning, and talent development.
* Drive delivery of strategic initiatives across data engineering, data warehousing, data lakes / lakehouses, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, and business intelligence.
* Partner with business, product, architecture, and engineering stakeholders to translate priorities into product roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead product-oriented teams with end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products.
* Drive Agile practices, including intake management, backlog prioritization, estimation, sprint and release planning, and delivery governance.
* Manage capacity planning, resource forecasting, delivery commitments, risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies to enable predictable execution.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, reusable, and compliant with applicable technology, risk, privacy, and information security standards.
* Promote effective data governance, data quality, metadata management, lineage, ownership, and stewardship practices.
* Monitor delivery, quality, and operational health through relevant metrics, and provide clear, concise updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Foster strong stakeholder relationships and communicate complex data and technology topics effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Promote automation, standardization, engineering excellence, cost optimization, and modern data practices, including cloud and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and business-outcome ownership.
* Provide leadership during major incidents and critical production events, partnering with support and engineering teams to drive timely resolution, stakeholder communication, and service recovery while ensuring operational continuity.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 10+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, data platforms, or IT services, including people leadership experience.
* Proven experience leading teams in a product-based environment with responsibility for delivery execution and stakeholder management.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, backlog management, sprint planning, and Jira.
* Experience leading data-focused technology initiatives, including data engineering, analytics, data quality, governance, or modern data platforms.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution, manage ambiguity, solve complex problems, and lead organisational change.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and effectively partner with engineering teams to deliver business outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries.
* Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and AI-enabled technology initiatives.
* Agile, Scrum, PMP, SAFe, or related certifications preferred.
* Experience leading cloud data platform, data modernization, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing geographically distributed or cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with industry-standard cloud, data engineering, analytics, governance, and data quality technologies.

**Key Success Factors**

* Experience in data-centric technology environments.
* Ability to build, scale, and lead high-performing teams.
* Sound understanding of data engineering, data platforms, governance, quality, and analytics.
* Strong product and Agile delivery leadership.
* Effective capacity planning, forecasting, and execution management.
* Ownership and accountability for delivery and operational outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication.
* Ability to connect data and technology investments to business outcomes.
* Ability to operate effectively in a complex, cross-functional environment.
* Commitment to engineering quality, operational excellence, risk management, and continuous improvement.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Context Engine
jobs.description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Director of Product Management, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the capabilities that let Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine understand customer data on its own: schema and ontology discovery, natural language processing, and AI driven workflow and policy extraction. The Context Engine extracts, curates, and continuously improves metadata and business context, grounded in Teradata's industry knowledge models, so that human analysts move faster and AI agents are grounded in trusted enterprise meaning.
  
  
You will serve as the Context Engine's senior product leader in the region and partner closely with local engineering, data science, and architecture teams along with product and engineering leaders across the US. You will set direction, make prioritization decisions, and hold your team accountable for customer outcomes, from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy, Roadmap & Outcomes**

* Own the roadmap knowledge graph completion / Ontology Learning, Reflexion-based memory extraction, and reinforcement learning-focused feature sets within the Context Engine portfolio. Translate customer needs and business priorities into clear requirements, prioritization decisions, and success criteria.
* Act as the primary touchpoint and evangelist for Context Engine to customers, executives, and field teams in the APJ region.
* Define how these capabilities are reusable by and drive value across Teradata products, personas, and business domains, and across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Shape the competitive position and differentiation of the Context Engine against competitors such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Google, and emerging AI data platform and semantic layer vendors.

**Automated Workflow Assembly**

* Define the product vision for automatically assembling workflows from discovered schemas and semantics, including data preparation, mapping, validation, enrichment, and publication of context, without hand-built pipelines for each customer.
* Specify how agents plan, compose, and execute these workflows, including reusable workflow templates, orchestration, approval checkpoints, and rollback.
* Set requirements for observability, explainability, and auditability so that customers can see why a workflow was assembled the way it was and trust what it produced.
* Define how workflows and discovered context are exposed to external agents and frameworks through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other open agent interfaces.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Customer adoption and production deployments of semantic extraction and automated workflow capabilities, including successful agent and application consumption of the context they produce.
* Discovery and mapping quality: accuracy, coverage, and confidence calibration of discovered schemas, relationships, and semantic mappings, and the share accepted by stewards without correction.
* Automation outcomes: reduction in time and manual effort to onboard a new customer data estate and reach usable context, and the share of workflows assembled and run without hand-built pipelines.
* Platform usability as measured by targeted KPIs and customer sentiment.
* Pipeline influence, win-rate contribution, and analyst and customer perception of Teradata's context and trusted-AI position.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of experience, including 6+ years in product management or equivalent technical product leadership, with 4+ years on enterprise NLP, search, or metadata and data discovery platforms.
* Hands-on experience with NLP and LLM-based applications such as entity and concept extraction, semantic matching, embeddings, and natural language grounding to structured data, including how to evaluate them.
* Experience with BPMN 2. 0 structured workflows, and a demonstrable record of bringing agentic AI solutions from concept to production.
* Working familiarity with ontology and knowledge graph concepts, and with how graph-based context is consumed by retrieval and agent systems.
* Experience with utilizing agent self-learning approaches such as Reflexion, Reflective learning (ERL), or similar approaches to verbal reinforcement learning to improve agents in response to events and encounters in production systems.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**VP Client Relationship Servicing(CRS)**
CIB COO delivers strategic execution for the CIB businesses across the globe. Through transformative data and digital solutions, customer servicing throughout the customer lifecycle, and delivering safe growth supported by non-financial risk expertise, we collaborate across the global businesses and global functions to get it done. Client Authorities & Confirmation Services (CACS) is part of the CIB CRS supporting CIB business by handling customer servicing requests across two journeys – Client Authorities and Audit Confirmation Services. Beyond day-to-day operations leadership, the role holder is the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys - a critical, dual-mandate accountability that combines run-the-bank operations leadership with change-the-bank delivery ownership. This includes supporting the deployment of global technology solutions, working hand-in-hand with the Transformation function on requirements definition and testing, and directly shaping the future-state operating and technology architecture for CACS.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the end-to-end client experience for Audit Confirmations and Mandates/Authorities journeys, acting as the single point of accountability across the full process rather than for individual process steps. Redesign and simplify the CACS operating model to minimise handoffs and touchpoints between teams, reducing cycle time, rework and risk of error at each handover. Use client feedback, complaints and journey/turnaround-time analytics to identify friction points in the end-to-end process and prioritise fixes accordingly.
* Own and drive delivery of Client Authorities & Confirmation Services, objectives and key results (OKRs) aligned to CIB CRS priorities. Act as a primary point of contact and coordinator for relevant CIB Servicing Business Stakeholders and partner teams supporting CIB customers. Partner with business stakeholders to shape and agree the service proposition, including management information, service performance, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Act as the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys, owning the CACS-side accountability for translating business and client needs into deliverable, adopted technology outcomes. Drive the digital change agenda to improve customer experience, reduce operational effort across the end-to-end customer journey, and support and/or lead delivery of strategic tooling and automation initiatives (e.g., digital workflow and AI-enabled solutions) to enable the future-state servicing architecture and its adoption.
* Partner closely with the global Transformation function throughout the delivery lifecycle — defining and prioritising business requirements, validating solution design against operational reality, and sequencing releases against CACS servicing priorities.
* Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for CACS-impacting releases: design test scenarios, coordinate subject-matter-expert testers from the operations team, triage and track defects, and provide formal sign-off ahead of go-live. Track and report transformation milestones, risks, dependencies and benefits realisation to CIB CRS leadership, ensuring the CACS journey transformation stays aligned to global programme timelines. Champion change adoption within the CACS team — ensuring readiness, training, communication and embedding of new tools and ways of working through go-live and hypercare.
* Provide leadership across a diverse, multi-location and/or virtual team environment, driving performance to global standards in a matrix structure. Act as the primary representative for Client Authorities & Confirmation Services for the relevant value stream and stakeholders. Build a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, pace and accountability, ensuring teams understand priorities, processes and expected outcomes. Lead, coach, and develop a large team of specialists, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Proven ability to run a large, multi-market teams across geographies and operating effectively across cultures and diverse working environments. Comfortable partnering with technology/ transformation teams to shape and adopt new tools – doesn’t need to run the transformation just needs to engage credibly and hold the CACS team accountable for adoption.
* Track record of client-centric decision-making prioritising client outcome over internal convenience. Demonstrable communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and drive alignment between operations, technology and client-facing audiences.
* Strong commercial mindset, including financial management capability and business acumen. Proven leadership and team management skills, with a focus on developing and motivating team members and experience in managing large, virtual teams. A natural go getter who moves things forward rather than escalating and waiting.
* Energised by ambiguity and comfortable running BAU, people, transformation agendas in parallel. Dedicated to being an early adopter of new technology and nurturing and environment where teams are excited to pilot new ways of working and technologies in the pursuit of sustainable improvements. Comfortable operating at the intersection of operations and technology, translating business needs into clear, testable requirements. Client-first mindset — instinctively thinks in terms of the client's end-to-end experience rather than individual internal process steps.
* Resilient under competing priorities and reprioritises on their own rather than needing structure imposed direction. CIB CRS / Servicing Operations leadership and regional/country teams. CIB CRS – Global and Regional Leads. Product partners and product teams (Trade, GPS, Credit) supporting CIB clients. Control functions and key partners as required to support safe, compliant servicing delivery
