jobs.title: Product Manager, Input Zone
jobs.description:
**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility.

* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.

* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

**Technical Skills**

* Understands the Input Zone's data and technical architecture — publisher drop zones, ingestion validation, and the downstream handoff — well enough to liaise credibly with engineering.

* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).

* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.

* Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints.

**Competencies**

**Personal Capability**

**Practices Self-Development**

* Is curious and keen to learn and develop new ideas, skills, and knowledge.

* Acts on feedback to improve him/herself.

* Looks for developmental opportunities in day-to-day work.

* Invests time and energy in self-development (professional qualifications, relevant reading, networking, keeping up with AI-assisted product and development practices).

**Solves Problems and Analyses Issues**

* Is able to ask effective questions and collect facts from multiple sources in order to solve problems.

* Is able to effectively identify and analyse problems and propose solutions.

* Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention.

**Innovates**

jobs.title: Vice President - Business Management, Design Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Our Business Management team acts as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and optimizes business performance by helping to drive key initiatives. We act as a counterweight to business and group heads and are responsible for identifying, escalating, and mitigating business risks. The role is dynamic and can vary from business to business, in line with the priorities of different lines of business. This is a time-pressured and high-profile position, instrumental in assisting and advising senior management. You will help coordinate the deployment of corporate resources to address strategic and tactical objectives.

Job summary

As a **Business Management** professional within the **Business Management team**, you will help drive strategic and tactical objectives by coordinating corporate resources and advising senior management. You will implement new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms by aligning partners across Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, and Compliance. You will optimize bottom-line performance by driving key initiatives related to fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization. You will identify, escalate, and mitigate business risks that could impair the ability to do business, including legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, and extraordinary transaction costs. You will partner across functions to define future workflows and implement related technology and infrastructure projects to support an evolving market structure.

Job responsibilities

* **Implement** new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms, including aligning department and support groups (Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, Compliance)
* **Optimize** bottom-line business performance by driving key initiatives (fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization)
* **Identify** business risks that could impair the ability to do business and **escalate and mitigate** those risks (e.g., legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, extraordinary transaction costs)
* **Analyze** financial performance, including expenses; **identify** productivity initiatives and **drive** implementation
* **Partner** with the business, Operations, and Technology to define future workflows and **implement** related technology and infrastructure projects to prepare for evolving market structure requirements
* **Partner** with relevant external service and infrastructure providers
* **Represent** the business in internal and external working groups

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or other related area
* Previous product knowledge and/or prior Business Management or Chief Operating Officer experience
* Energetic and dynamic style
* Highly motivated self-starter with excellent time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to present well to senior and global business heads
* Ability to forge strong internal relationships across a broad range of functions
* Self-motivated, tenacious, and able to work with a high degree of independence
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to define and deliver a strategic agenda across multiple groups
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including ability to analyze large data sets and present conclusions concisely
* Excellent project management and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail and a logical thought process

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

jobs.description:
#### **Job ID**

62988

#### **Work Style**

Hybrid Worker

#### **Brand**

HSBC

#### **Job Type**

Full Time

#### **Date Posted**

19 November 2026

#### **Apply By**

27 November 2026

If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

  

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role **Head of Business Technology Intelligence**.

  

**The Opportunity**

  

Data and Analytics Professionals at HSBC have responsibility for executing our HSBC Data Strategy. Their responsibilities are threefold:

  

* Recognising data as an asset to HSBC by managing Data Risk and ensuring we are compliant with our Data standards and policies;

* Using analytics and data science to unlock the value of our data; and

* Implementing and maintaining our Data Technologies. Data and Analytics Professionals are geographically dispersed and aligned to the Global Businesses / Global Functions or regions.

**What you will do:**

  

As an influential and visionary servant leader, you’ll lead and empower delivery teams to execute the Group Business and Technology Data Strategy and roadmap. You’ll provide direct and indirect leadership, fostering innovation across the organisation through agile ways of working and effective agile leadership.

  

Leading by example, you’ll enable teams to deliver high-quality technology, data products and services that meet customer and business requirements. You’ll help create an environment where people can succeed, collaborate effectively and deliver measurable value at pace.

  

The Head of Data Group Chief Information Office is accountable for the strategic design, implementation, governance, and ongoing management of the end-to-end enterprise data model across Group Chief Information Office. The role ensures that data is structured, governed, trusted, and managed as a strategic asset, enabling effective decision-making, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and technology transformation.

  

The role leads the development and execution of the organisation's data architecture, data quality, lineage, metadata, and data management capabilities, establishing robust controls and standards across the technology estate while driving adoption and accountability throughout the organisation.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Company** | Hybon Technologies Private Limited  
**Location** | The Executive Centre, 7th Floor, Worldmark 4, Aerocity, New Delhi  
**Employment Type** | Full-time  
**Reporting To** | Chief Financial Officer

Role Overview

Hybon Technologies is looking for a **Head of Accounts** to lead the accounting function for its domestic trading and export business in mobile phones, electronics and IT products. The role owns the books of accounts, financial close, statutory compliance, audit coordination and internal controls. The successful candidate will lead the accounts team and work closely with sales, procurement, logistics and banking teams to keep financial records accurate and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Key Responsibilities

* **Accounting and financial close** — Oversee the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, fixed assets and intercompany balances. Lead monthly and year-end closing and prepare financial statements and supporting schedules.
* **GST and tax compliance** — Oversee GST returns, GSTR-2B reconciliations, input tax credit, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Manage TDS deductions, deposits and returns, and coordinate with tax advisors on statutory filings and notices.
* **Import and export accounting** — Review invoices, bills of entry, shipping bills, customs duties, freight and landed costs. Monitor foreign currency receivables and payables, exchange differences and export realisations. Coordinate with banks and internal teams on remittance documentation and support GST refund claims where applicable.
* **Inventory and cost controls** — Reconcile inventory records with the books and physical stock counts. Investigate stock discrepancies, review valuation and landed costs, and oversee IMEI or serial-number reconciliation where applicable.
* **Receivables, payables and cash flow** — Monitor customer and vendor ageing, advances and credit balances. Drive account confirmations and dispute resolution, review payment schedules and prepare cash flow forecasts for management.
* **Management reporting** — Prepare monthly reports on profitability, gross margins, inventory, overdue receivables and working capital. Explain material variances and flag issues that require management action.
* **Audits and internal controls** — Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits. Maintain supporting documentation, close audit observations and strengthen review controls for invoicing, payments, credit notes and journal entries.
* **Team leadership** — Supervise and develop the accounts team, set clear responsibilities and review deadlines, and improve accounting processes and ERP workflows.

Qualifications and Experience

* CA preferred. CMA, M.Com or B.Com candidates with relevant senior accounting experience may also be considered.
* 8–12 years of accounting experience, including at least 3 years leading an accounts team.
* Experience in trading, distribution or import/export is preferred. Exposure to mobile phones, electronics or IT hardware is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience in financial closing, GST, TDS, inventory accounting, reconciliations and audit coordination.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or a comparable ERP, along with strong Excel skills for reconciliations and management reporting.
* Ability to lead a team, meet statutory and reporting deadlines, and communicate clearly with management, auditors, banks and business teams.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

The Cluster Sales Head will lead a team of current-account sales team and relationship managers, work closely with branches and product partners, and ensure the cluster delivers profitable, compliant, transaction-active current-account growth.

Business Banking / Branch Banking / CASA

Cluster Head

Defined cluster of branches, catchments and business hubs

Branch Managers, Product, Cash Management, POS/QR, Operations, Compliance and Service teams

* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.

* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.

* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.

* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.

* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.

* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.

**3. Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up**

* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.

* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.

* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.

* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.

* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.

* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.

* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.

* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.

* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.

* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.

* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.

* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.

**7. People Leadership**

* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.

Apart from payments, we provide services on Data and Insights, Lending, Insurance, Risk Solutions, etc. Our core customers are businesses at every scale and segment, though recently we are growing in direct to consumer card segment as well.
  
  
**Our EVP**
At Network International, we always stay ahead. . In the fast-paced world of financial services, we thrive on innovation, agility, and purposeful collaboration. We invest first in our people, empowering you to make bold decisions, learn fast, and grow your expertise alongside industry leaders. Here, solving complex problems means more than using cutting-edge technology; it’s about creating meaningful value for our customers, together. We foster a culture where trust, accountability, and achievement go hand in hand—because success isn’t just a goal; it’s how we work, every day, as one team.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Head of Agile Transformation will lead Acquiring's evolution into a more product-led, agile and insight-driven organisation. Working across Product, Technology, Data, Business Teams, Leadership and Transformation Partners, the role will assess current maturity, define the target operating model and embed practical ways of working suited to Network International.
  
  
The role will create the governance, capabilities, roles and operating practices needed for successful product delivery, while delivery outcomes remain shared across Product, Technology and the wider organisation. As maturity increases, the remit will evolve towards broader product strategy, portfolio management, investment prioritisation and value creation.
  
  
**The Transformation Journey**

* Discover: Assess maturity and define the target state and roadmap.
* Transform: Establish the Product and Agile operating model.
* Embed: Build internal capability, a Centre of Excellence and partner knowledge transfer.
* Scale: Extend and continuously improve successful practices.
* Evolve: Broaden influence over Product strategy, portfolio choices and value creation.

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Lead Product & Agile Transformation**

* Own the transformation vision, business case, roadmap, milestones and success measures; assess maturity and sequence priorities.
* Align Product, Technology, Data, business leadership and partners around a common target state, removing organisational, governance and behavioural barriers.
* Keep the transformation practical, commercially relevant and aligned with customer, risk and enterprise priorities, using AI-enabled tools to accelerate adoption.

**Establish Product-led & Agile Ways Of Working**

* Design and embed a scalable operating model covering team structures, governance, decision rights, funding principles, delivery cadences and performance measures.
* Clarify accountabilities across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Design, Data, Operations, Sales and delivery roles.
* Embed customer-led discovery, prioritisation and outcome-based planning; apply Scrum, Kanban or scaled approaches according to context.
* Improve Product-Technology collaboration, portfolio visibility, dependency management, predictability and speed to value.

**Build Capability & Organizational Ownership**

* Build Product and Agile capability from executive leadership to delivery teams through structured learning, coaching and practical application.
* Establish a Product and Agile Centre of Excellence, communities of practice, playbooks, role standards and internal coaching capability.
* Lead stakeholder engagement and change adoption; govern transformation partners and progressively transfer knowledge and ownership into Network International.

**Enable Insight-led Decisions & Demonstrate Value Through Data & AI:**

* Embed customer insight, product analytics, commercial measures and operational data into discovery, prioritisation and lifecycle decisions.
* Identify responsible uses of AI for research, experimentation, requirements, knowledge management and decision support, with appropriate human oversight and controls.
* Maintain a balanced scorecard covering adoption, capability, flow, predictability, quality, customer outcomes and commercial value; report progress, risks and benefits transparently.

**Qualifications**
**Key Requirements:**
**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years across Agile transformation, Product operating models, Product management, technology delivery or enterprise change, including 5+ years in senior leadership.
* Proven success leading large-scale Product and Agile transformation across multiple teams or business units in a complex, regulated organization.
* Strong experience designing Product-led operating models, including governance, roles, team structures, portfolio practices, outcome-based planning and investment prioritization.
* Hands-on expertise in Product discovery, Agile delivery, organizational design, change leadership, executive influence, coaching and capability building.
* Experience managing transformation partners, establishing a Centre of Excellence and transferring capability into internal teams.
* Track record of measuring adoption, delivery performance, customer impact and business value; practical understanding of responsible AI, data privacy and security.
* Experience in payments, acquiring, merchant services, fintech or banking, with knowledge of the merchant lifecycle, payment products, risk, fraud, operations and commercial drivers.
* Experience across multiple markets and regulatory environments, ideally in the Middle East and Africa.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field; a master's degree or MBA is advantageous.
* Credentials such as SAFe SPC, Certified Scrum Professional, ICAgile, Scrum Alliance or Prosci are advantageous; demonstrated transformation outcomes are more important than certification alone.

*Network International is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, nationalities, and experience levels. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where innovation, diversity, and performance thrive.*

to join our technology leadership team, reporting directly to the CTO. This role will
**manage and grow the Platform Product organization**
and
**extend product ownership across the CTO-line platform product portfolio**
, including infrastructure-facing product lines such as AI platform, compliance infrastructure, financial cloud, and developer tooling.

This is a rare opportunity to shape the product strategy of a global crypto exchange at a pivotal inflection point — transitioning from a high-growth crypto-native platform to a
**regulated, AI-native financial institution**
.

  **AI-native product development**

* Define and drive the
  **killing feature strategy**
  for the AI agent platform: identify the user acquisition hook that converts infrastructure investment into real user growth
* Own the product strategy for intelligent customer service evolution — from reactive article-linking to proactive, fully automated resolution (>80% resolution rate target)

What We're Looking For

Must Have

  of product management experience, with at least
  **5 years in a senior product leadership role**
  managing multi-team product organizations (20+ PMs)
* Proven track record building and shipping
  **platform/infrastructure products**
  — not just consumer-facing features; experience with developer platforms, internal tooling, or B2B SaaS is highly valued
* Strong
  **systems thinking**
  : ability to define product architecture, module catalogs, and API contracts — not just user stories
* Experience operating in a

  (fintech, banking, crypto, or equivalent); understanding of how regulatory requirements translate into product constraints and opportunities
* Demonstrated ability to
  **drive OKR quality**
  — moving teams from go-live metrics to outcome-based measurement

  **Chinese (Mandarin)**

Strongly Preferred

  or

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform, revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers and potential to turn into performance. FNmarkets is our international brokerage arm, serving clients across global markets*.*

With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users, from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

**Your Role in Our Mission**  
As a Manager, Payments & Treasury (FNmarkets Brokerage), you own the end-to-end movement, safeguarding, and optimization of client and corporate funds across FNmarkets’ international brokerage operations. You will run the PSP and banking portfolio that powers client deposits and withdrawals, manage multi-currency liquidity and FX exposure, and keep settlement, reconciliation, and treasury controls tight as the brokerage scales across markets. Sitting at the intersection of payment operations, treasury, and bank/PSP relationship management, you partner closely with Compliance, Finance, Risk, and trading-platform teams to keep funds flowing reliably, cost-efficiently, and within regulatory requirements.

This role reports to the group Head of Payments & Treasury.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **Payment Operations & PSP Portfolio:**

* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own the PSP and payment-method portfolio (cards, local bank rails, e-wallets, crypto) across the brokerage’s active markets, from onboarding and integration through performance monitoring and offboarding.
* **Payment Routing Optimization:** Optimize payment routing in the orchestrator to lift approval rates, reduce decline and failure rates, and lower blended cost per transaction.
* **SLA & Performance Tracking:** Track and improve deposit/withdrawal success rates, processing times, and chargeback/dispute ratios against agreed SLAs.

**2. Client Funds & Payout Operations:**

* **End-to-End Flow Oversight:** Oversee client deposit and withdrawal flows end to end, ensuring funds are processed accurately, on time, and in line with client-money safeguarding rules.
* **Payout Management:** Manage brokerage client withdrawals and wallet transfers, including volume forecasting, queue management, and exception handling.
* **Fund Segregation & Reporting:** Maintain segregation of client funds from corporate funds and support audit and regulatory reporting on balances.

**3. Treasury, FX & Cash Management:**

* **Multi-Currency Liquidity:** Manage multi-currency liquidity across entities and accounts, ensuring sufficient funding for client withdrawals, settlements, and operating needs.
* **FX & Hedging Execution:** Run FX operations and conversions, monitor currency exposure, and execute hedging or rebalancing as directed by policy.
* **Cash Forecasting & Yield:** Forecast cash positions, optimize working capital, and manage the placement of eligible corporate cash within approved investment and counterparty limits—with client funds held separately and safeguarded at all times.

**4. Banking & Relationship Management:**

* **Partner Management:** Own relationships with banks, PSPs, and acquiring partners—covering commercials, fee and settlement-term negotiation, issue escalation, and periodic performance reviews.
* **Cost Reduction:** Drive down processing, settlement, and FX costs through negotiation and transfer-pricing/routing optimization.
* **Infrastructure Redundancy:** Build banking and PSP redundancy to protect the continuity of client deposits and withdrawals.

**5. Reconciliation, Compliance & Risk:**

* **Multi-Ledger Reconciliation:** Own daily and periodic reconciliation across PSPs, banks, crypto wallets, and the ledger, resolving breaks and ensuring settlement accuracy.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Alignment:** Partner with Compliance on KYC/AML, licensing, and regulatory requirements affecting payment flows and client funds.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Identify and mitigate operational, settlement, counterparty, and fraud risk across the payment and treasury stack.

**6. Projects & Optimization:**

* **Expansion & Automation Initiatives:** Lead payments and treasury projects, including new-market and new-method launches, orchestrator and system integrations, and process automation.
* **Executive Reporting:** Build reporting and dashboards on approval rates, cost, settlement cycles, liquidity, and payout performance for leadership.
* **Cross-Functional Scaling:** Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Risk to scale payment and treasury capability as the brokerage grows.

**7. Build & Scale, Team Leadership & Innovation:**

* **Build & Scale:** Define and build out the FNmarkets payments and treasury operating model - people, processes, and systems - to support the brokerage’s growth across new markets and product lines.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing payments & treasury wing for FNmarkets business line, setting clear priorities, fostering accountability, and building capability at every level.
* **Innovation & Knowledge Sharing:** Champion continuous improvement by staying current on industry developments, introducing best practices, and ensuring knowledge flows across the team and key stakeholders.

**What You Bring**

* **Industry Experience:** Minimum 5 years in payments, funds management, and treasury functions at an international brokerage (CFD/FX/securities); strong candidates from payments firms serving brokerage clients also considered.
* **High-Volume Payment Operations:** Hands-on experience managing client deposit and withdrawal flows, PSP relationships, and payment routing in a high-volume, multi-currency environment.
* **Treasury & FX Mastery:** Treasury experience across multi-currency liquidity and cash management, FX operations, and working-capital or settlement optimization.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager 3
jobs.description:
#### **About Behavox**

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.

Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.

**About the Role**

Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.

Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships.

The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value.

This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks.** Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time.
* **Financial services regulatory environment.** Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors.
* **Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions.** Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts, technology teams, and operations teams; manages both executive-level strategic relationships and working-level practitioner relationships simultaneously.
* **Commercial lifecycle management for enterprise SaaS.** Owns the full renewal and expansion cycle: retention strategy, churn forecasting, negotiation, close, and pipeline development in partnership with Account Executives; understands how delivery health directly impacts commercial outcomes.
* **Escalation management and operational accountability**. Owns ticket triage, escalation, and resolution end to end for the full portfolio; manages complex, multi-workstream escalations with minimal manager involvement; builds relationships with Product, Engineering, and Support counterparts to accelerate resolution.

**What You'll Do**

* **Account health monitoring and risk identification.** Independently assesses account health and risk across commercial, operational, and relationship dimensions; surfaces risk early by reading ticket patterns, stakeholder signals, and adoption data as intelligence; builds intervention plans without manager direction.
* **Executive business review design and delivery.** Designs and executes QBRs and EBRs for all accounts including executive-level engagement; leads conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value rather than product update calls.
* **Renewal ownership and churn forecasting.** Owns all renewals across the portfolio: builds retention strategy, leads negotiations, closes; accurately forecasts ARR churn risk and develops mitigation plans using account health data, stakeholder intelligence, and delivery performance indicators.
* **Expansion identification and commercial execution.** Drives inbound expansion deals independently; collaborates with Account Executives per Unit of One model for strategic accounts; leads with value, not discount-first positioning; builds commercial plays grounded in customer intelligence.
* **Delivery follow-through and client communication ownership.** Owns the client-facing narrative when delivery issues arise, ensuring commitments made to the client are tracked and fulfilled; translates technical or operational updates into language the client can act on; holds internal teams accountable through to confirmed resolution so the client has everything they need without chasing.

**What We Offer**

* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation
* Benefits include fully covered health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule

**About Our Process**

  

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.  
  
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.  
  
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

**Please note that:**

* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

**Our Meaningful Mission**  
At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech. Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave , driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognises and supports global connections.
  
  
**Who You'll Be Joining**

We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners , always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners , treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

**Our Core Commitments — What We Live By**  
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:

* Integrity: We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
* Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
* Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

**Perks of Joining Our Team**

We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. While we have all the tools to work remotely, we value the purpose and benefits of in-person connections so expect regular team off-sites. We also offer unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

**About the Role**  
As the Head of APAC, you will be the ultimate executive responsible for driving the commercial expansion, strategic growth, product launches, and operational optimization of the Company across the Asia-Pacific region. You will hold full accountability and responsibility for APAC growth targets, taking end-to-end ownership of Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. You will build the partner network, commercial deals, and local operational engines needed to launch, scale, and optimize them rapidly. This role requires an ambitious commercial mindset, exceptional matrix leadership capabilities, and a deep understanding of cross-border financial markets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
Regional Expansion & Growth Strategy

* Commercial PnL & Target Ownership: Meet and exceed all targets set across Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. Take full accountability for scaling the region’s market share and bottom-line growth.
* Corridor & Network Expansion: Identify, negotiate, and execute strategic partnership and banking network expansion opportunities across emerging and developed APAC markets.
* Launch & Market Optimization: Lead end-to-end market entry and expansion strategies, integrating local real-time payment rails and partner networks to maximize transaction speed, cost efficiency, and customer experience.
* Commercial FX & Margin Strategy: Partner closely with internal Pricing, FX Trading, and Treasury teams to continuously optimize corridor pricing models. Drive regional FX spread margins, ensure competitive liquidity across high-volume APAC currency pairs, and maximize overall revenue margins.

Team Leadership & Matrix Governance

* Direct Regional Management: Lead and manage the regional commercial team, driving accountability, setting KPIs, and mentoring direct reports including:
  + Regional Managers
  + Business Development Managers
  + Commercial Managers
* Cross-Functional Matrix Leadership: Manage and Collaborate across indirect reporting lines and work streams that filter into regional Business Partners, aligning multi-disciplinary teams around expansion and revenue goals:
  + Launch & Product Teams (market readiness, feature rollouts, rails integration)
  + Marketing Teams (multi-channel acquisition and localized growth campaigns)
  + Payment Operations Teams (route efficiency, settlement, scaling infrastructure)
  + Pricing Teams (dynamic rate management and corridor margins)
  + FX Traders (underlying liquidity support and panel coordination)
* Country Directorship & Governance: Concurrently serve as, or oversee, Country Director roles based on business needs, managing local regulatory relationships and government interactions to facilitate seamless market launches.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Report performance metrics, expansion milestones, and revenue updates directly to the ExCo and senior leadership.

Infrastructure, Launch Execution & Risk

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The UAE Services Business Execution & Strategy Analyst / Associate plays a central role in driving the growth, governance, and operational execution of Citi’s Services franchise in the United Arab Emirates.

  
  

This role blends strategic commercial enablement, product P&L analytics, and sales pipeline optimization with proactive oversight of country governance, regulatory affairs, technology enhancement asks, and executive reporting for UAE leadership.

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

**A. UAE Services Strategy & Commercial Growth**

**Strategy Execution:** Execute the comprehensive UAE Services strategy established by Country Management to accelerate business momentum across the franchise.

**Franchise Expansion:** Support growth initiatives across revenue, transaction volume, and balance sheet/asset dimensions across all UAE cash management, payments, and trade lines.

  
  

**B. Product P&L, Financial Analytics & Performance Tracking**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**P&L Management & Measurement:** Monitor, analyze, and report on product-level P&L performance, revenue streams, and expense drivers across all UAE Services offerings.

**Variance & Trend Analysis:** Extract and evaluate financial and balance sheet data from Citi internal systems; compare actual performance against plan and prior periods, pinpointing drivers, growth trends, and outliers.

**C. Country Governance, Regulatory Affairs & Infrastructure**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**D. Sales Pipeline & Commercial Enablement**
---------------------------------------------

**E. Executive Presentations, Senior Visits & Action Tracking**

**Executive Decks:** Prepare high-impact PowerPoint presentations and briefing documents for Country Governance Committee meetings, regulatory engagements, and business reviews.

* Minimum of 3+ years of relevant banking experience (preferably in transaction banking, cash management, trade services, or corporate banking)
* Sound understanding of P&L mechanics, balance sheet analysis, statistical analysis, and variance modeling
* Advanced PowerPoint presentation skills with the ability to synthesize complex commercial, regulatory, and financial data into clean, executive-ready decks
* Strong hands-on proficiency in MS Excel (advanced formulas, data modeling) and MS Word; aptitude for quickly learning internal core banking and CRM platforms
* Fluent written and verbal English communication skills; confident in liaising with cross-functional internal stakeholders and senior management
* Highly organized with a strong attention to detail; able to work independently, manage multiple time-sensitive deliverables, and drive tasks to completion
  

  

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related quantitative field.
  

  

**What We Offer:**

**Direct Country Franchise Exposure:** High-visibility role with direct access to UAE Services leadership and country governance bodies.

**Workplace Flexibility:** Business casual environment with a hybrid work structure (up to 2 days/week working from home).

**Competitive Package:** Annually reviewed base salary alongside a comprehensive suite of health, wellness, and savings benefits for you and your family.

You will work as Senior Auditor under the direction of the Head of MEA Region Internal Audit and the Head of IMI-CIB Foreign Network Audit. Either independently or collectively with the MEA Audit team and with HO auditors, you will carry out or lead internal audit engagements covering different areas; you will evaluate internal controls of the audited organizational structure process, document audit test work and communicate audit issues to management. jobs.description:
Date live: 11/10/2026

Business Area: See job description

Area of Expertise: Early Careers

Contract: Intern

Reference Code: JR-0000125149

  

**Off-Cycle Internship Overview**
  
Join us on an Off-Cycle Internship for 3-6 months. Immerse yourself in our work and culture and gain invaluable insights into life as a Full-time Analyst with this longer internship.

  
  

**Why the Sales, Trading and Structuring Off-Cycle Intern Programme?**
  
Our Sales and Trading team works in a fast-paced, dynamic and exciting environment, quickly processing information and anticipating market trends to help clients make their next move. Sound like the place for you? Find out when you join us as an Off-Cycle Analyst.

  
  

**The chance to make an impact**

As an Off-Cycle Analyst, you’ll be surprised by what you can achieve. Your internship starts with intensive training that gives you an essential platform for gaining skills and knowledge. Then you’ll head to your desk, where you’ll get to grips with the intricacies of the global markets and follow a structured programme that includes project-based work. Through our off-cycle programme, you will have the chance to have more in-depth exposure to projects, compared to our summer internships; thus, expanding your overall knowledge and skill in this role.

  
  

Through your desk assignments, you’ll develop a solid understanding of the global markets, building your communication, quantitative and analytical skills. You may:

* Research industries or products, reporting summary information to your team.
* Monitor markets and help formulate trade ideas.
* Perform various analyses on fundamental and technical data.
* Attend client meetings or calls with traders, salespeople and research colleagues.
  

  

**Markets at Barclays**
  
Markets is the financial barometer of world events at Barclays. So every day is different and it’s a challenging, fascinating place to build a career.

  
  

We help institutional investors to identify market opportunities, manage risk and generate returns for their portfolios.

  
  

Our teams provide market insights, execution services and tailored risk management and financing solutions to our clients; we help them protect their capital and make the most of their assets.

  
  

As one of the largest investment banks in the world, we offer a full range of products and services across every type of investment market.

  
  

**Who we're looking for**
  
To be considered for this programme, you must be in your penultimate or final year of your degree, in any discipline.

  
  

Language requirements: fluent in English and Arabic desirable.

  
  

Ideally you’ll have a keen interest in business or finance with a curiosity to learn. We value resourcefulness, teamwork, enthusiasm and an entrepreneurial spirit, all of which might be showcased through your involvement in extracurricular activities.

  
  

**Working in Dubai**
  
For more than 150 years, Barclays has been a member of the Middle East business community. From our Dubai office you’ll work on corporate banking solutions, to financial institutions and multinationals, supporting them to fulfil their financing needs, risk management, cash and liquidity management, as well as trade and working capital requirements.

**Purpose of the role**

To participate in the day-to-day activities of the markets division providing insights and expertise that help senior colleagues make informed decisions, develop new products and services, and identify new market opportunities.

**Accountabilities**

* Execution of small research projects, research to support strategic decision making, preparation of presentations and reports to communicate research findings, collaboration with senior management to implement research findings for the global markets division.
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives.
* Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.
* Identification of opportunities, development of business cases, management of the deployment and launch of new products and services for the global markets division.
* Management of client relationships and provision of customer service support to clients and customers, under steadily decreasing supervision, responding to questions about products and services, processing of transactions.
* Management of the development and implementation of financial models and strategies that support in decision making in the global markets division.
* Training and mentoring of junior colleagues.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise.
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise.
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisation’s products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Vice President - International Gaming Compliance & MLRO
jobs.description:
About Wynn Al Marjan Island:

Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.

About the Position:

Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking a **Vice President – Gaming Compliance & Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO)** to join the resort’s **Gaming Compliance team** in Ras Al Khaimah. The role reports directly to the Chief Global Compliance Officer, Wynn Resorts, and administratively to the SVP, General Counsel, WMI.

As MLRO and a senior leader within Gaming Compliance, you will direct the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of WMI’s risk-based Anti-Money Laundering, Countering the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation Financing (AML/CFT/CPF) Compliance Program. You will oversee suspicious activity investigations and reporting to the UAE Financial Intelligence Unit (UAE FIU) through goAML, set risk appetite and control standards, lead training, and provide strategic direction to Gaming Compliance teams and Gaming Promoters/Independent Agents. The program covers applicable UAE Federal AML laws, Cabinet Decisions, Chapter 12 of the GCGRA Executive Regulations, and FATF standards applicable to Designated Non-Financial Businesses and Professions (DNFBPs).

The primary duties and responsibilities of this role are:

* Act as WMI’s MLRO, reviewing and determining Suspicious Activity Incident Reports (SAIRs), escalating and filing Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs), ensuring continuity through an appropriately qualified Deputy MLRO during any absence, and serving as Secretary of the WMI AML Compliance Committee.
* Provide strategic leadership and direction to Gaming Compliance, setting objectives, policies, and procedures aligned with regulatory requirements and business goals.
* Oversee AML/CFT obligations and maintain effective compliance systems, controls, and governance to minimize exposure to money laundering and terrorism financing.
* Direct and review suspicious activity investigations, analysis, and escalation, with direct reporting to the WMI AML Compliance Committee and governing body. Make timely, documented reporting or non-reporting decisions, prioritize cases by risk, and maintain confidentiality and independence.
* Oversee timely SAR filing with the UAE FIU through goAML, no later than 30 calendar days from initial detection, and ensure the GCGRA is notified of the FIU reference number immediately following submission.
* Oversee Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), source of funds and source of wealth verification, and risk scoring for potentially high-risk patrons and Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), approving risk-based decisions.
* Develop and maintain quality assurance (QA) policies, procedures, and review standards for SARs, CDD and EDD files, transaction monitoring alerts, and investigations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with GCGRA requirements.
* Conduct comprehensive QA testing to identify trends, gaps, and errors, and recommend corrective actions and improvements to strengthen the AML Compliance Program.
* Prepare QA reports, metrics, analytical findings, and enhancement updates for leadership, the WMI AML Compliance Committee, and the Patron AML Restriction Committee.
* Maintain robust AML/CFT recordkeeping and storage for a minimum of five years, in accordance with the GCGRA Executive Regulations, with records immediately available to the GCGRA or UAE authorities upon request.
* Oversee regular screening of persons reported in SAIRs/SARs, currency exchanges, and third-party wire transfers, and review the monthly PEP checklist prepared for Global Compliance Investigations.
* Work closely with Wynn Resorts Global Compliance Investigations to prepare and review reports for the WMI AML Compliance Committee and Patron AML Restriction Committee.
* Lead GCGRA examinations, internal audits, and annual independent AML Compliance Program testing; act as a primary regulatory contact and oversee remediation of deficiencies.
* Cooperate with the GCGRA, UAE FIU, Police, and Courts, managing responses to investigation inquiries and regulatory or law enforcement information requests.
* Oversee ongoing sanctions screening of players, transactions, and vendors against UAE and relevant UN Security Council sanctions lists, including match handling, escalation, freezing measures, reporting, and recordkeeping; ensure Targeted Financial Sanctions are applied when a match is identified.
* Oversee daily transaction monitoring, transaction logs, and Electronic Multiple Transaction Logs (e-MTLs), ensuring loggable and reportable transactions at or above AED 11,000 are accurately recorded and structuring or other suspicious activity is identified and escalated.
* Design and implement monitored risk scenarios and typologies, overseeing alert handling, escalation, investigation, system tuning, and transaction monitoring effectiveness.
* Enforce the prohibition on anonymous, alias/AKA, fictitious-name, and nominee Player Accounts, and ensure identification and account-opening due diligence requirements are met.
* Enforce strict confidentiality of SARs and suspicious activity investigations and the prohibition on tipping off, sharing SAR information only on a need-to-know basis in accordance with UAE law.
* Direct WMI’s annual money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing risk assessment, using results to enhance policies, procedures, systems, and controls.
* Report clearly and promptly to senior management and governing bodies on AML/CFT/CPF program effectiveness, maintaining governance that upholds confidentiality and independence.
* Keep the Compliance Program current with evolving risks, typologies, legislation, regulatory guidance, sanctions requirements, products, services, and emerging technologies.
* Develop, deliver, and maintain AML/CFT/CPF training, including role-targeted programs, materials, and records; coach managers, staff, and Gaming Promoters/Independent Agents on regulatory obligations.
* Recruit, develop, mentor, and manage Gaming Compliance managers and team members.
* Build professional, positive relationships with department heads, team members, regulators, and Gaming Promoters/Independent Agents.
* Attend and lead departmental and interdepartmental meetings and share relevant information.
* Adhere to Company policies, procedures, and the Code of Conduct.
* Maintain professional conduct and grooming in line with Department and Company standards.
* Follow health and safety standards and pursue continuous improvement to prevent health and injury hazards.

jobs.title: AD/Director - B2C Marketing & Consumer Activation
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Pine Labs is seeking a dynamic B2C marketing leader to drive consumer adoption of our fintech products through integrated marketing campaigns and innovative in-store activation. This role owns the end-to-end consumer journey—from digital discovery to in-store transaction—making affordability and smart payment solutions accessible and desirable to millions of Indian consumers.

**As the Lead for B2C Marketing & Consumer Activation, you will build Pine Labs into a household name for Gen Z and Millennial consumers seeking flexible payment options.**
You'll craft compelling fintech narratives that demystify complex products, drive app adoption, and create memorable in-store experiences that convert browsers into users at the moment of purchase.

**What You'll Own**

**Consumer Brand Building & Integrated Campaigns**

* Develop and execute 360-degree integrated marketing campaigns that connect digital touchpoints (social, app, performance marketing) with physical retail experiences
* Own the consumer narrative for Pine Labs' affordability ecosystem—EMI, Pay Later, consumer cards, and wallet products—translating fintech complexity into simple, relatable stories
* Build category leadership by creating the "Halo Effect" that positions Pine Labs as the smart choice for aspirational consumption
* Drive always-on brand campaigns and high-impact moment marketing that keeps Pine Labs top-of-mind for young consumers

**App Marketing & Digital Consumer Acquisition**

* Lead consumer app marketing strategy—from acquisition to activation, engagement, and retention
* Design app onboarding journeys, push notification strategies, and in-app campaigns that drive feature adoption and transaction frequency
* Partner with Performance Marketing teams to optimise digital spend across Meta, Google, and emerging channels for consumer acquisition
* Build growth loops that turn one-time users into habitual consumers of Pine Labs products

**In-Store Consumer Activation & Experiential Marketing**

* Design and execute high-impact in-store activation programs that educate and convert consumers at the point of purchase
* Create experiential marketing initiatives—pop-ups, brand activations, merchant location takeovers—that drive trial and adoption
* Build "phygital" experiences that seamlessly connect app downloads, wallet loading, and in-store transactions
* Develop merchant partnership programs where Pine Labs creates value for both retailers and end consumers through co-created experiences

**Consumer Lifecycle & Engagement Marketing**

* Own the post-acquisition consumer journey—designing lifecycle marketing programs (email, SMS, WhatsApp, push) that drive repeat usage
* Build segmentation strategies that deliver personalized messaging based on consumer behavior, transaction patterns, and life stage
* Create nudge marketing frameworks that increase transaction frequency and basket size
* Design loyalty and rewards programs that increase wallet share and consumer lifetime value

**Partnership Marketing & Co-Branded Campaigns**

* Develop strategic partnerships with consumer brands (electronics, fashion, travel) to create co-branded campaigns that drive mutual value
* Design "brand as a utility" partnerships where Pine Labs' affordability products enhance consumer access to aspirational brands
* Build influencer and content creator programs that authentically showcase Pine Labs use cases to target audiences

**What We're Looking For**

* 10 -15+ years in B2C marketing with at least 5+ years in consumer fintech, digital payments, or consumer-facing financial services
* Proven track record of scaling consumer apps and driving adoption of digital financial products in India
* Deep experience with integrated marketing campaigns that blend digital performance marketing with offline/experiential activation
* Strong understanding of consumer behavior, purchase psychology, and the affordability mindset in India

**Core Capabilities**

*Consumer Insight & Market Synthesis*

* Deep empathy for Gen Z and Millennial financial behaviours, aspirations, and anxieties around credit and affordability
* Ability to identify cultural moments, consumer trends, and behavioral shifts before they become mainstream
* Track record of translating complex fintech products into relatable consumer propositions that drive trial

*Digital Marketing Excellence*

* Strong command of app marketing—ASO, UA campaigns, onboarding optimization, retention mechanics
* Experience with performance marketing optimization, cohort analysis, and growth experimentation
* Understanding of consumer data platforms, marketing automation, and personalization at scale
* Comfort with analytics—can diagnose funnel drop-offs and design interventions based on data

*Campaign Architecture & Storytelling*

* Ability to design multi-channel integrated campaigns with a clear consumer journey from awareness to transaction
* Strong creative judgment—can evaluate and elevate creative work from agencies and internal studios
* Narrative design skills that make financial products emotionally compelling, not just functionally useful
* Experience creating viral-worthy social content and culturally resonant brand moments

*Experiential Marketing & Activation*

* Experience designing and executing consumer activations in retail environments, campuses, events, and festivals
* Understanding of how to create Instagram-worthy brand experiences that generate earned media
* Ability to measure the impact of experiential marketing on brand metrics and downstream transactions
* Creative approach to "phygital" experiences that bridge online engagement and offline action

*Strategic Orchestration & Influence*

* Can align Product, Sales, Business, and Creative teams around a unified consumer vision without direct authority
* Experience managing multiple agency partners (creative, media, experiential, PR) toward cohesive output
* Ability to build business cases that secure budget and resources for high-impact consumer initiatives
* Strong stakeholder management—can navigate organisational complexity and drive consensus

**Why Pine Labs**

Join us at an inflection point where fintech meets mass consumer adoption. You'll have the opportunity to introduce millions of first-time users to smart financial products that unlock aspirational consumption. Pine Labs processes tens of billions in transaction value annually—your campaigns will directly shape how a generation of Indian consumers discovers, adopts, and evangelizes new ways to pay. You'll work at the intersection of brand, product, and growth—a rare opportunity to build a category-defining consumer fintech brand.

**About The Job**
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
  
  
As a Product Manager leading the Transit and Mobile Recharge verticals within Google Pay (GPay) India, you will own the overall direction, strategy, and execution for two of GPay's highest-frequency engagement drivers. In this role, you will define end-to-end product roadmaps across daily-commute transit experiences as well as Mobile Recharge product strategy and growth across - Platform, AI experiences, UX, performance and more. You will serve as the core strategic owner bridging product innovation, internal cross-functional execution (Engineering, UX, Analytics, Legal, Business Development), and critical external ecosystem partnerships with Telecom companies, Aggregators, regulators, public transport operators, and more to scale daily and monthly usage and engagement amongst users across India.
  
  
Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for Transit and Mobile Recharge verticals on GPay India, translating complex daily utility needs and regulatory standards into intuitive, high-scale GPay experiences.
