jobs.title: Senior Product Manager ( Dostt )
jobs.description:
**About Lokal:**

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a  **house of focused apps,**  many products, one mission:   
 to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the  **Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts**  they ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

* **Emotional Well-being Peer Support**  - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt Eaze)
* **Astrology Guidance**  - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* **Edutainment Skill Learning**  - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* **Matrimonial Matchmaking**  - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* **Agri Consulting**  - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* **Local Jobs**  - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* **Social Community**  - Place to find post social updates (Lokal app)
* **Advisory Services**  - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a  **discovery and access platform**  : local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:   
 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre -  **access changes lives**  .

**We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.**

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

**About the Team:**  The Product Team at Lokal operates as the engine driving our house of apps model. We work at the intersection of deep Bharat user insights, cutting-edge AI, and business strategy. As a Group Product Manager, you will lead a squad of Product Managers and Product Analysts, taking end-to-end ownership of a major product vertical or portfolio of apps to scale engagement, monetization, and user retention.

**Role Overview:**

We are hiring a Product Manager / Senior Product Manager to lead key initiatives. Youll own high-impact projects across pricing, growth, user retention, expansion, and platform strategy-working closely with cross-functional teams to scale Products at Lokal.

**Responsibilities:**

+ **Drive product strategy**  to maximize conversion and retention through data-driven analysis of supply-side levers and their business impact.
+ **Own and enhance payment systems**  by improving payment success metrics, optimizing payment gateway (PG) integrations, and elevating the overall checkout experience.
+ **Design and run pricing experiments**  including default pricing, cohort-based pricing, discounting models, and repeat-user strategies to optimize revenue growth.
+ **Collaborate with Marketing**  to unlock and scale new acquisition channels while continuously optimizing performance.
+ **Strengthen trust and user satisfaction**  by defining and improving profile verification workflows and customer support processes.
+ **Partner cross-functionally**  with design, engineering, analytics, and business teams to execute, measure, and iterate on impactful solutions.
+ **Own the product roadmap**  , prioritizing initiatives based on business impact and user needs.
+ **Conduct market research**  to stay ahead of industry trends and incorporate insights into product strategy.
+ **Develop retention strategies**  to increase repeat revenue and long-term user engagement.
+ **Analyze user behavior**  and implement gamification mechanics to enhance user motivation and platform stickiness.

**What We re Looking For:**

+ 5 - 9 years of experience in product management, preferably in consumer internet or marketplace products.
+ Strong background in data-driven decision-making; must be mathematically sharp and investigative in approach.
+ Educational background from top-tier institutes preferred.
+ Prior experience in marketplaces or platforms with demand-supply matching problems is a strong plus.
+ Ability to think strategically and also roll up your sleeves to execute.
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

* At Lokal, we act like owners who take initiative beyond job descriptions, get things done despite obstacles, and maintain a growth mindset focused on learning. Were outcome-driven with bias for action, believing speed matters in building products for billion Indians. Decision-making involves open debate followed by full commitment, and we operate on context rather than control - managers share the "why" while you own execution. We aim to be an all-star team that thinks big and takes calculated risks to achieve ambitious goals.
* Be part of a fast-growing startup with 100M+ downloads and a footprint across 1000+ towns 250+ districts - huge scope for impact and learning.
* Opportunity for fast growth, professionally and personally, as you help expand into new areas and build things from scratch.
* Access comprehensive benefits, including insurance coverage, generous leave policies, ESOP buybacks, flexible work-from-home options, and more.

feasibility.
  
  

* Drive customer discovery alongside forward deployed engineers - conduct structured interviews with issuers and acquirers, synthesize operational workflow pain points into validated product requirements, and

distinguish symptoms from root causes.
  
  

* Translate PoC findings and field signal into scoped, shippable product briefs: clearly written requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that engineering teams can build against without returning to you

for clarification.
  
  

* Define and own the agent capability roadmap - which workflows get automated, in what sequence, at what level of AI autonomy - balancing customer readiness, data availability, and compliance constraints.
* Set and track outcome-oriented success metrics for each agent and platform capability; ensure the team is measuring actual customer impact (time saved, errors reduced, queries resolved) not just activity.
* Partner with engineering leads to make build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions; understand enough about how AI systems work to evaluate feasibility claims honestly without being captured by engineering

enthusiasm or conservatism.
  
  

* Own the compliance and governance interface: work with legal, security, and risk teams to ensure product decisions account for data classification, audit requirements, and approval gates - and translate those

constraints back into product requirements without losing velocity.
  
  

* Manage stakeholder expectations across business, technology, and customer-facing teams; communicate roadmap trade-offs clearly and defend prioritization decisions with evidence.
* Define the agent maturity model - the progression from informational to insight to recommendation to action - and own the criteria that determine when a capability is ready to advance to the next tier.
* Identify platform-level patterns across individual agent builds and advocate for shared infrastructure investments that accelerate future delivery rather than optimizing only for the next release.
* Contribute to pre-sales and commercial conversations as the product authority - set honest expectations on what AI can deliver today, what requires a roadmap investment, and what is out of scope.

**All About You**

* Master's or bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience in product management for data, analytics, or AI products.
* Proven track record owning and shipping AI or data products in enterprise B2B environments - you can point to products you defined that are in production and delivering measurable value.
* Deep understanding of the AI product lifecycle: from discovery and PoC through productization, compliance review, and post-launch iteration. You know which phase you are in and what the exit criteria are.
* Strong customer instinct: you have run discovery sessions with non-technical domain experts, translated messy operational workflows into clean product requirements, and caught requirements that sounded right but would not generalize.
* Comfortable with the economics of AI products - inference cost, latency trade-offs, model capability ceilings, evaluation rigor - well enough to make roadmap trade-offs without deferring every technical question to engineering.
* Experience managing products in regulated industries (financial services, payments, or comparable); you understand what compliance and data governance constraints actually mean for product scope, not just as a checkbox.
* Strong written communication: your PRDs, briefs, and roadmap documents are clear enough that stakeholders and engineers reach different parts of them for different reasons - and both find what they need.
* Sharp prioritization discipline: you can say no to a well-articulated customer request, explain why, and offer a path forward that serves the underlying need without expanding scope.
* Experience working in a platform-and-application product model: you understand the tension between shipping agent-specific features and investing in platform capabilities, and you make that trade-off deliberately.
* Collaborative leadership style with an ability to influence without authority - across engineering, design, data science, sales, and compliance functions that each have their own priorities.
* Familiarity with agentic AI concepts (tool use, retrieval, reasoning loops, guardrails, safety) at a level sufficient to write meaningful acceptance criteria and evaluate whether an implementation actually

meets the product intent.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Accounts & Finance Manager – Cross-Border E-commerce
jobs.description:
**Location:** Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** 7–12 Years  
**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Reporting To:** Director / CEO

Job Summary

We are hiring an experienced Accounts & Finance Manager to oversee financial operations across multiple Indian and international entities within our cross-border e-commerce business.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in accounting and financial reporting, marketplace reconciliations, international taxation, inventory accounting, cash flow management, statutory compliance and team management.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Manage accounting operations across multiple Indian and international entities.
* Ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures.
* Prepare and review P&L, Balance Sheets, Trial Balance and financial statements.
* Finalize monthly P&L by the 10th of every month.
* Review ledgers, bank accounts, credit cards, sales, purchases, creditors, debtors and intercompany transactions.
* Manage accruals, provisions, depreciation, prepaid expenses and forex adjustments.

**E-commerce Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Handle marketplace reconciliations across Amazon, Noon, eBay, Walmart, Lazada, Shopee, Shopify and other platforms.
* Reconcile marketplace sales, settlements, commissions, refunds, returns, chargebacks and deductions.
* Monitor marketplace receivables, delayed settlements and stuck payouts.
* Reconcile marketplace reports with bank statements and accounting records.
* Coordinate with operations and account management teams to resolve discrepancies.

**Financial MIS & Profitability Analysis**

* Prepare monthly financial MIS and consolidated financial reports.
* Analyse revenue, margins, expenses and business profitability.
* Conduct product, brand and marketplace-level profitability analysis.
* Prepare landed-cost calculations, logistics cost comparisons and breakeven analysis.
* Identify cost leakages and opportunities for cost optimization.
* Present financial performance and variance analysis to management.

**Inventory & Procurement Accounting**

* Reconcile inventory across books, warehouses, marketplace reports and operational trackers.
* Monitor inventory movements, stock ageing, purchases, returns and damaged stock.
* Conduct inventory verification and investigate stock discrepancies.
* Review purchase and procurement reconciliations.

**Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Manage GST, TDS, Income Tax, Tax Audit, Advance Tax, PT, PF and ESIC coordination.
* Handle export-related GST compliance, LUT renewals and refund applications.
* Coordinate international taxation, including UAE VAT and Corporate Tax, Saudi VAT and Zakat, USA tax compliance, Singapore GST and UK VAT.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants, auditors and external tax consultants.
* Manage transfer pricing, related-party compliance and applicable international tax documentation.

**Banking & Treasury**

* Manage banking operations across domestic and international entities.
* Monitor bank reconciliations, cash balances and fund movements.
* Manage Payoneer and other international payment accounts.
* Track foreign remittances, export proceeds and import payments.
* Coordinate with AD banks for EDPMS, IDPMS and remittance documentation.
* Monitor cash flow, forex exposure and intercompany fund transfers.

**Audit, Cost Control & Team Management**

* Coordinate internal, statutory, tax and international audits.
* Maintain financial controls, SOPs, documentation and compliance trackers.
* Review logistics and vendor invoices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Lead and supervise the Accounts & Finance team.
* Allocate responsibilities, review performance and train team members.
* Work closely with management on budgets, financial projections and business planning.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* CA / CA Inter / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com.
* 7–12 years of experience in Accounts & Finance.
* Minimum 3–5 years of managerial or team supervisory experience.
* Experience in e-commerce, retail, export-import, cross-border trade or multi-entity accounting preferred.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting and taxation.
* Experience in international entities, marketplace reconciliation and foreign currency transactions.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or other ERP/accounting software.
* Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookup functions and financial modelling.
* Strong analytical skills, leadership, ownership and attention to detail.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

We are seeking a hands-on Marketing Director of Innovation, Menu & Markets to grow KFC, the biggest chicken brand in the region, across the GCC, Levant and Morocco. This role is pivotal in leading the day-to-day marketing operations and the innovation agenda for the brand across all operating markets. The role owns the innovation pipeline, the menu architecture and the end-to-end execution of locally relevant marketing windows in every market, across dine-in, drive-thru and aggregator channels.

Provide advisory and center-of-excellence support to other markets as required. This includes strategic guidance during critical situations, recovery planning and support on key initiatives, such as strengthening menu and NPD plans, in collaboration with local teams.

**The right person is a true hustler: hands-on, action-oriented and relentless on execution, with a strong food palate, the ability to bring diverse stakeholders along, and a proven record of leading high-performing teams to drive operational and commercial excellence across markets.**

**Strategic Leadership: Future-proof the brand across Customer, Commercials, Competitiveness & Channels**

* Spot key customer and food trends early and shape brand strategy through relevant actions built into the 18-month plan that rolls into the AOP.

* Manage agency, supplier and aggregator partner relationships to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.

**Menu & NPD Leadership: Bring a strong food palate to every decision**

* Own the menu strategy and architecture across core, value, premium and limited-time offers, ensuring a balanced, profitable menu tailored to each market.
* Lead the culinary innovation agenda to enhance brand love and relevance, driving customer penetration and frequency through sustainable new product platforms.
* Bring a strong, discerning food palate to product development: lead taste panels, kitchen sessions and product sign-offs with R&D and suppliers, and push for products that win on taste, quality and consistency.
* Translate local flavor preferences and culinary trends into a robust NPD pipeline that is operationally feasible and commercially viable.

**Fortify & Future-Proof Brand Connect: Modernize the brand**

* Actively guide all local market actions to embed the brand in local culture while retaining its global stature.
* Ensure brand consistency and quality across all market communication and activations.

**Digital Marketing Excellence: Build a digitally native brand, in line with the customers of the future**

* Manage and leverage the aggregator channel to maximize revenue while delivering profitability objectives.
* Design market programs that shift customers towards dine-in and drive-thru habits.

**Financial Outcomes: Deliver profitable growth**

* Plan, monitor and adhere to resource allocation within budget, in line with Annual Operating Plan guidelines, and coach the team to do the same.

* Leverage insights from dedicated brand analysts to inform decision-making, optimize innovation and address menu gaps.

**Team Leadership: Build an enviable, high-performing, cohesive working environment**

* Lead and manage a diverse, multi-disciplinary team across all eight operating markets: onboard, coach and mentor team members, set clear goals and hold the team accountable for delivery.
* Provide functional leadership to the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership and innovation.
* Lead the brand agenda among cross-functional teams to accelerate delivery of the brand’s strategic objectives.
* Role-model Americana people practices and coach the team to build a strong talent bench.
* Be a strong advocate for the customer agenda within the KFC leadership team and a mentor for cross-functional teams.

* Expertise in building brand love to drive both customer penetration and frequency.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align senior leaders, the franchisor, country teams and cross-functional partners.
* A hustler mindset: hands-on, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity and driven to get things done at pace.

jobs.title: Vice President- Retail Credit Policy
jobs.description:
Job Purpose
  
• Manage portfolio risk strategy and performance management for unsecured retail assets, including credit cards, personal loans, BNPL and other digital lending products.
  
• Own the end-to-end risk decision framework across acquisition, account management, line assignment, pricing, collections and customer lifecycle management.
  
• Use advanced analytics, segmentation and AI/ML models to optimize growth, credit quality, customer outcomes and risk-adjusted profitability.
  
• Provide the senior leadership team with forward-looking portfolio insights, clear risk appetite recommendations and timely actions to maintain losses, returns and capital consumption within plan.
  
  
Key Result Areas
  
• Set and execute portfolio strategies for credit cards, personal loans, BNPL and emerging digital credit propositions, aligned with approved risk appetite, growth plans and regulatory requirements.
  
• Own portfolio performance across approval rates, activation, utilization, balances, yield, delinquencies, roll rates, loss rates, risk charge, vintage performance, expected credit loss, capital and risk-adjusted returns.
  
• Develop granular customer, product, channel, employer, income and behavioral segmentation to identify growth pockets, emerging risks and differentiated treatment strategies.
  
• Design and govern risk decision frameworks covering eligibility, score cut-offs, affordability, limits, tenor, pricing, line management, cross-sell, collections and exit strategies.
  
• Lead champion–challenger tests and controlled experiments; define success metrics, guardrails and post-implementation monitoring to scale profitable strategies safely.
  
• Partner with data science teams to develop, validate and deploy application, behavioral, propensity, fraud and early-warning models using traditional and alternative data.
  
• Establish responsible AI and model governance, including explainability, fairness, drift, stability, override, monitoring and human-oversight standards.
  
• Build executive dashboards, forecasts and scenario analyses linking risk drivers to revenue, margin, credit cost, operating expense, capital and lifetime customer profitability.
  
• Define early-warning indicators, portfolio triggers and remediation playbooks for adverse trends, concentration risks and macroeconomic or market shocks.
  
• Provide independent retail credit risk challenge for new products, partnerships, fintech propositions and material changes to customer journeys or decision engines.
  
• Ensure compliance with Central Bank requirements, internal policies, model risk standards, consumer protection expectations and audit requirements.
  
• Lead, coach and develop a high-performing portfolio analytics team and strengthen data-driven decision making across Retail Banking.
  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science or a related quantitative discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred.
  
• Experience: Typically 12–15 years in retail credit risk, portfolio management or risk analytics, including substantial leadership responsibility and direct exposure to credit cards, personal loans and digital lending/BNPL.
  
• Portfolio expertise: Proven ownership of acquisition and account-management strategies, vintages, roll rates, delinquency, loss forecasting, provisions, risk-adjusted profitability, limit management, collections strategies and portfolio optimization.
  
• Analytics and modeling: Strong command of statistical analysis, experimentation, segmentation, forecasting, scorecards and AI/ML applications across underwriting, behavioral risk, propensity, fraud and early warning.
  
• Technical capability: Hands-on proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical language such as Python, R or SAS; strong working knowledge of Power BI/Tableau, large datasets, data pipelines and cloud analytics environments.
  
• Decision frameworks: Demonstrated ability to translate analytics into executable cut-offs, pricing, limits, treatments and growth strategies with clear economics, controls and performance measurement.
  
• Governance: Sound understanding of model risk, responsible AI, explainability, fairness, data privacy, consumer protection, IFRS 9/provisioning concepts and Central Bank requirements relevant to retail lending.
  
• Leadership: Strong executive communication, stakeholder influence and people leadership, with the ability to challenge constructively and present complex risk-return choices to senior committees.

jobs.title: Gen AI Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us as a Gen AI Product Engineer
  
  

* In this key role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and scaling Generative AI (GenAI)-powered products and features that deliver tangible business value
* We’ll look to you to bridge product thinking and engineering execution, translating user needs into robust, production-ready AI solutions while driving innovation in the application of GenAI capabilities
* This is an opportunity to design and deliver production-grade GenAI solutions, including AI agents, conversational AI, and automation, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance
* We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do
  
  
As a Gen AI Product Engineer, you'll design, build, and deploy production-grade GenAI products and systems that turn user and business needs into secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. You'll also translate product and user requirements into scalable technical solutions, balancing model quality, latency, system complexity, and long-term maintainability, while building and integrating large language model (LLM) capabilities using modern frameworks and application programming interfaces (APIs).
  
  
This will include working across orchestration layers, retrieval pipelines, system integrations, prompt and context engineering, and model evaluation.
  
  
**You'll Also Be**

* Converting ambiguous product requirements and research concepts into robust technical architectures, balancing model capability, latency, cost, complexity, and maintainability
* Ensuring all GenAI solutions meet enterprise security, governance, responsible AI, and risk management standards, with appropriate controls, escalation, and mitigation built into delivery
* Developing and operating LLM solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, agent workflows, orchestration, prompt and content engineering, and model integration patterns
* Integrating GenAI capabilities into existing platforms through internal APIs, services, event flows, and data pipelines, ensuring resilience, observability, and maintainability in production environments
* Defining and applying approaches to model evaluation, benchmarking, monitoring, and continuous optimisation to improve quality, accuracy, reliability, and user outcomes
* Identifying and managing real-world AI system failure modes, including hallucinations, retrieval failures, tool-call errors, degraded model performance, and unsafe or non-compliant outputs
* Supporting production operations, including service monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and on-call responsibilities where required for business-critical GenAI systems

The skills you'll need
  
  
We're looking for someone with proven experience designing, building, and operating production-grade GenAI software systems, with strong capabilities in Python, front-end design frameworks, distributed systems, API design, cloud-native engineering, observability, and performance-critical workloads. You should also bring experience translating ambiguous research concepts, emerging AI capabilities, user needs, and product requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable production systems within fast-moving product or research-led environments.
  
  
To succeed in this role, you'll need experience delivering GenAI or LLM-powered products beyond the prototype stage, including self-hosted model inference with frameworks such as vLLM, OpenAI-compatible serving patterns, orchestration layers, software development kit integration, and production systems. You must also bring a practical understanding of LLM application architecture, including prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, agent workflows, tool-calling patterns, memory and context management, and the mitigation of real-world AI system failure modes.
  
  
**You'll Also Demonstrate**

* An understanding of model training, fine-tuning, adaptation, inference, and serving pipelines, including trade-offs in model selection, performance, cost, reliability, scalability, and operational complexity
* Experience evaluating, monitoring, and optimising AI systems, with working knowledge of responsible AI, model risk, security, governance, and operational controls in enterprise or regulated environments
* Hands-on experience deploying small language models for latency-, cost-, privacy-, or domain-specific use cases

jobs.description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are seeking a
**senior business Product Owner**
for the Insurance Accounting product within State Street’s Fund Accounting and Administration platform. This role represents accounting, operational, regulatory, and client needs and serves as a senior business authority across complex functional areas and strategic initiatives.
  
  
This is
**not a technical product owner role**
. While the position partners closely with technology and development teams, accountability is focused on
**business requirements, accounting logic, client outcomes, regulatory compliance, product strategy and prioritization**
, rather than system architecture or technical solution design.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The Vice President, Product Owner plays a critical role in ensuring that product capabilities and enhancements accurately reflect insurance and investment accounting requirements and deliver meaningful value to clients. By acting as the voice of the business, this role ensures solutions are fit for purpose, compliant, and aligned with product strategy, while enabling efficient and effective delivery through agile development teams. The role also drives alignment across business and technology stakeholders, and supports investment decisions for complex, multi-year initiatives.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As the Vice President, Product Owner, you will act as a
**senior business lead and subject matter expert**
for the Insurance Accounting product and related strategic initiatives. Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Serving as one of the primary business authorities for insurance accounting functionality and related reporting
* Communicating product direction and measurable business outcomes for assigned product capabilities
* Leading complex product initiatives and enhancements that span multiple business processes, client segments, or delivery teams
* Engaging clients and internal stakeholders to understand needs, priorities, and impacts
* Leading business analysis and functional design efforts; creating clear business design documents and requirements
* Defining accounting ledger entries, multi-cost basis behavior, and accounting outcomes for enhancements
* Establishing needs for reporting solutions and ensuring alignment with accounting, regulatory, and client requirements
* Translating business and accounting requirements into well-defined epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Providing business use cases and functional testing scenarios
* Providing senior-level oversight of testing strategy and validating accounting accuracy, control effectiveness, and business outcomes
* Partnering with product management, development, operations, client service, and other stakeholders to manage dependencies, resolve issues, and maintain an actionable backlog
* Assisting with product roadmaps and longer-term functional direction, including recommendations for modernization
* Overseeing delivery of enhancements through iterative planning, prioritizing business value and client impact
* Identifying cross-product and data dependencies and driving alignment across accounting, reporting, operational, and client-facing capabilities
* Creating and maintaining user documentation
* Delivering training sessions, and product demonstrations for internal teams and current or prospective clients
* Supporting software maintenance and client service teams with business-level troubleshootingAssisting onboarding teams and clients with conversions and implementations, as needed

**What We Value**
The following skills and attributes will help you succeed in this role:
  
  

* Strategic product leadership and the ability to translate business objectives into clear product direction and priorities
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, including the ability to make informed decisions in complex or ambiguous situations
* Deep analytical and research capabilities
* Sound accounting judgment and attention to financial details
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously
* Clear and effective communication with a wide range of stakeholders
* Strong presentation and written communication skills
* Ability to build alignment and drive accountability across complex initiatives
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft tools (Copilot, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field; advanced degree, CPA, CFA, or relevant product experience is preferred.
* 12+ years of experience as a business Product Owner, product leader, or senior end user of insurance, fund accounting, or financial software
* OR 12+ years of experience as a senior business analyst, business Product Owner, or product leader supporting financial or accounting platforms
* Demonstrated experience leading complex product initiatives
* Strong experience with insurance accounting and/or investment accounting, including complex asset classes (e.g., fixed income, derivatives, mortgage loans, alternative investments)
* Knowledge of inbound and outbound data flows across the investment lifecycle (e.g., trade processing, cash, market data)
* Experience leading within an agile software development environment as a business Product Owner, product leader, or senior business analyst
* Significant experience working directly with clients and other stakeholders
* Experience with AI tools and applying them to improve product development, analysis, and day-to-day business processes

*This role does not require hands-on software development, system architecture design, or technical solution ownership.*
**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**
We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.
  
  
**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
The Core Engineering
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e.g., Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm’s compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm’s liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc.; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units:
  
  

* Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

**What We Look For**
This VP Software Engineer role is for a professional who is passionate about bringing business impact through digital transformation and deployment of scalable and reliable software solutions.
  
  
The Core divisions have a large footprint of software applications to ensure the firm complies with the controls set forth in its policies and risk appetite, meet its regulatory obligations, and to protect the firm’s reputation. To meet the demand of the business, drive by the size and complexity of the entire firm, the candidate will have the mandate to continuously increase the level of automation and to modernize and consolidate our software stacks. In addition, data is at the center of what we do. The successful candidate will have demonstrated experiences in and a passion for solving critical problems related to data quality, warehousing, and analytics.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential (responsibilities)**

* Work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment that provides exposure to all areas of Finance
* Build strong relationships with business partners
* Understand business needs, facilitating and developing process workflow, data requirements, and specifications required to support implementation
* Develop technical specifications, high level/detailed design, testing strategies, and implementation plans from business requirements
* Define and govern scalable, secure, and cost-optimized architecture
* Leverage AI tools, i.e Devin, Claude etc to improve development efficiency and innovation
* Ensure strong cloud governance including security, compliance, and cost control
* Manage end-to-end systems development cycle from requirements analysis, coding, testing, UAT and maintenance
* Exploring new and emerging technologies as needed by the project.
* Drive program execution, manage risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations
* Collaborate with business leaders to align technology with strategic goals

**Skills And Relevant Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related technical discipline
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software development, including a clear understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design, core programming concepts and experiences with continuous delivery and deployment, preferably 2+ years of experience with AWS services.
* Deep understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, and system design
* Strong problem solver, organized and able to work in a fast-paced environment with delivery focus as part of a global team
* Exposure to AI/ML tools and modern engineering practices preferred
* Excellent communicator who is comfortable engaging stakeholders, both verbally and written
* Preferably experienced in managing small to mid-size teams
* Strong programming experience in at least one compiled language (e.g. Java, C++, python)
* Full Stack experience with industry standard frameworks and tools (e.g. React, SpringBoot, DropWizard, Maven, Web/RESTful service development)
* Knowledge of relational and columnar SQL databases, including database design

jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and resourceful product manager to join our Investment Services Technology team, partnering closely with the Compliance team, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. This position offers the opportunity for broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and software development groups, as well as the chance to manage real-time issues related to the firm’s expanding suite of global investment products in a dynamic, constantly evolving regulatory environment. The role offers an inclusive and dynamic environment, with a focus on improving technology for efficiency, control, and scalability. The ideal candidate will bring exceptional product management fundamentals, experience in process optimization and workflow automation, and the judgment to operate effectively in a highly regulated and confidential environment with diverse stakeholders.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will drive technological solutions that support critical compliance functions across the firm, collaborating with cross-functional teams — engineering, design, business, and other front- and back-office partners — to develop and launch new products and features. You will develop and maintain a strategic product roadmap that aligns with the firm's overall goals and evolves continuously based on user feedback, prioritization, and other factors while working with senior leadership in Compliance. You will also partner closely with the business to understand their needs, define product requirements, scope open-ended projects, and conceptualize effective solutions across a broad range of functional areas, including pre-trade compliance and trade-restriction management, position-limit monitoring, trade surveillance, and regulatory and transaction reporting. Additionally, you will conduct technical design and architecture reviews to ensure alignment with the roadmap and end-user needs and partner with engineering to address technical challenges and deliver on time and to specification. You will evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, replace legacy and vendor systems with scalable in-house platforms, and develop AI- and data-enabled tools for monitoring, detection, and reporting — balancing near-term regulatory and operational needs against long-term strategic and architectural objectives, often building scalable infrastructure in areas with limited existing technology while serving as a senior point of coordination for compliance technology transformation. Furthermore, you will monitor product usage and feedback to identify areas for improvement and address technical debt in a timely manner, maintain product documentation (requirements documents, user guides, and more), conduct training and enablement as a subject-matter expert for the product suite, and manage product launches and backlogs — prioritizing features and enhancements based on end-user feedback and business needs.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, a related field, or an MBA, with 8+ years of product management experience, preferably within the financial services or investment management industry
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and operational concepts clearly, influence decision-making through both meetings and written artifacts, and engage effectively with diverse stakeholder groups
* Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities, with proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques to generate product insights, prioritize initiatives, measure outcomes, and guide product strategy
* Proven adaptability in managing changing priorities, with robust project and delivery management skills in dynamic environments
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and business teams, translating nontechnical needs into clear requirements while balancing competing stakeholder priorities, building consensus, and delivering customer-focused outcomes
* A high degree of attention to detail and structured problem-solving abilities, with a consistent focus on quality, risk awareness, and operational excellence
* Hands-on experience owning and delivering technology products end-to-end in Agile environments, from product vision and discovery through backlog management, iterative delivery, launch, scaling, and ongoing maturation
* Demonstrated expertise in workflow automation and process optimization, applying structured approaches and tools to improve efficiency, transparency, and control
* A solid understanding of operational workflows within hedge funds and investment management firms, including how controls, data integrity, and regulatory considerations shape technology and product design

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Exposure to the investment management or hedge fund domain, with familiarity with pre-trade compliance, trade restrictions, position limits, trade surveillance, or regulatory and transaction reporting
* Experience partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk, or other control functions to define requirements and deliver workflow-driven, compliant technology solutions

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PMComplyTechOct26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.

As a manager of Data & Analytics, you will need to liaise with Compliance Test Managers to understand compliance activities and define Analytical & automation solutions to drive efficient Compliance Testing and define new compliance Testing models using analytics.
  
  
You will lead a team of highly talented and creative team, proficient with the use of tolls and technologies like Python, UiPath, Alteryx, ThoughtSpot & SQL, who will deploy these analytical and automation solutions.
  
  
You will need to explore data strategies across LOBs and leverage them effectively and efficiently to build analytical and automation solutions.
  
  
Apart from defining and deploying analytical solutions who will also look to support the build out of analytical solution libraries to generate efficiency and fuel a citizen developer program.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Program management and Delivery ownership: Drive the delivery of projects for the Control Testing center of Excellence (TCoE) within / across lines of business. Manage a team of skilled Analytics team. Manage concurrent deliveries, which could include data extractions, basic to advanced analytical solutions, dashboards / automated reports, and ML solution deployments. Build a library of Analytics linked to the Operational and compliance Risk they seek to manage and make it available for re use with subsequent Control Testing cycles. Work with the AI / ML governance team to train, test and deploy models, to ensure controls related to the use of AI / ML models for estimation are adhered to
* Drive the delivery of business insights to strengthen controls and management of risks: Leverage basic data exploration techniques (Descriptive and prescriptive/predictive analytics) to support current testing routines that seek to measure compliance to the various laws, regulations, and guidelines. Design, build, and execute data quality controls that ensure completeness and accuracy on risk datasets and reports.
* Build and maintain strong stakeholder engagement: Establish and maintain a consistent dialog and strong relationship with Control Testing managers & leaders across the TCoE, to enable better management & growth the Book of Work / engagements.
* Define, manage and expand the ‘Toolkit': Partner with the Technology team to identify & champion new tools and technologies to deliver stronger analytical solutions that enhance the way operational and compliance risks are managed. Current tools include Alteryx, Tableau, COGNOS, Python, ThoughtSpot & UiPath
* Timely and accurate reporting: Provide timely and relevant information through appropriate reporting mechanisms (scorecards, dashboards, monthly management meetings). Design on demand data visualizations / presentations to communicate complexity, scale & impact of solutions/delivery.
* Adherence to Firm wide Controls framework associated with the creation of Analytical solutions: Understand the controls associated with the creation, deployment and re use of analytics, and ensure adherence consistently and in the most efficient manner.
* Document requirements associated with the analytical solutions built to enable Control Testing activities in the TCoE:
* Document Business Requirements and generate SOPs for handover of automation to the CCOR Testing team for use as BAU activity.
* Update Process control Test papers, that document the data extraction, Automation and Analytics approach to extract data / Automate Compliance Testing activities / Drive deeper insights into Compliance Test results.

* Post graduate program with Data Analytics and Automation from a leading institute / University.
* Minimum 12 years of experience in Automation and Analytics
* Proven track record of managing large portfolios of projects; managing delivery in an environment with diverse automation solutions like Python / Alteryx / UiPath etc.
* Experience as a Business Analyst / Product manager will be a plus.
* Experience of working in an Audit / Testing / Compliance or risk management environment will be additionally preferred but not mandatory.
* Strong Executive presence, presentation skills and excellent oral and written communication skills
* Growth Mindset: Actively contribute to building and exemplifying a continuous learning mindset, bringing in new ideas and perspectives that stretch the thinking of the group.
* Confidentiality and Discretion: Maintain the highest standards of confidentiality and professionalism when handling sensitive information.
* Ability to supervise, develop and implement state of the art, fully scalable – various machine learning models / algorithms for risk detection, classification, prediction to aid in continuous monitoring and testing activities. (In partnership with the Machine learning deployment management team)
* Highly proficient with the use of MS Power point, MS Excel, and MS Word

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the India Demat Team within India International Wealth and Premier Banking as Assistant Vice President – Demat Operations.

  

**Role Purpose**

  

The role holder will manage end-to-end depository participant operations within a regulated bank environment, encompassing demat account opening and servicing, settlement monitoring, reconciliations, income and DP charge controls, and regulatory reporting. The role will ensure accurate and timely execution in accordance with applicable SEBI requirements, NSDL/CDSL rules and bye-laws, PMLA, and HSBC policies and operating procedures.

  

The incumbent will drive operational efficiency and customer service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services, maintain robust risk and control standards, manage audit and regulatory review requirements, and implement regulatory and system changes within prescribed timelines.

  

**Principal Accountabilities**

* + Oversee demat account opening, modification, servicing and closure, including verification of client documentation and KYC/AML requirements, periodic account reviews, and corporate demat requests.
  + Ensure accurate and timely processing of dematerialisation and rematerialisation requests (DRF/RRF), Delivery Instruction Slips (DIS), pledge, un-pledge and invocation requests, and off-market and inter-depository transfers.
  + Monitor settlement cycles and ensure timely reconciliation with depositories and clearing corporations.
  + Oversee daily, weekly and monthly reconciliations of client holdings, DP balances, suspense accounts and control accounts; investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks.
  + Manage provisioning of income entries and reconciliation of DP charges in coordination with Finance/Accounts.
  + Prepare and submit regulatory and depository reports within prescribed timelines and maintain accurate MIS for management review and compliance oversight.

**Customers / Stakeholders**

  

* + Manage DP-related customer queries, grievances and escalations in coordination with branches, relationship and service teams, ensuring timely resolution.
  + Liaise with NSDL/CDSL, registrars and transfer agents (RTAs), Finance/Accounts, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to resolve servicing and operational matters.
  + Drive customer-centric improvements in turnaround time and service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services.
  + Act as the principal contact for Demat operational and regulatory matters across Operations, Compliance, Legal, Technology, Risk, Finance, Treasury, the business and relevant depositories.
  + Coordinate responses to regulatory queries, inspections, internal and external audits, and compliance reviews.
  + Drive cross-functional actions independently, secure clear ownership and deliver within agreed timelines.
  + Provide concise management reporting on key operational risks, regulatory actions, exceptions and outstanding deliverables.
  + Promote disciplined execution, clear accountability and strong collaboration across first- and second-line stakeholders.

* **Leadership and Teamwork**
  

* + Demonstrate ownership and accountability for assigned DP operations and coordinate with stakeholders to meet operational, regulatory and audit deadlines.
  + Work collaboratively with branches, service teams, Compliance, Finance and Technology on regulatory implementation, escalations and process changes.

* **Operational Effectiveness & Control**
  

* Conduct periodic process and control reviews to identify operational and regulatory risks.
* Own audit and inspection observations, agree remediation plans and ensure timely, evidenced closure.
* Monitor implementation of regulatory and product changes and confirm that required controls operate effectively.
* Proactively identify and escalate material operational, regulatory, conduct or control risks.
* Regulatory and business deliverables completed within prescribed timelines.
* Timely and sustainable closure of audit, inspection, compliance and control actions.
* Accuracy and completeness of regulatory trackers, governance records, evidence and management information.
* Reduction in repeat exceptions, overdue actions and material control gaps.
* Effective implementation of regulatory, product and process changes with appropriate documentation and stakeholder sign-off.
* Positive stakeholder feedback and effective escalation of material risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation and digitisation to reduce manual intervention and operational errors.
* Track new and revised regulatory and depository circulars and implement required process and control changes within defined timelines.

Citi operates through five major business divisions — Services, Markets, Banking and International, Wealth, and U.S. Personal Banking. Each of these generates complex financial data and transactions that require robust technology infrastructure. Technology and Business Enablement is the division that cuts across all of them, providing shared platforms, controls, and transformation programs. Key responsibility will be to define Product vision, strategy and roadmap, develop solution proposals, business cases, solution design and tactics in engagement with Business and Technology stakeholders.

This role will be responsible for leading business process redesign, map existing and to-be processes for operational optimization, digital transformation initiatives.

With Data at the heart of everything we do, this role will require strong data analytical skills (using programming or AI tools), tracing lineage of data, and developing conceptual and logical data models.

The role is expected to drive cross-functional collaboration and effective communication with business and technology partners, to guide, influence and convince others and lay the direction for Product development.

* Defines and measures the KPIs for a platform product

* Is able to make trade-off decisions on multiple platform products in a portfolio

* Drive stakeholder alignment and iterative product delivery

* Lead business process redesign, operational optimization, digital transformation initiative and change management

* Manage cross-functional dependencies, regulatory and risk alignment, user adoption and change management.

If you've been experimenting with new models, new tooling, or new patterns, that's exactly the kind of thinking we want in the room.

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**

Our people make all the difference in our success.

-

**About us:**

Analytics Information management (AIM) is a global community that is driving data driven transformation across Citi in multiple functions with the objective to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. We are a fast-growing organization working with Citi businesses and functions across the world.

**What do we offer:**

FCDO team manages the implementation of best-in-class data quality measurement programs across globe in retail consumer bank. The critical areas we support:

* **Data Governance**: Standardization of data definitions and ensuring consistency in usage as per definitions across systems/products/regions.
* **Meta Data Management**: Leveraging data lineage, data discovery initiatives and creation of enterprise level meta data for all retail consumer products
* **Data Ownership**: Identifying trusted data sources, data owners and consumers across process and products
* **Issue Management**: Identifying defects and investigating root causes for different issues. Following up with stakeholders and creation of plan for resolution as per SLA
* **Audit Support**: Identifying cases on control gaps, policy breaches and providing data evidence for audit completion
* **Data Certification**: Developing procedures on data certification and certifying as per fit for purpose criteria

**Expertise Required:**

Data/Information Mgt Sr Analyst is responsible for ensuring the organization’s data is accurate, complete, consistent, and reliable to support strategic planning and operational efficiency. This role involves profiling data to identify flaws, authoring data quality rules to prevent issues, monitoring data pipelines, managing metadata and remediate data concerns. This person will also be responsible to design, develop, and deploy scalable AI-powered solutions that enhance enterprise workflows and decision-making. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering skills with hands-on experience in machine learning and generative AI systems, including LLM-based applications and AI agents.

**Metadata Management and Data Governance**

* **Maintain Data Catalog/Dictionary:** Document and maintain business, technical, and operational metadata, including data lineage, definitions, and data standards.
* **Data Lineage Mapping:** Utilize metadata to map data lineage, understanding how data flows from source systems to downstream reporting to identify potential impact areas.
* **Policy Compliance:** Ensure all data assets adhere to defined data governance policies and data privacy regulations.

**Data Profiling and Analysis**

* **Profiling Execution:** Perform deep profiling of large datasets to understand data structure, patterns, and content, identifying hidden anomalies or missing information.
* **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):** Investigate data quality issues to determine the root cause, distinguishing between upstream processing errors and data entry errors.
* **Data Assessment:** Evaluate critical data elements (CDEs) for accuracy and completeness.

**Data Quality Rule Creation and Authoring**

* **Rule Definition:** Collaborate with business stakeholders to define and validate business rules for data validation (e.g., completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity).

* **Validation Logic:** Document validation logic and exception-handling procedures for critical datasets.

**Data Monitoring and Reporting**

* **Continuous Monitoring:** Actively monitor data pipelines, ETL processes, and dashboards to proactively identify DQ issues and operational anomalies.
* **DQ Dashboards/Scorecards:** Develop and maintain data quality metrics and scorecards to report on data accuracy trends to leadership.
* **Alerting:** Set up automated alerts for breach of data quality thresholds.

**Data Concern Remediations**

* **Issue Resolution:** Identify, document, and triage data quality issues through a tracking system.
* **Remediation Action Plans:** Develop and execute remediation plans, including data cleansing efforts and automated corrections.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with data stewards, IT, and developers to resolve data issues and implement long-term solutions.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficient in Python, SAS, SQL, Teradata, Collibra
* Experience with prompt engineering
* Experience building LLM-based applications, AI agents, or autonomous workflows
* Exposure to LangChain / LangGraph frameworks
* Exposure to creating multi-agent orchestration

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Credit Card Sales
jobs.description:
**About WeRize**

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).

This customer segment is not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health/life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit.

While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t work for this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a high-impact, business-driven
**Chief Manager / Associate Director – Credit Card Sales**
to lead and scale our Credit Card vertical. In this role, you will be responsible for building end-to-end sales strategies, managing banking and co-branded card partnerships, and scaling credit card distribution across our social freelance partner network in 5,000+ small towns.

You will act as the single point of contact between bank partners, internal product/tech teams, and our freelancer channel to drive high-volume, cost-effective, and compliant credit card issuance tailored to India’s middle-income segment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Sales Execution**

* Own the P&L, sales targets, and portfolio growth for the Credit Cards vertical across 5,000+ towns.
* Formulate and execute scalable sales strategies to drive credit card adoption through our unique tech-enabled freelancer distribution platform (
  **‘Finance ki Online Dukaan’**
  ).
* Analyze regional performance, conversion funnels, and customer approval rates to continuously optimize sales pipelines.

**Partnership & Ecosystem Management**

* Onboard, manage, and scale partnerships with leading banks, card issuers, and fintech partners.
* Collaborate with partner institutions to design customer journeys, credit policies, and product variants tailored to Tier 2/3/4 customer profiles.
* Serve as the key liaison for day-to-day operations, SLA management, and approval rate optimizations with partner banks.

**Partner Enablement & Channel Engagement**

* Work alongside channel and marketing teams to design training modules, sales enablement toolkits, and commission/incentive structures for local freelancers.
* Drive engagement, active sourcing, and product cross-selling across the freelancer network to maximize card issuance.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with internal Product, Tech, and Analytics teams to enhance digital application flows, minimize friction, and automate approval pipelines.
* Ensure strict adherence to RBI guidelines, partner bank compliance, data privacy, and ethical selling practices across the freelance network.

**Qualifications & Skill Set**

* **Experience:**
  8 to 15 years of core experience in Credit Card sales, partner management, or unsecured lending within Banks, NBFCs, or Fintechs.
* **Distribution Expertise:**
  Proven track record in scaling financial products through indirect channels, agency networks, DSAs, or tech-enabled social/freelancer distribution.
* **Banking Partnerships:**
  Prior experience managing relationships, integrations, and SLAs with major credit card issuing banks.
* **Data-Driven Approach:**
  Deep understanding of approval funnels, customer acquisition metrics (CAC, LTV), and credit underwriting basics for middle-income segments.
* **Entrepreneurial Mindset:**
  Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, solve unstructured problems, and take complete ownership of product-line growth.

**Campaign Execution & Performance Balance**
You will oversee key brand launches and high-stakes campaigns to ensure speed does not compromise quality.
  
  
You will collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Brand teams to protect brand integrity while meeting aggressive timeline demands.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Creative Mastery & Craft**
Deep experience in brand storytelling, content strategy or creation, high stakes execution at scale. across multi-channel environments (digital, visual, social, video).
  
  
A strong, proven portfolio that reflects deep attention to detail, diversity, narratives and formats. Clear editorial judgment with a track record of upholding brand integrity against low-quality, generic asset production.
  
  
**Understanding of YouTube as the growth engine**
Deep experience and understanding of building YouTube playbook: formats, series, packaging (titles, thumbnails, hooks), retention, search and discovery, and the long-form and Shorts mix.
  
  
Understand how to grow subscribers, watch time and return viewership through programming, not one-off campaigns, that leads to business growth.
  
  
Build YouTube capability across your team and agencies.
  
  
**Marketing Domain & Leadership Depth**
10 to 12 or more years of experience in creative leadership, brand strategy, or advertising agencies / high-growth consumer brands.
  
  
Proven track record of managing and mentoring teams of marketers, or creative strategists.
  
  
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to articulate creative decisions clearly to business leaders and technical teams.
  
  
Experience in fintech, e-commerce, or high-growth consumer tech is highly preferred.
  
  
**Mindset to Succeed**
You believe that Brand marketing leads to revenue growth and enjoy it!
  
  
**Craft Ownership:**
You take personal pride in the visual and narrative quality of everything PhonePe puts into the market. You reject mediocrity and generic content.
  
  
**Human-First Technology Approach:**

**Systems Thinking:**

**Role & responsibilities**

  

The department head (HOD) has the sole responsibility of running the academic programs of a department successfully.He/she has to follow the set rules and standards of the University in the delivery of the program. He/she reports to the Dean/ Director of the school.

He/she has the following duties and responsibilities:

1. To act as the administrative and academic head of the department in executing the teaching and learning aspects of the department.
2. To take advice/sanction from the dean for implementation of academic, co-curricular and extracurricular activities.
3. To assign duties to teaching and non-teaching staff of the department in consultation with the dean/director.

8. To ensure smooth conduct of examinations including paper setting, assessment of theory and lab.
9. To ensure quality, maintenance and cleanliness of the department.
10. To forward leave applications of the departmental colleagues.
11. To motivate faculty towards research proposals to various research funding agencies.
12. To encourage research and innovative programs in the department.
13. To invite guest speakers for interaction and guidance to students.
14. To facilitate faculty in the preparation and processing of self-appraisal of performance.
15. To ensure that school/college equipment/facilities under the departments control are properly maintained and serviced as required.

EDUCATION Masters Degree or Ph.D (Doctor of Philosophy) in Psychology/Clinical Psychology
