jobs.description:
**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Customer Service & Operations  
**Designation:** Customer Service Executive  
**Location:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Office-based  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Reporting To:** Customer Service Manager / Head of Operations  
**Salary:** As per experience and suitability (Fixed + Performance Incentive)

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financial services company focused on providing responsible, accessible and technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved customer segments.

The company offers financing solutions across multiple customer categories and is expanding its digital lending and financial services operations.

At Loan2grow, we believe that a good customer experience is central to responsible lending. We aim to make financial services accessible, transparent and convenient through technology-enabled platforms and responsive customer support.

2. About the Role

We are looking for customer-oriented and proactive professionals to join our Customer Service & Operations team as Customer Service Executives.

The selected candidates will be responsible for handling customer queries, providing assistance throughout the loan application and servicing journey, resolving customer complaints and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

F. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.
* Work with Credit teams to obtain updates on loan applications and pending verifications.
* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.
* Work with Collections teams on repayment-related customer queries and payment confirmation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation and account-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, queries, complaints and service requests.
* Update customer interactions and service request status in the CRM or designated systems.
* Maintain daily customer service reports covering:
* Total inbound and outbound calls.
* Customer queries received.
* Customer requests registered.
* Complaints received and resolved.
* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.
* Escalated complaints.
* Customer follow-up status.
* Share daily and weekly performance updates with the reporting manager.
* Identify recurring customer issues and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, telecalling, contact centres or customer relationship management.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable handling inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to handle multiple customer queries and service requests simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, digital lending, microfinance or other financial services organisations.
* Experience handling loan-related customer queries and servicing requests.
* Familiarity with loan application processes, KYC documentation and digital onboarding.
* Experience resolving EMI, repayment and payment-related queries.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Exposure to complaint management and customer grievance resolution.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and query resolution.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Patience and empathy in customer interactions.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations.
* Follow-up and service

jobs.title: Sales & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Company:**

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

**Role Overview**

As City Manager – Sales & Operations, Bengaluru, you will own our business in the city end to end. You will bring in new NBFC and bank customers, and you will make sure that every customer we sign is onboarded smoothly, served well and keeps growing with us. You will run the city like a business unit: pipeline, revenue, delivery quality and client satisfaction are all yours.

This role suits someone who enjoys being in front of credit, legal and collections leaders at lending institutions, and who also likes making operations run cleanly behind the scenes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development (approx. 60%)**

•Find, prospect and acquire new NBFCs, banks (private, small finance, cooperative), HFCs and MFIs headquartered or with major operations in Bengaluru and Karnataka.

•Build and manage a healthy pipeline: research target accounts, map decision-makers (Heads of Collections, Legal, Credit Operations, Risk, IT/Digital) and run multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

**B. City Operations & Client Delivery (approx. 40%)**

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

* Coordinate with internal product, tech, legal and support teams to resolve client issues and escalations quickly.

* Make sure clients receive timely MIS and delivery reports, and review account health with them regularly (monthly reviews and QBRs).

* Track usage, wallet/billing status and collections on invoices for city accounts, and follow up on receivables.

* Manage local vendors and partners (printing, dispatch, courier and field partners) where needed.

* Capture client feedback and feature requests and pass them to the product team in a structured way.

* As the city grows, hire, train and lead a small team of sales and operations executives.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New NBFC and bank customers signed per quarter

* Revenue and pipeline value against target

* Time from signature to go-live for new clients

* SLA adherence for notice dispatch, eSign and ODR delivery

* Client retention, expansion revenue and cross-sell across products

* Receivables collected on time

**Requirements Must have**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B / enterprise sales, account management or operations in BFSI, fintech, legal-tech or SaaS.

* A proven record of selling to NBFCs and/or banks, with an existing network among collections, legal, credit or operations leaders.

* Understanding of the lending lifecycle in India — loan origination, documentation, collections, NPA recovery and legal/recovery processes (SARFAESI, Section 138 NI Act, arbitration).

* Comfort managing operational processes, SLAs and client escalations.

* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets and preparing MIS reports.

* Willing to travel within Bengaluru and Karnataka for client meetings. Good to have

* Experience selling eSign, eStamp, legal notice, collections or ODR solutions.

* Exposure to RBI digital lending guidelines and outsourcing norms for regulated entities.

* Experience setting up or scaling a city or regional business from an early stage.

* Experience hiring and leading a small team.

**What We Offer**

* A chance to build and own a city business at an early-stage, fast-growing legal-tech company.

* Direct work with the founding team and real influence on product and go-to-market.

* Competitive fixed pay plus a performance-linked incentive plan.

* A clear growth path to Regional / Zonal Head as we expand to more cities.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About this role**

As a part of our team, you'll help us shape a platform that works for One — a business owner, an artist, a freelancer. In this role, you will build and manage a growth system based on data, AI, and user intent, transforming marketing from a communication function into a real-time decision layer. We provide the space for you to exercise true strategic autonomy, stripping away micromanagement so you can integrate marketing directly into the product, drive user acquisition and retention through intent detection, and evolve UMO into a trusted financial assistant end-to-end.

**You'll take ownership of:**

* **Growth & Decision Layer (The Core):**
  Build an intent detection and decisioning system based on user data. Integrate marketing directly into the product (product-led growth) to drive "one intent -> one action" logic, shaping the user's experience by correctly reacting to their state in the moment.
* **Data & MarTech Architecture:**
  Build our first-party data strategy, developing the CDP, data layer, event tracking, and data clean rooms while maintaining data quality, structure, and accessibility for automated decisioning.
* **Customer Lifecycle & Personalization:**
  Design the end-to-end customer journey, transitioning from traditional segments to individual scenarios powered by behavior, context, financial status, and life event triggers.
* **Go-to-Market & Growth Execution:**
  Develop GTM strategies for new products and markets while managing performance, partnership, and product-led acquisition channels focused on LTV, engagement, and value delivered.
* **Brand & Trust:**
  Shape UMO's positioning as an AI-native financial assistant and trusted decision layer, ensuring absolute communication consistency across all customer touchpoints.
* **Compliance & Data Governance:**
  Ensure strict compliance with GDPR, privacy rules, advertising standards, and consent management frameworks in close coordination with CISO, Risk, and Legal teams.
* **Analytics & Intelligence:**
  Build a real-time metrics system measuring intent detection accuracy, context conversions, LTV, retention, and value delivered.
* **Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment:**
  Lead Growth, Data, Marketing, and CRM/Lifecycle teams while partnering closely with Product, Tech, AI, Risk, and Compliance.

**About you:**

* **Executive Growth Leadership:**
  You have extensive commercial experience in a senior marketing or growth leadership capacity (at least 7+ years) within high-growth fintech, tech, or data-driven digital environments.
* **Data & AI-Native Architecture:**
  You feel at home building first-party data strategies, CDPs, and event-tracking frameworks, leveraging AI tooling and predictive models to turn raw data into actionable decision engines.
* **Product-Led Growth (PLG) Depth:**
  You have proven experience driving acquisition, engagement, and retention directly through product workflows rather than relying solely on external ad campaigns.
* **Regulated Environment & Compliance:**
  You understand data protection principles, GDPR, advertising regulations, and consent governance, ensuring data is used transparently and in the user's best interest.
* **Autonomous Milestone Execution:**
  You manage complex growth goals comfortably, taking complete end-to-end problem ownership over market entry, LTV metrics, and product-led journeys.
* **Transparent & Supportive Leadership:**
  You communicate openly, foster cross-functional collaboration with product and tech teams, and prioritize an absolute zero-tolerance policy for rudeness or politics.
* **Linguistic Fluency:**
  You speak and write English fluently to comfortably lead global teams and align cross-functional executive tracks.

**Can get you a few bonus points:**

* **Fintech & Digital Asset Background:**
  Prior experience building growth systems or personalized financial products within fintech, neobanks, or regulated web3 platforms.
* **MarTech & AI Tooling Expertise:**
  Direct experience configuring advanced CDP platforms, custom LLM prompt setups, or AI-driven marketing automation engines.
* **Startup Agility:**
  Experience operating within zero-to-one or lean startup environments where market entry strategies evolve quickly.

**The UMO Standard**

* Mandate & Ownership: Full ownership of the product organization and roadmap, reporting directly to the founders.
* Equity: A meaningful equity stake in a venture built from zero to one.
* Location & Flexibility: Base yourself in Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, or Lviv, with openness to remote for the right fit.
* Impact & Ownership: Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

jobs.title: Unit Leader - Client Acquisition (Loans)
jobs.description:
**Unit Leader - Client Acquisition**

**About the Role:**

YubiLoans UAE is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to lead the SME Loans Segment. This role is central to driving the growth of our SME marketplace by acquiring corporate borrowers and successfully onboarding them onto our platform. As the Team Leader, you will manage a team responsible for identifying, engaging, and facilitating the onboarding of SME borrowers, ensuring they can connect with the right lenders through our marketplace. You will be at the forefront of shaping the acquisition strategy, ensuring the smooth onboarding of borrowers, and building strong relationships with potential clients. This role requires a leader with a deep understanding of the SME lending landscape, excellent team management skills, and the ability to drive marketplace growth through strategic partnerships and efficient processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Leadership & Team Management:**

* **Team Leadership**
  : Lead and inspire a team of SME loan acquisition specialists and onboarding managers, ensuring they meet loan origination targets and contribute to the growth of Yubiloans' SME borrower base across all SME loan variants including business loans, POS loans, asset backed loans, commercial vehicle and fleet finance, working capital loans, loan against property and capex loans.
* **Performance Management**
  : Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for your team, tracking progress and providing coaching to improve team performance and overall contribution to business goals.
* **Coaching & Development**
  : Develop a high-performance culture, providing ongoing training and development to enhance the skill sets of your team members.

**Borrower Acquisition & Onboarding:**

* **Market Development**
  : Drive efforts to identify and target potential SME and corporate borrowers across the MENA region, focusing on those who would benefit from connecting with lenders through the Yubiloans marketplace.
* **Client Engagement**
  : Establish relationships with potential borrowers, understand their financing needs, and position Yubiloans as the optimal solution for connecting them with the right lending partners.
* **Onboarding Process**
  : Oversee the seamless onboarding of borrowers onto the Yubiloans platform, ensuring they are fully equipped to access financing options that best meet their needs.
* **Sales Strategy**
  : Develop and implement strategies to acquire a diverse set of borrowers, balancing volume with quality to maximize the overall growth and health of the marketplace.

**Partnership & Relationship Management:**

* **Lender Network Collaboration**
  : Collaborate closely with Yubiloans' lender partners to understand their requirements and ensure the borrowers you onboard are well-matched with appropriate lenders.
* **Strategic Partnerships**
  : Build and maintain strong relationships with key corporate clients, industry associations, and other stakeholders to attract new borrowers to the platform.
* **Customer Service Excellence**
  : Ensure a high-quality onboarding experience for borrowers, guiding them through the platform and answering questions to ensure smooth adoption.

**Operational Excellence:**

* **Process Optimization**
  : Work closely with operations, product, and technology teams to continuously refine and streamline the borrower onboarding process for greater efficiency and scalability.
* **Market Insights & Trends**
  : Keep abreast of market trends, competitor activities, and regulatory changes in the SME lending space to refine acquisition strategies and ensure compliance.
* **Data-Driven Decisions**
  : Utilize data and performance metrics to inform strategies and track the effectiveness of borrower acquisition and onboarding efforts. Identify opportunities for process improvements.

**Client and Stakeholder Interaction:**

* **Client Consultation**
  : Provide advisory support to borrowers, helping them understand the benefits of connecting with the right lenders through Yubiloans and ensuring they are informed and confident throughout the onboarding journey.
* **Cross-Sell & Upsell Opportunities**
  : Identify opportunities to cross-sell or upsell additional services or products to existing borrowers, enhancing their experience on the platform and increasing lifetime value.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* **Internal Coordination**
  : Collaborate with internal teams such as product, legal, compliance, marketing, and technology to ensure the smooth onboarding of borrowers and continuous improvements to the platform’s functionality and user experience.
* **Market Insights**
  : Provide feedback to the product and marketing teams to ensure that the platform features and promotional strategies align with market demands and borrower needs.

**Key Performance Metrics:**

* **Borrower Acquisition**
  : Achieve new borrower onboarding targets, ensuring a diverse and high-quality pool of SME and Corporate borrowers on the platform.
* **Onboarding Success**
  : Monitor and optimize the borrower onboarding process, ensuring timely and efficient onboarding experiences.
* **Team Performance**
  : Drive team performance, ensuring KPIs related to borrower engagement, conversion rates, and platform adoption are met.
* **Lender Match Success**
  : Ensure borrowers are successfully matched with the right lenders, contributing to successful loan transactions on the platform.
* **Customer Satisfaction**
  : Track borrower satisfaction and retention, ensuring a high-quality experience throughout the onboarding process.

**Requirements:**

**Experience & Qualifications:**

* **Experience**
  : 8-12 years of experience in the SME lending, fintech, or financial services sectors, with at least 3-5 years in a team management role focused on borrower acquisition, onboarding, or relationship management.
* **Leadership**
  : Proven ability to lead and inspire high-performing teams, with strong people management and coaching skills.
* **Business Development**
  : Experience in driving business development within the SME lending space, with a focus on building relationships with borrowers and lenders.
* **Market Knowledge**
  : Strong understanding of the SME lending landscape in the MENA region, including the needs of corporate borrowers and the dynamics of lending marketplaces.
* **Educational Background**
  : A Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field. An MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualifications are a plus.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* **Strategic Thinking**
  : Ability to develop and execute strategic plans to grow borrower acquisition and platform adoption.
* **Client-Centric**
  : A customer-first mindset, with the ability to build trust and strong relationships with SME borrowers and lender partners.
* **Communication**
  : Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with corporate borrowers, lenders, and internal teams.
* **Problem-Solving**
  : Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address borrower challenges and optimize the onboarding experience.
* **Technologically Savvy**
  : Familiarity with digital lending platforms, SaaS solutions, and marketplace models. Comfort with using data and technology to drive decision-making.

jobs.title: ED - Head, Margin & Collateral Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* The Executive Director – Global Head, Margin and Collateral Operations is accountable for the global end-to-end delivery, control and transformation of the Bank’s uncleared margin and collateral franchise across non-centrally cleared derivatives, repo, securities borrowing and lending, structured financing, commodities, precious metals and other collateralised businesses.
* The role owns Initial Margin, Variation Margin, Independent Amount, portfolio reconciliation, dispute management, collateral allocation, settlement, interest, static data, reconciliations, reporting and exception management across the full lifecycle—from legal-agreement and counterparty onboarding through daily exposure calculation, margin exchange and collateral return.
* The role ensures compliance with applicable uncleared margin, segregation, portfolio-reconciliation, dispute-reporting, client-asset, liquidity and books-and-records obligations across all relevant jurisdictions and legal entities, and is accountable for timely, evidenced delivery of regulatory, audit, assurance and risk-remediation commitments.
* The role leads the global target operating model, people strategy and investment roadmap to deliver upcoming global and local margin regulations, maintain compliance with existing requirements through adequate preventive and detective controls, and resolve conflicts between global standards and local regulatory, legal-entity, currency, custody and settlement obligations. The role is accountable for evolving MARS into the Bank’s strategic straight-through and zero-touch collateral management solution, enabling artificial intelligence and effective integration with industry utilities and vendors, including TriOptima and AcadiaSoft, while supporting digital-currency margining, Prime Crypto and other new-business requirements across Asia and the wider Bank.

Strategy
  
  

* Define and execute the global strategy for uncleared Margin and Collateral Operations, aligned with Global Markets Operations, business growth, counterparty credit-risk mitigation, liquidity objectives and risk appetite.
* Own the forward regulatory roadmap for global and local margin reforms, translating emerging rules into coordinated legal, client, model, process, technology, custody, settlement, finance and control deliverables while sustaining compliance with existing regulations.
* Establish a scalable target operating model with global process ownership, follow-the-sun delivery, resilient location strategy, clear service segmentation and effective capacity planning.
* Set the strategic direction for MARS as the Bank’s authoritative collateral management platform, delivering end-to-end straight-through processing and zero-touch processing across calculation, margin exchange, allocation, settlement, reconciliation, reporting and exception management.
* Own the multi-year transformation and investment roadmap for standardisation, artificial intelligence, real-time settlement transparency, collateral optimisation, common data, strategic platform integration and controlled decommissioning of legacy processes and systems without service or control degradation.
* Establish strategic partnerships and interoperable solutions with global vendors and industry utilities, including TriOptima and AcadiaSoft, to increase automation, strengthen portfolio reconciliation and dispute management, and support exception-led operations.
* Set measurable outcomes covering regulatory compliance, margin timeliness, settlement success, disputes, reconciliations, risk reduction, productivity, resilience, client service, collateral utilisation, funding efficiency and financial-data accuracy.
* Anticipate regulatory, market, product and infrastructure developments and ensure the operating model remains controlled, scalable and fit for global flow business and complex local or bespoke requirements.

Business
  
  

* Act as the senior global Operations owner for uncleared margin and collateral services, maintaining effective service across products, legal entities, regions and client segments.
* Partner with Trading, XVA, Treasury, Repo, Prime, Product, Sales and Client Coverage to enable new clients, products, markets and bespoke structures with transparent operational readiness, risk assessment, approvals, capacity and controls.
* Lead the operational enablement of digital-currency margining, Prime Crypto, crypto spot, crypto derivatives and other emerging business propositions, ensuring appropriate agreement structures, segregated or cross-service margin treatment, settlement, custody, valuation, reconciliation, reporting and risk controls.
* Support the Bank’s growth across diverse Asian markets by delivering scalable solutions for local currencies, local custodians, domestic settlement infrastructure, country-specific collateral rules and bespoke regulatory margin requirements.
* Protect the Bank from counterparty credit, liquidity, market, conduct, operational, regulatory and reputational impacts arising from ineffective margining, collateralisation, disputes or settlement.
* Maximise utilisation of the Bank’s collateral inventory through eligibility, concentration, substitutions, intragroup margining, cross-product opportunities and cheapest-to-deliver allocation, while ensuring optimal funding, liquidity, legal-entity and regulatory outcomes.
* Represent Margin and Collateral Operations in senior business, client, risk, governance, audit and investment forums, providing clear decisions and escalation on material matters.

**Processes**

* Own the global control and service framework for agreement onboarding and static data; trade and valuation feeds; IM, VM and Independent Amount calculation; SIMM; margin issuance and response; dispute investigation; collateral selection and movement; interest; substitutions; returns; reconciliations; and reporting.
* Ensure margin calls and collateral movements are complete, accurate, timely and consistent with legal terms, credit requirements, settlement instructions, eligibility schedules, thresholds, minimum transfer amounts, haircuts and concentration limits.
* Deliver change for new and amended global margin regulations and local addenda, including impact assessment, requirements interpretation, controls, documentation, client repapering, model approval, custody and settlement readiness, testing, training, implementation and post-go-live assurance.
* Design and operate a defensible framework for conflicting global and local requirements, with documented rule hierarchy, legal and compliance interpretation, country-specific configurations, approvals, traceability and evidence that each applicable obligation is met.
* Enhance MARS and its upstream and downstream interfaces to enable STP and ZTP processing, AI-supported ingestion and exception analysis, real-time connectivity with TriOptima and AcadiaSoft where appropriate, and controlled handling of clients or markets that cannot use industry utilities.
* Provide real-time or near-real-time settlement status for cash and securities, with end-to-end acknowledgement, fail management, aged-item escalation and reconciled views across MARS, settlement platforms, custodians, triparty agents, nostro and ledger records.
* Ensure complete, accurate and timely feeds of collateral positions, valuations, movements, interest, encumbrance and accounting attributes to Finance, Aspire and other downstream liquidity, ledger, regulatory and management-reporting systems, supported by controls and reconciliations.
* Maintain a robust portfolio-reconciliation and dispute-management model with risk-based prioritisation, ageing, escalation, regulatory reporting and accountable root-cause remediation.
* Establish complete reconciliations across margin systems, trade platforms, settlement systems, Finance, Aspire, custodians, triparty agents, nostro and ledger records; ensure all breaks are risk-assessed, owned, aged and resolved with

**Head, Credit Risk Review, Specialised Finance**
in the
**Banking**
division.

**Job Description:**

**Job Summary:**

* Lead independent, technical, and forward-looking assessments of the credit quality, risk governance, and control environment across the Group's global Specialized Finance portfolio.
* Exercise independent challenge and escalation authority under the Credit Risk Review mandate while maintaining clear separation from first-line credit and business decision-making.
* Conduct independent reviews that drive strategic and business outcomes, including decisions on portfolio growth, risk appetite, sector and country concentrations, capital deployment, hold levels, and distribution strategy.
* Identify emerging and systemic risks, influence improvements in underwriting, structuring, and portfolio management, and ensure timely remediation of material weaknesses.
* Provide senior management, risk committees, and regulators with independent assurance on underwriting, structuring, portfolio quality, risk appetite alignment, lifecycle monitoring, and problem-credit management.
* Perform Business Credit Application and portfolio reviews across Project Finance, Sponsor Finance, Private Credit, Commercial Real Estate (CRE), Infrastructure & Power, Natural Resources, Transportation (Shipping/Aviation), Export Finance, Structured Asset Finance, and other asset-backed or cash-flow-based lending.
* Focus on Credit Risk and its interaction with ESG, climate, and country risks.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategy
:**

Maintain awareness of the Group's Specialized Finance strategy and assess whether growth priorities, sector and country concentrations, tenor, leverage, distribution assumptions and originate-to-distribute activity remain aligned with approved risk appetite. Specifically the role requires:

* Served as the senior independent reviewer for Specialized Finance, providing oversight and escalation of key credit and portfolio risks.
* Advised leadership on portfolio strategy, risk appetite, growth priorities, capital deployment, and concentration limits.
* Identified emerging and systemic risks across sectors and regions, recommending risk mitigation and control enhancements.
* Assessed portfolio sustainability under stressed conditions, balancing risk, return, capital, and concentration exposures.
* Independently challenged underwriting, portfolio management, and strategic decisions to ensure compliance with approved risk appetite.
* Monitored portfolio vulnerabilities and concentrations, ensuring timely identification and remediation of material risks.

**Business**

* Assessed macroeconomic, sector, sovereign, commodity, and market risks impacting portfolio performance and resilience.
* Evaluated portfolio exposures to concentration, refinancing, interest rate, inflation, and other emerging risk factors through forward-looking reviews.
* Led independent assessment of complex project and structured finance transactions, including cash flow analysis, ESG/climate risks, and distressed assets.
* Translated portfolio and thematic review findings into strategic recommendations to enhance underwriting, structuring, and portfolio management practices.
* Influenced senior stakeholders to strengthen credit governance, risk controls, risk appetite adherence, and portfolio resilience through effective challenge and remediation oversight.

**Processes**
:

* Led Specialized Finance credit reviews, ensuring compliance with policies, regulations, and governance standards.
* Enhanced review methodologies, portfolio analytics, and risk assessment frameworks.
* Conducted end-to-end credit reviews, including transaction assessment, model validation, and stakeholder engagement.
* Developed risk-based review programs covering high-risk sectors, jurisdictions, refinancing risks, and portfolio concentrations.
* Evaluated complex financing structures and key legal, ESG, technical, valuation, and financial risks.
* Identified and escalated material underwriting, monitoring, concentration, and control weaknesses, driving timely remediation.

**Risk Management:**

* Conducted end-to-end reviews of Specialized Finance transactions, assessing sponsor strength, project viability, leverage, cash flows, covenants, and refinancing risk.

This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

* Drive employee engagement, coaching, performance management, and succession planning.

* 5+ years of securities operations experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience using analytics and data analysis to identify trends, investigate exceptions, and support operational decisions
* Knowledge of compliance requirements and risk controls applicable to securities transaction processing and operational workflows
* Ability to apply customer insights, customer support operations, and product knowledge to improve service and resolve issues

This role provides critical leadership and oversight for the CDR function, ensuring operational performance, risk management, compliance adherence, and stakeholder support. * Lead the India team and build a culture of quality, ownership and growth.

JOB DESCRIPTION Zoho Books Accountant K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons Kasaragod, Kerala Position: Zoho Books Accountant Department: Accounts & Finance Location: Kasaragod, Kerala Employment Type: Full-time Reporting To: Management / Accounts Head 1. About the Company K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons is an established cashew processing and trading company with a legacy dating back to 1945. The company is engaged in cashew kernel processing, domestic and international trading, procurement of raw cashew nuts and sale of cashew by-products. We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible accountant with practical experience in Zoho Books and GST compliance to manage our accounting operations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Zoho Books Management - Maintain complete and accurate accounting records in Zoho Books. - Record daily sales, purchases, receipts, payments and journal entries. - Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. - Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. - Ensure timely and accurate accounting entries. - Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions. B. GST & Statutory Compliance - Prepare and verify GST sales and purchase data. - Coordinate preparation and filing of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. - Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records. - Verify GST input tax credit eligibility. - Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants. - Maintain TDS records and assist with statutory compliance. C. Banking & Financial Transactions - Perform bank reconciliations regularly. - Monitor customer collections and supplier payments. - Maintain cash and bank books. - Prepare payment schedules. - Track outstanding receivables and payables. D. Inventory & Stock Accounting - Maintain inventory records in Zoho. - Monitor raw cashew nut purchases and stock. - Track cashew kernel grades and quantities. - Maintain stock records of finished goods, packing materials and by-products. - Reconcile physical stock with accounting records. - Coordinate with factory and stores personnel for stock verification. E. Sales & Purchase Accounting - Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices and debit/credit notes. - Ensure correct GST rates, HSN codes and tax classifications. - Track customer outstanding balances. - Monitor supplier balances and payment due dates. - Maintain proper records of domestic and export transactions. F. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare periodic reports for management, including: - Daily sales and purchase reports. - Customer outstanding and ageing reports. - Supplier outstanding reports. - Stock and inventory reports. - Monthly Profit & Loss statement. - Cash flow and fund position. - Expense analysis. - Product-wise and business-wise profitability reports, wherever data is available. 3. Required Qualifications & Experience - B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification. - 2–5 years of accounting experience. - Hands-on experience in Zoho Books is essential. - Good knowledge of GST and Indian accounting practices. - Experience with inventory accounting. - Knowledge of Excel and spreadsheets. - Experience in manufacturing, processing or trading businesses will be an advantage. 4. Skills & Competencies - Strong accounting fundamentals. - High accuracy and attention to detail. - Good analytical and reconciliation skills. - Ability to independently manage daily accounting operations. - Good communication and coordination skills. - Integrity, confidentiality and accountability. - Ability to meet deadlines. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the accountant will be evaluated on: 1. Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries. 2. Timely completion of bank reconciliations. 3. Timely GST preparation and compliance. 4. Accuracy of customer and supplier balances. 5. Timely submission of monthly MIS reports. 6. Accuracy of inventory and stock reconciliation. 7. Timely identification and reporting of accounting discrepancies. 6. What We Expect We expect the accountant to take ownership of the company's accounting system, ensure that all transactions are properly recorded and reconciled, and provide reliable financial information to management for decision-making. The objective is to maintain a transparent, accurate and well-organised accounting system through Zoho Books.

---------------

At Standard Chartered, excellence means more than achieving financial results — it means embodying our core values and delivering on our promise: Here for good. We foster a diverse and inclusive workplace culture that supports all individuals in realising their full professional potential and actively contributing to our continued success.

We are looking for an experienced professional to join our team in Chennai as a Director/Associate Director of Business Risk Assessment & Advisory focused on the Depository Participant (DP) license framework. This role will provide expert advisory on Conduct, Financial Crime, and Compliance Risk (CFCC) to ensure the integrity and regulatory alignment of our Depository Business. Effective risk management in this role will support the organisation's commitment to regulatory compliance and protect client interests in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment.

**You will have deep expertise in CFCC risk assessment, regulatory interpretation, compliance oversight and risk advisory services under the Depositories Act, 1996 and related SEBI regulations, ensuring we uphold our reputation as a trusted financial institution.**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Responsible for supporting Head, WRB CFCR Advisory in India for Compliance Advisory for Depository Business under Depository Participant (DP) license.
* Responsible for FC Risk assessment for DP Business
* Responsible for providing details of developments relating to DP compliance and conduct, giving rise to a material risk that serious regulatory breaches or breaches of country risk appetite metrics may occur and notifying any such breaches to (as appropriate) Head, WRB CFCR India, relevant Heads of Business and risk forums

**Strategy**

* Support Head WRB CFCR India in implementing the vision, strategy and direction set for the WRB CFCR function in India
* Practice the culture and compliance with CFCR standards (including conducting business within regulatory requirements, and to high ethical standards) within the Bank and embed a Here for good culture and the Group Code of Conduct.
Establish close links with colleagues of other Client segments and/or Product Groups to achieve common platforms and work plans, implementing a One Bank approach to covering all Clients.  

**Business**

* Analyse comprehensive impact of CFCR matters on the DP business areas, and their operations.
* Ensure that key changes (to laws, rules, regulations) pertaining to DP products are communicated and cascaded (in region/country).
* Support relevant stakeholders to make decisions based on current and possible future policies, practices, and trends.
* Ensure appropriate advice is provided to the relevant stakeholders on the interpretation and application of regulatory expectations, laws, best practices and policies related to CFCR (DP advisory).

**Processes**

* Support Head WRB CFCR India in review and approval of appropriate policies/processes/DOls to address CFCR risks related to DP, aligning them with relevant regulatory requirements.
* Provide support and challenge to the relevant stakeholders to ensure that they establish and monitor appropriate processes for compliance with CFCR policies, procedures and standards (including meeting regulatory obligations and maintaining high standards of conduct) pertaining to DP in WRB.

**People & Talent**

* Help in creating an environment of appropriate culture and values. work in collaboration with risk and control partners
* Work collaboratively with the team.

This role reports directly to the Head, WRB CFCR Advisory India, and interfaces regularly with senior business leaders, risk committees, and regulatory bodies. You will have an opportunity to influence policy formulation, risk frameworks and compliance culture at both a local and regional level, ensuring that our Depository Business consistently meets the highest standards.

You will also contribute to strategic initiatives aiming at digital transformation and risk automation, supporting Standard Chartered’s vision to be digitally enabled while maintaining rigorous control disciplines.

As part of your key contributions, you will participate in external regulatory engagements, representing the bank’s perspective with clarity and professionalism. You will work to anticipate regulatory trends and prepare the organisation for compliance-related changes, thereby reducing potential operational and reputational risks.

Furthermore, you will support internal audit and regulatory inspection processes, ensuring timely and effective remediation of findings and recommendations.

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* Business Acumen, Product and Operations

• Business Ethics
  
• CFCC Risk Management
  
• CFCC Risk Advisory
  
• Leadership (Influencing and Inspiring)
  
• Managing Change
  
• Data gathering, analytics and insights
  
• Enterprise and Operational Risk Management
  
• Collaboration and Stakeholder Management
  
• Regulatory Environment – Financial Services

**Qualifications**
------------------

We seek candidates with a minimum of 15 years’ relevant work experience within banking, financial institutions, regulatory bodies, fintech or closely related industries. Specifically, at least 10 years’ experience in conduct, compliance or risk management roles with a strong emphasis on Depository Participant regulations and securities market frameworks.

The ideal candidate will have advanced practitioner level expertise including:

* 5+ years of specialised conduct or compliance risk management experience.
* Demonstrable experience with NSDL, CDSL and SEBI regulatory requirements in the Indian context.
* Hands-on experience managing conduct risks including data risk, conflict of interest, regulatory reporting, and client market conduct.
* Robust knowledge of financial crime risks such as anti-money laundering, anti-bribery and corruption, sanctions compliance, and fraud prevention.
* 4+ years of practitioner level experience in business, product, or operational risk management with exposure to compliance and financial crime disciplines.
* 3+ years of complementary experience in interconnected risk surveillance operations or control oversight functions.

Key competencies required for success in this role include an action-oriented approach, strong collaboration and communication skills, and the courage to challenge and lead change. You will need to maintain a customer focus while ensuring high decision quality and ethical standards.

Other essential competencies encompass talent development, vision and purpose alignment, providing clear guidance, instilling trust, managing ambiguity effectively, adopting a nimble learning mindset, and demonstrating a strategic outlook. Technical competencies relevant to this role involve deep expertise in CFCC risk management and advisory within the financial services sector.

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**Senior Manager, BG&C**
========================

Req ID: 124671

Department: GO - GCC Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.
* Lead the design, uplift and consistent application of control testing methodologies, quality benchmarks, documentation standards and review practices across GCC teams and portfolios.
* Champion data-led and automated testing approaches where appropriate, ensuring enhancements are well governed, scalable and improve the quality and efficiency of assurance outcomes.
* Synthesise risk assessments and control testing outcomes into clear, prioritised insights for the GCC Leadership Team and relevant governance forums, including transparent escalation of material weaknesses, systemic issues and non-compliance risks.

* Oversee the quality and progress of remediation, challenging whether actions address root causes and provide sufficient evidence of sustainable closure, while retaining accountability with the relevant business owner.
* Lead first-line coordination of internal, external and in-country audits for the GCC, ensuring effective business engagement, timely responses and disciplined tracking of agreed actions.
* Build a strong risk and compliance culture by coaching leaders, strengthening accountability and promoting open, transparent engagement across businesses, functions, second line, Audit and other key stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the BG&C team, ensuring effective resourcing, clear priorities and the skills and capability required to meet current and future GCC needs.
* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

**‘Must have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* Strong degree of know-how and ability to drive strategic initiatives
* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, including control taxonomies and enterprise risk standards.
* Knowledge of regulatory obligations relevant to conduct, compliance, and operational risk.
* Awareness of business processes, control design principles, and first‑line risk responsibilities.
* Analytical capability to interpret data, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey risk messages clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness, including root‑cause analysis and evidence evaluation.
* Stakeholder engagement and relationship‑building skills, with confidence to challenge constructively.
* Planning and prioritisation skills to manage testing cycles, competing workloads, and quality standards.
* Experience delivering control testing, quality assurance, or risk assessment activities in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in analysing business processes and identifying control gaps or compliance issues.
* Strong understanding of risk management and operational risk
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and partner effectively with stakeholders across geographies
* Knowledge of banking processes and/or products
* Extensive experience in enterprise risk management and/or leadership roles within the banking, financial services or KPO sectors
* Knowledge of retail banking products and processes
* Demonstrated experience in risk and compliance management
* Strong stakeholder management
* Demonstrated experience in people leadership and capability development

**‘****Good to have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* ERP systems and Risk toolkits
* PACT
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Programs
* Business and Executive Report Writing

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Relevant tertiary qualifications
* Overall 15+ years of experience in banking, including a minimum of five years in risk, compliance or audit

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

From the moment you join ANZ, you'll be doing meaningful work that will shape a world where people and communities thrive.

  

But it's not just our customers who'll feel your impact. you'll feel it too. Because at ANZ, you'll have the resources, opportunities, and support you need to take the next big step in your career.

jobs.title: Director – Precious Metals Sales
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Organization Unit Purpose**

The Precious Metals business originates, structures and delivers physical and financial precious metals solutions for the Bank’s corporate, institutional, commercial and wealth clients. The unit connects client coverage with trading, structuring, operations, legal, credit and compliance capabilities to build a scalable, well-controlled and profitable bullion franchise across the UAE and ENBDs network markets.

**Job Purpose**

The Director – Precious Metals Sales is responsible for originating and growing precious metals revenue by developing client relationships and delivering solutions across physical bullion, price-risk management, financing and investment products. The role leads opportunity identification, solution design and transaction execution while ensuring suitability, documentation, conduct, operational readiness and risk requirements are fully satisfied.

The job holder will contribute to the strategic development of the Bank’s precious metals franchise, deepen wallet share across existing relationships, acquire new-to-bank flows, and position the Bank as a trusted regional liquidity, financing and physical bullion partner.

**Job Content**

**Sales strategy and revenue delivery:**
Develop and execute a client and product sales plan to achieve annual revenue, volume, profitability and franchise objectives. Maintain a disciplined pipeline, identify white-space opportunities and convert prospects into recurring business.

**Client origination and relationship management:**
Build senior relationships with banks, refiners, bullion traders, jewellery groups, retailers, family offices, sovereign-linked entities and large corporates. Lead account planning with relationship teams and coordinate multi-product engagement.

**Physical bullion solutions:**
Originate and execute outright sales and purchases of allocated or unallocated gold and silver, minted and investment products, consignment, deferred-payment structures, import/export flows, custody and vault-related solutions, subject to approved product and risk frameworks.

**Hedging and investment solutions:**
Advise clients on precious metals price-risk management and investment requirements using approved spot, forward, swap, option and structured solutions. Translate market views into suitable, executable ideas without compromising conduct or suitability standards.

Partner with structuring, credit and relationship teams on gold loans, bullion repo, inventory or transit financing, collateralised structures and other approved precious metals financing solutions.

**End-to-end transaction leadership:**
Coordinate pricing, credit, documentation, KYC, sanctions screening, logistics, insurance, settlement, vaulting and post-trade follow-up. Escalate execution risks early and ensure responsibilities are clearly assigned.

**Market intelligence and franchise development:**
Monitor precious metals markets, regional physical premiums, competitor activity, regulation, refining and supply-chain developments. Provide actionable intelligence to clients and management and support new product, corridor and partnership development.

**Governance, risk and controls:**
Operate within approved mandates and policies covering market, credit, legal, operational, conduct, financial-crime and reputational risk. Maintain complete records and ensure transactions meet relevant internal approvals and regulatory requirements.

**Cross-functional collaboration and leadership:**
Work closely with trading, structuring, research, operations, finance, legal, compliance, credit and coverage teams. Share product knowledge, support joint client meetings, coach junior team members and strengthen a collaborative sales culture.

Share market and product expertise, support junior colleagues and improve coordination across sales, trading and support functions.

**Experiences**

Minimum 10 years of relevant banking, precious metals experience, including a strong record in client-facing sales and revenue generation. Experience with physical bullion and/or precious metals derivatives is required.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of gold and silver markets, physical supply chains, spot/forward/swap pricing, hedging, financing and settlement conventions.
* Understanding of vaulting, logistics, custody and refining ecosystems is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to originate opportunities, build senior relationships, negotiate commercial terms, manage a pipeline and convert complex requirements into executable solutions.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Commercial judgement and revenue orientation

jobs.title: Head of Treasury
jobs.description:
**Head of Treasury - Investment Holding Group**

**The Opportunity**

I am working with a well-established investment holding group in the UAE that is looking to appoint a Head of Treasury. The business has a significant portfolio of investments across multiple sectors and international markets.

As the group continues to grow and diversify, it is looking for someone to take ownership of its treasury function, develop its funding strategy and improve how cash, liquidity and financial risk are managed across the portfolio.

This is a hands-on leadership role with direct exposure to senior management and shareholders. The successful candidate will be expected to bring ideas, challenge existing processes and build a treasury function that can support the group's future investment activity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage the group's treasury strategy, including liquidity planning, funding and capital allocation.
* Advise senior management on the investment of surplus cash, balancing returns, liquidity requirements and financial risk.
* Manage relationships with UAE and international banks, negotiating funding facilities, credit lines, guarantees and deposit arrangements.
* Lead debt financing, refinancing and capital structure initiatives across group entities.
* Oversee FX and interest-rate exposure, including the use of appropriate hedging instruments.
* Lead the implementation and development of Treasury Management Systems (TMS), banking integrations and reporting automation.
* Establish treasury policies, controls and governance frameworks across the group.
* Improve cash visibility and forecasting across subsidiaries, investments and international operations.
* Work closely with investment and finance teams to understand upcoming transactions, funding requirements and capital commitments.
* Provide regular treasury reporting and recommendations to senior management and shareholders.
* Identify opportunities to improve banking terms, reduce financing costs and generate better returns on available cash.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 12–18+ years of experience across corporate treasury, group treasury or corporate finance, with demonstrated leadership responsibility.
* Background within an investment holding company, family office, conglomerate, real estate investment group or similarly complex organisation.
* Strong experience managing sizeable cash, debt or investment portfolios.
* Proven experience negotiating directly with banks on financing facilities, refinancing, guarantees and other treasury products.
* Good understanding of treasury investments, capital allocation, FX and interest-rate risk management.
* Experience implementing or leading TMS projects, treasury automation and process improvements.
* Strong UAE banking relationships and knowledge of the regional financial market.
* Comfortable operating in a lean team, taking ownership and working directly with senior stakeholders.
* CTP, ACT, CFA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent qualifications would be advantageous.

**The Opportunity Offers**

* A senior role with responsibility for developing the group's treasury function.
* Direct involvement in funding decisions, capital allocation and treasury strategy.
* Exposure to a diversified portfolio of investments across the UAE and international markets.
* The opportunity to lead treasury systems implementation and improve existing processes.
* Regular interaction with senior management and shareholders.

Applications will be treated confidentially. Further details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

**Head of M&A**

Location: Dubai, UAE · Permanent

Our client, a banking group in the UAE, is hiring a senior M&A banker to build and lead a new advisory franchise within its Investment Banking business. This is a franchise-building role for an entrepreneurial dealmaker who can both originate and execute.

**Purpose of the role**

To originate, win and execute M&A and private capital advisory mandates across the bank’s client base. You’ll turn existing financing relationships into broader advisory relationships and build a sustainable, leading regional M&A franchise. The role needs strong transaction execution together with a commercial, proactive approach to origination and client development.

**Key accountabilities**

* Origination and franchise building: proactively find M&A and strategic advisory opportunities across the bank’s client base, and originate new mandates with relationship managers and sector teams.

* Cross-bank collaboration and growth: bring the bank’s full capabilities and relationships to clients, build a sustainable pipeline of mandates, and grow Investment Banking revenues and the bank’s market profile.

**Experience and qualifications**

* About 15+ years of high-quality M&A or investment banking advisory experience, ideally at a leading investment bank or advisory platform.
* A demonstrable track record of executing complex sell-side and buy-side transactions.
* Proven origination capability, with the ability to find opportunities, win mandates and build a business, not only execute.
* Credibility and executive presence with shareholders, CEOs, CFOs, boards and sophisticated investors, plus experience handling critical negotiations with the C-suite, financial sponsors and other stakeholders in an M&A process.

**Knowledge and skills**

M&A technical and execution expertise; valuation and financial analysis; equity story development and investment positioning; origination and business development; senior client and board-level relationship management; negotiation; process design and deal management; private capital and growth equity structuring; investor and buyer coverage; commercial judgement; cross-functional collaboration; an entrepreneurial, franchise-building mindset.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President – Investments and Funding (UAE National)
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

To lead EDB’s investment and funding strategy by managing multi-asset portfolios and optimizing capital deployment across fixed income, equities, and private equity. The role ensures efficient liquidity and cost of funds through structured funding solutions, including public/private issuances and repo facilities. It also involves overseeing portfolio performance, regulatory compliance, and execution of investment and funding activities aligned with the bank’s strategic objectives, while driving cross-functional collaboration and revenue growth.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Formulate, evaluate and implement investment policies, guidelines, asset allocation, selection of external investment managers, risk management, compliance monitoring and rebalancing through advanced planning and management of investment risk at strategic, managerial and operational levels.
* Manage the investment portfolios, analyze market trends and economic indicators as well as execute trades based on their analysis.
* Construct and continuously manage the fixed income portfolios within the approved parameters to generate alpha (risk-adjusted return) for the bank.
* Utilize cash flow planning for the funds and investments across a multi-year time horizon to assist in strategic decision-making.
* Align investment goals with the overall objectives of the bank and position portfolios accordingly.
* Conduct detailed financial analysis of the private equity portfolio, coupled with arranging quarterly performance calls with their senior management teams, attending AGMs, developing exit strategies (where required), and apprising EDB management periodically.
* Assess the funding needs of the bank, develop funding strategies, source potential investors, and formulate capital structure strategies to advise on capital investment decision making and ensure compliance with financial regulation.
* Choose the most cost-efficient effective funding solutions for the bank to minimize CoF while continuously revamping the mix to achieve optimum results
* Grow the short-term financing tools and manage liquidity of the bank by establishing a Repo framework in accordance with GMRA guidelines to optimize returns or to raise funding using fixed income securities
* Execute all tasks related to any existing or new issuances by the bank (public or private), including deliberations with the JLMs (Joint Lead Managers), external counsels and auditors, securities exchanges, regulators, rating agencies, etc.

**Operational Responsibilities:**

* Originate, price, execute, book, manage and monitor investments like Fixed Income securities, Listed and Unlisted Equities, Repo and Reverse Repos and other investments.
* Assess the bank’s cash positioning, including forecasts, and recommend ways to utilize idle funds by identifying potential investment opportunities
* Anticipate interest rate shifts and optimize trade timing to secure favorable terms with brokers and banks while negotiating terms like interest rates, yield, pricing, before making any investment decisions, ensuring alignment with EDB Investment guidelines and objectives.
* Rotate cash across assets classes or within the same asset class to optimize returns in the short term (when required), while focusing on maximizing the annuity income for the bank on a longer-term risk adjusted net-FTP basis
* Manage the private equity portfolio, review and analyze the company’s yearly valuations, attend EGMs & AGMs, report to senior management on company’s performance, manage dividend payouts, capital reductions or injections, including devising exit strategies
* Coordinate with the Risk Management and Compliance teams to ensure exposure remains within the limits defined with adherence to CBUAE and Basel regulatory requirements
* Partner with EDB’s Balance Sheet Management function to understand the bank’s funding requirements in the short, medium and long term.
* Perform market scan with banks, investors and other external counterparties to select viable funding solutions for the bank and recommend the same to ALCO
* Work with internal as well as external stakeholders, from origination to completion, to close the selected approved financing solution
* Transact Repo and Reverse Repo trades to manage short-term financing needs in accordance with approved guidelines. This requires the presence of an approved Repo framework, including a Product Manual, Standard Operating Procedure (SoP), and Operational Risk Assessment Plan (ORAP) duly signed off. Additionally, all transactions must be supported by executed GMRA agreements with counterparties, a functional collateral management operation, established counterparty limits, and a pricing mechanism with clearly defined haircuts.
* Draft and submit memos related to the Investment and Funding businesses to the relevant committees of the bank for approvals as per the DoA matrix
* Coordinate with the MIS team/Finance to deliver periodic performance updates as well as reports for senior management’s review and monitoring
* Evaluate and manage the bank’s capital adequacy, liquidity, profitability, and other ratios with the Risk department.
* Cultivate strong relationships with external counterparties while managing internal stakeholders with an equal amount of care and responsibility.
* Ensure all revenue, cost, and volume targets are delivered under the stipulated guidelines.
* Be the key driver in delivering a larger share of the P&L responsibility for T&I.
* Conduct constructive and meaningful discussions with senior management, using market knowledge and business expertise to build trust and affinity, leading to better performance results
* Develop and implement sound business practices across all investment as well as funding related activities/operations to promote efficiencies in work processes.
* Maintain a trusted partner status with Middle Office, Market Risk, Finance, and Operations.
* Comply 100% with all Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Operational requirements as well as ensure there are no breaches
* Function within the framework and boundaries of EDB’s policies as well as overall organizational and governance frameworks
* Maintain adherence to Treasury & Investments policies, procedures, and processes that comply with the leading practices, laws, and regulations
* Take decisions as per the approved authorization matrix.
* Always maintain the highest standards of work ethics, making sure that one operates in a professional environment, there are zero compromises on compliance or principles, any breaches of limits, etc. are immediately escalated, and all activities are performed under the approved audit framework
