Vice President – Lead London South Bank University Ajman Campus in the UAE

ABOUT THE ROLE

London South Bank University UAE is a branch campus of London South Bank University, based at Ajman NuVentures Centre Free Zone, Ajman. We are recruiting a Vice President to serve as the Head of Institution. The role is accountable for the academic, regulatory, financial and operational performance of the campus, and for its relationship with London South Bank University (LSBU) in London, the UAE regulator and the campus's governing board.

ROLE SUMMARY

• Position: Vice President (Head of Institution)

• Reports to: President and the Board of Governance

• Direct reports: Academic Affairs; heads of Finance, Student Recruitment, Marketing, Student Success, IT, and Transport and Facilities

• Location: Al Rashidiya 3, Ajman, UAE

• Employment type: Full time, on-site

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Institutional Leadership and Strategy

• Lead the campus as Head of Institution and act as its senior academic and administrative representative.

• Develop and deliver the campus strategic plan, with annual targets for enrolment, programme growth, quality, retention and financial performance.

• Lead the senior management team and set clear objectives, accountability and performance standards.

• Advise the Board of Governance on strategy, risk and investment decisions, and carry out their decisions.

2. Academic Quality and Standards

• Ensure all programmes are delivered to LSBU academic standards and to the standards of the UAE regulator.

• Work with the President, Academic Affairs, and the Quality Office to run assessment boards, course advisory boards, external examining and annual monitoring.

• Oversee teaching and learning, curriculum development, research activity and the recruitment, appraisal and development of academic staff.

• Support the validation and launch of new undergraduate, postgraduate and foundation programmes.

3. Regulatory Compliance and Licensing

• Hold overall responsibility for the campus's licence and accreditation with the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHESR) and the Ajman NuVentures Centre Free Zone Authority.

• Manage licence renewals, amendments, inspections, audits and all correspondence with regulators.

• Make sure the campus meets UAE higher education licensure requirements, labour law, data protection and visa and student-record obligations.

• Keep policies, registers and compliance records current and available for inspection.

4. Partnership with London South Bank University

• Act as the main contact for LSBU London, including the Global Partnership Office, link tutors and quality teams.

• Meet the terms of the partnership agreement, including reporting, quality assurance, fee and invoicing arrangements, and visits.

• Raise issues with LSBU early and agree resolutions with them.

5. Student Recruitment, Experience and Success

• Set recruitment targets with the Student Recruitment and Marketing teams and review progress each intake.

• Ensure admissions, enrolment, induction, advising, welfare and safeguarding processes work for students.

• Oversee student support, employability, placements, internships and alumni engagement.

• Review student feedback, attendance, progression and retention data and act on the findings.

6. People and Operations

• Lead workforce planning, recruitment and retention for academic and professional services staff.

• Make sure HR, payroll, visa and contract processes meet UAE requirements.

• Oversee IT, facilities, transport, health and safety and business continuity.

• Build a staff culture based on accountability, clear communication and professional conduct.

7. Governance, Risk and Reporting

• Prepare regular reports for the Board of Governance and the CEO on academic, financial, compliance and operational performance.

• Maintain the institutional risk register and put controls and escalation routes in place.

• Make sure committees and boards meet on schedule, record decisions, and that actions are followed up.

8. External Relations

• Represent the campus with government bodies, chambers of commerce, employers, schools and community groups.

• Build industry and employer partnerships that support placements, research and graduate employment.

• Act as the public face of the campus at graduation, open days and other events.

REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications

• Doctorate (PhD or equivalent) in a relevant discipline, or a master's degree with substantial senior leadership experience in higher education. Professorial rank is ideal.

• A recognised qualification or evidence of leadership development in higher education management is desirable.

Experience

• At least 10 years in higher education, including at least 5 years in senior leadership.

• Experience running or helping to run a UK-linked, transnational or branch campus operation, with knowledge of UK quality assurance.

• Working knowledge of the UAE higher education regulatory environment, MOHESR licensing and accreditation. Experience in the GCC region is preferred.

• Record of managing a budget, leading a multi-department team and growing student numbers.

Skills and Attributes

• Clear, direct communication with senior stakeholders, regulators, staff and students.

• Sound judgement in compliance, risk and financial decisions.

• Ability to build partnerships and manage a relationship with a university partner.

• Fluent English, written and spoken. Arabic is an advantage.

WHAT WE OFFER

• Competitive salary package, based on qualifications and experience

• Medical insurance, annual leave, annual flight ticket allowance and UAE employment visa

• The opportunity to lead the growth of a new UK branch campus in the UAE

: Dubai, UAE | Region: MENA, with global responsibilities as required

**About PayerMax**

PayerMax is a leading global fintech company rooted in emerging markets. It is committed to delivering professional, omni-method global payment solutions — including global acquiring, payout, and collections — providing merchants with a safer, more convenient one-stop payment experience.

Leveraging years of experience in emerging markets, PayerMax continues to expand its global footprint, breaking down geographical and currency barriers, and maximizing growth beyond borders.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a
**Senior Banking & Financial Institutions Partnership Lead**
to spearhead the company's strategic banking, FI, and payment infrastructure partnerships across the MENA region, with additional support for global initiatives as required.

This role will be accountable for developing and managing high-value relationships with banks, financial institutions, payment service providers (PSPs), and fintech partners. You will architect scalable banking and payment infrastructure, identify transformational partnership opportunities, and execute end-to-end deal cycles—from commercial structuring and negotiation through technical integration and go-live.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in transaction banking, established institutional networks, a growth-oriented business development approach, robust risk management acumen, and exceptional cross-functional leadership capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

Strategic Partnerships & Business Development

* Design and execute the banking and FI partnership strategy across MENA, with a primary focus on the UAE market
* Establish and nurture C-level relationships with banks, financial institutions, PSPs, fintechs, and other strategic ecosystem players
* Own the full partnership lifecycle: sourcing, evaluation, commercial negotiation, due diligence, onboarding, technical integration, and ongoing performance management

Banking & Payment Infrastructure

* Architect and optimize scalable banking infrastructure for collections, payouts, settlements, FX, and cross-border payment flows
* Demonstrate expert-level proficiency in SWIFT messaging, domestic and international payment rails, banking APIs, and modern financial infrastructure
* Apply deep operational knowledge of corporate accounts, client money accounts (CMA), FBO (For Benefit Of) structures, virtual accounts, virtual IBANs, pooled/omnibus account models, and correspondent banking frameworks

Cross-Functional Execution

* Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance/AML, Risk, Treasury, and Operations teams to deliver partnerships and products on time and within scope
* Drive internal alignment across stakeholders with competing priorities and operate with influence in a dynamic environment

Channel Strategy & Risk Management

* Develop sophisticated channel management and volume allocation frameworks, optimizing transaction routing based on cost, capacity, regulatory risk, geography, and operational performance
* Conduct thorough counterparty and channel risk assessments; design and implement mitigation strategies
* Provide senior leadership with actionable market intelligence, competitive insights, and channel related risk reporting

Market Intelligence & Innovation

* Monitor emerging trends across payments, banking-as-a-service (BaaS), embedded finance, FX, fintech innovation, stablecoins, and Web3 infrastructure
* Identify whitespace opportunities for new product offerings, geographic corridors, and strategic alliances
* Support the development and deployment of stablecoin and digital asset payment infrastructure, including fiat on/off-ramp solutions and blockchain-based settlement mechanisms

**Candidate Profile**

Experience & Background

* 10–15 years of progressive experience in tier-1 banks or leading fintech platforms, with a focus on transaction banking, financial institutions coverage, correspondent banking, strategic partnerships, or payments
* Proven track record of originating, structuring, and closing complex banking/FI partnerships that delivered measurable business impact
* Deep domain expertise in AML/KYC frameworks, foreign exchange operations, cross-border payments infrastructure, and modern banking technology stacks

Technical & Domain Knowledge

* Strong working knowledge of payment APIs, SWIFT standards, ISO 20022, and real-time payment systems
* Solid understanding of virtual account architecture, multi-currency settlement flows, and liquidity management
* Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain rails, and digital asset infrastructure is highly advantageous

Network & Relationships

* Established, senior-level banking network in the UAE; broader MENA relationships strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ability to open doors and build trust with C-suite executives and decision-makers at financial institutions

Skills & Competencies

* Exceptional stakeholder management, negotiation, and executive communication skills
* Strategic thinker with strong commercial judgment and a bias toward execution
* Ability to drive outcomes across cross-functional teams without formal authority
* Fluent in English (written and verbal); proficiency in Arabic or Mandarin is a distinct advantage

jobs.title: KYC Operations Analyst - Post Execution Quality Review (PEQR) Analyst - DUBAI
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Description:**

This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. The Post Execution Quality process is a key risk indicator that is reported to the regulators monthly. The PEQ process is reviewed numerous times a year by Regulators, Internal Audit and Compliance Testing to ensure adherence to regulatory and Citi-wide policies and standards. This role is responsible to test the Post Execution Quality accuracy to ensure all KYC Quality reporting is in line with our regulatory commitments to the OCC. This role is responsible for independently testing each PEQ analyst and report all findings to the Head of Wealth KYC Quality for effective oversight of personnel.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

This role is critical in identifying any quality deficiencies immediately, raise self-identified issues for proper oversight and execution on the correction action plans in a timely manner. Without this role and process, KYC could introduce significant risks related to regulatory and internal audit findings for insufficient KYC program and controls. These results would lead to significant remediation population, remediation populations, procedures changes or even MRA (Matters Requiring Attention) if identified by a regulator.

Partner with internal units to ensure adequate due diligence process is carried out for customer accounts and documentation reviews.

Ensure all information and documentation comply with local regulation and Citi standards.

Ensure all AML risks are mitigated based on local regulation and internal procedural requirements.

Review all screening activities and making sure all true, false, and potential matches are dispositioned correctly including sanctions related activities, if applicable.

Update and review forms according to local regulation requirements and work with Compliance to expedite documentation reviews, providing clarification as needed.

Appropriately assess and verify CIP requirements based on internal and global requirements.

Strong understanding of wealth holding vehicles which includes the various structures, legality, and documentation for each type of entity.

Participate and assist with the organization of weekly meetings and calls to discuss “Sustainability and Remediation” population.

Appropriately assessing risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

* 3-6 years of relevant experience
* Experience in banking operations, preferably in KYC/AML profile reviews.
  

  

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

Operations - Services

Business Acumen, Credible Challenge, Laws and Regulations, Management Reporting, Policy and Procedure, Program Management, Referral and Escalation, Risk Controls and Monitors, Risk Identification and Assessment, Risk Remediation.

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

**Director, Treasury Program Management**

**Shift Timing : 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM**

**Location- India – Bangalore**

**Job Summary**

- We are seeking a Director, Treasury Program Management, to lead large treasury programs across the global organization.

- This role drives execution across treasury systems, bank connectivity, payments modernization, settlement workflows, controls, reporting, exception-based processing, automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, and process improvement.

- The Director will lead programs across payments, capital markets, middle office workflows, credit facility administration, loan seasoning, investing, management reporting, and forecasting.

**What You’ll Do**

Program Delivery & Governance

- Lead treasury programs end-to-end: Manage planning, execution, implementation, adoption, and post-go-live stabilization while overseeing milestones, risks, dependencies, governance, and issue management.

- Own program delivery & governance: Maintain program plans, stakeholder updates, and reporting while translating business objectives into workstreams, requirements, testing plans, controls, and implementation roadmaps.

- Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders: Partner with Treasury, Capital Markets, Middle Office, Finance, Accounting, Operations, Technology, banks, vendors, and service providers.

- Drive automation & exception-based processing: Reduce manual effort, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and expand automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, and operational transparency.

- Improve payments, settlements & bank connectivity: Enhance payment initiation, approval workflows, settlement instructions, reconciliations, and bank connectivity including SWIFT and ISO 20022.

- Standardize treasury payment workflows: Streamline processes across regions, funds, entities, currencies, and banking partners while reducing breaks and manual intervention.

**What You’ll Bring**

Required Experience

**- 15+ years of experience in treasury, treasury operations, middle office, capital markets operations, finance transformation, program management, or related financial services roles.**

**- Experience leading large treasury, finance, or operations programs across multiple stakeholders.**

**- Strong understanding of payments, settlements, bank connectivity, controls, reporting, treasury workflows, and operational risk.**

**- Experience with requirements gathering, process design, testing, implementation, and change management.**

**Must-Have Technical / Tools Criteria**

**- Must-have technical skills for this role include reporting, visualization, workflow, automation, and testing capabilities across the treasury ecosystem, including automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, SWIFT payment format testing automation, and treasury platform testing automation.**

**- Hands-on experience using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Sigma, Alteryx, SQL, Python, workflow tools, test automation frameworks, or low-code automation platforms to support treasury process improvement, reporting, and automation, with examples including Power Automate, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, KNIME, dbt, Apache Airflow, pytest, Robot Framework, and Selenium-based testing approaches.**

- Strong proficiency building dashboards, operational KPI views, variance analysis, issue trackers, reconciliations, and executive reporting materials.

**- Ability to define dashboard requirements, data models, business rules, workflow metrics, and reporting packs that support treasury oversight and exception-based processing.**

- Experience working with large data sets, control evidence, exception reports, process flows, testing evidence, and controls documentation.

**- Must have experience supporting or driving automation for SWIFT payment format testing, including payment message validation, formatting rule checks, bank-specific requirements, and regression testing across bank connectivity and treasury payment workflows.**

- Must have experience coordinating or executing automated testing across the treasury ecosystem, including payments, settlements, reporting, controls, interfaces, and related system integrations.

- Strong familiarity with SIT, UAT, regression testing, parallel runs, defect triage, test evidence management, and implementation readiness.

**- Ability to partner effectively with Technology teams, data teams, and operations stakeholders without being a pure technology role.**

- Exposure to AI-enabled automation or agentic workflow capabilities in treasury, finance, or operations is a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**- Experience in asset management, private equity, banking, capital markets, fintech, treasury operations, or global capability centers.**

**- Exposure to Treasury Management Systems, payment platforms, banking portals, ERP tools, reporting platforms, or workflow tools.**

**- Familiarity with SWIFT messaging, ISO 20022, bank connectivity, settlement processes, and treasury controls.**

**- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.**

**- CTP, PMP, CPA, CFA, or process improvement certification preferred.**

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Experience working at code level

jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Director, Technical Program Management’
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
Mastercard’s Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth & innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a ‘Director, Technical Program Management’ for Payment Reconciliation Intelligence program within B&MI, to provide program management leadership, cutting across different product areas.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Successfully lead major projects and complex assignments with broad scope and long-term business implications. Collaborate with business and technical partners to scope the opportunities, outline potential value and ROI, and identify risks, benefits and constraints.
* Be the owner for all Program-level initiatives while also ensuring success of individual delivery teams. Provide people leadership to technical program managers across the program.
* Assist in examining commercially available and forthcoming industry technologies related to area of expertise. Research on current and upcoming technologies and application frameworks and provide recommendations. Proactively create and maintain solution and technology roadmaps.
* Create detailed cost and time estimates for implementing business solutions, define technical scope and requirements of the project and assist your team with managing scope during the lifecycle of the project. Identify Program quality methodologies, define and track quality metrics and ensure continued process quality improvement within the program.
* Manage multiple scrum teams and be responsible to organize and lead all Agile/SAFe ceremonies. Be accountable for overall progress of the committed projects and enhance processes to streamline deliveries. Champion in tracking initiatives progress/reports using Agile project management tools such as Jira, Rally.
* Develop good technical understanding of product architecture & flows and be able to propose technical solutions. Possess hands-on technical capabilities to track, analyse or resolve critical issues and customer queries.
* Effectively manage internal and external stakeholders and participate in technical discussions as a program representative.
* Help customers and the product/engineering teams make trade-off decisions by considering all the data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. You identify blocking issues and manage their resolution.

  
  
**All About You**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent work experience, with a proven track-record of successfully leading and managing complex programs/projects/products.
* Advanced level understanding of Agile/SAFe methodologies with a demonstrated experience in organizing Agile/SAFe ceremonies, planning program & iteration deliverables, leading scrum meetings, managing cost & effort estimation and driving prioritization discussions.
* A solid foundation in Computer Science, with prior hands-on experience on .Net stack and/or Java stack (preferably on web applications and microservices-based software architecture and with an exposure to cloud technologies). Strong SQL skills would be a huge plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with quick adaptation to new technologies, methodologies, and systems.
* Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal) and experience with managing internal and external stakeholders at all management levels.
* High-energy, detail-oriented and proactive, with ability to function under pressure in an independent environment along with a high degree of initiative and self-motivation to drive results.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* Drive revenue growth, operational efficiency, service performance improvements and value realisation through transformation initiatives
* Manage programme governance, risks, dependencies, milestones and cross-functional delivery across multiple portfolios

* Exposure to senior leaders across global markets, business functions and technology organisations
* Ability to shape future operating models, services and business architecture across a leading international organisation
* Opportunity to influence AI-enabled transformation strategies and emerging technology adoption
* Collaboration with diverse global teams and strategic partners on high-profile transformation programmes

jobs.title: Director-Technology Controls Testing Team Lead
jobs.description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who have the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest and growing banks in the world.

**Profile Summary:**

The Technology Controls Team Lead leads the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team and the EMEA Technology Internal Control Testing Programme.

The role is responsible for the risk-based assessment of technology controls, including control design and operating effectiveness testing, evidence quality, issue identification, remediation monitoring and management reporting. The role also develops data-led, automated and continuous control-assurance capabilities.

Working across EMEA Technology, the role partners with control owners, Technology leadership and relevant oversight and assurance functions to strengthen the technology control environment while maintaining clear accountability across the three lines of defense.

**Technology Controls Framework and Testing:**

* Own and maintain the EMEA Technology Controls Testing Framework.
* Lead the Technology Internal Control Testing Programme, including methodology, planning, scope, approval, execution, quality assurance and reporting.
* Develop a risk-based testing plan using RCSA results, process mapping, risk appetite measures, incidents, control failures, audit findings, regulatory priorities and material technology changes.
* Prioritize controls associated with Critical and High inherent risks, while including Moderate-rated controls where justified by risk concentration, limited assurance coverage, control failures or emerging risk.
* Maintain a technology testing inventory covering control ownership, risk linkage, testing frequency, previous results, existing assurance coverage and open issues.
* Lead control walkthroughs and assessments of control design and operating effectiveness.
* Define testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Ensure conclusions are supported by complete, reliable and traceable evidence.
* Coordinate with IT Risk Assurance lead on SOX, Compliance, Head Office and other assurance programmes to minimize unnecessary duplication.
* Continuously improve testing methodology, guidance, templates and supporting tools.

**Issues and Remediation:**

* Ensure control deficiencies, self-identified issues, risk acceptances and treatment plans are consistently identified, recorded and escalated.
* Challenge control ownership, testing conclusions, remediation plans and proposed issue closure.
* Ensure remediation actions have clear owners and target dates.
* Monitor remediation through to closure and arrange validation or retesting where required.
* Identify recurring or systemic control weaknesses requiring coordinated remediation.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue actions and risk appetite breaches through the appropriate governance channels.

**Audit and Regulatory Readiness:**

* Coordinate Technology responses to internal audit, external audit, SOX and regulatory assurance activity.
* Maintain a coordinated view of assurance activity, findings, evidence requests, management responses and remediation commitments.
* Improve the quality and timeliness of evidence, walkthroughs and management responses.
* Maintain a reusable regional evidence base to support assurance activity.
* Ensure recurring audit and regulatory themes inform the control framework, testing plan and remediation priorities.
* Support senior-management and regulatory briefings on material technology control matters.

**Reporting and Governance:**

* Own management information covering technology control testing delivery, control effectiveness, issues, remediation, risk acceptances and recurring themes.
* Provide concise, accurate and decision-oriented reporting to Technology leadership and relevant governance forums.
* Act as the central escalation and prioritisation point for Technology control-testing matters.
* Represent the Chief Technology Controls Team at relevant committees and working groups.
* Ensure material control weaknesses and risks are escalated promptly and transparently.

**Data, Tools and Continuous Assurance:**

* Own the Technology Controls testing toolset, workflows, dashboards and analytics capability.
* Ensure testing plans, evidence, samples, conclusions, issues and remediation records are accurately maintained in approved repositories.
* Establish standards for evidence quality, naming, ownership, version control, retention, permissions and audit traceability.
* Lead evidence coordination and quality review with process and control owners.
* Develop automated monitoring and continuous control-testing capabilities where supported by reliable data and repeatable testing logic.
* Define appropriate governance for automated testing, including data quality, access, change control, exception handling and periodic validation.
* Explore the responsible use of AI to support evidence review, control mapping, testing preparation, exception identification, thematic analysis and reporting.
* Ensure that automation and AI retain appropriate governance, validation and human oversight.

**Leadership and People Management:**

* Lead and develop the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team, initially comprising three VP-level control resources.
* Set team priorities and allocate coverage according to risk, assurance requirements and business demand.
* Lead implementation of the target operating model.
* Establish clear objectives, accountabilities and quality expectations.
* Build team capability through training, coaching and knowledge management.
* Promote a constructive, evidence-led risk and control culture.
* Provide broader local Technology Management or Operations oversight only where formally assigned.

**Decision Authority (Within delegated authority, the role may):**

* Approve the proposed testing plan and material scope changes before governance submission.
* Determine testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Require additional evidence, expanded testing or retesting.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue remediation and inadequate risk acceptance.
* Prioritise team activity and allocate testing resources.
* Recommend control improvements and automation opportunities.
  ***Control owners remain accountable for operating their controls and remediating identified weaknesses. Risk acceptance remains subject to approval under the applicable risk-management framework.***

**Experience and Skills:**

* Significant experience in technology risk, technology controls, IT audit, cyber risk or a related discipline within regulated financial services.
* Experience leading a technology control-testing or management-assurance programme.
* Strong knowledge of control design and operating effectiveness testing, including walkthroughs, evidence assessment, sampling, reperformance and issue validation.
* Experience of RCSA, risk appetite, issue management, risk acceptance and governance reporting.
* Broad understanding of material technology risks and controls.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews or SOX activity.
* Proven leadership of senior risk or control professionals.
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to challenge constructively and explain complex control matters to senior management.
* Ability to work effectively across jurisdictions and multicultural teams.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation**
Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. You will work with world-class teams and insights, helping support delivery in challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to help unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we collaborate with teams to enable transforming finance.
  
  
**Level: Anaplan Manager**
As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of enterprise-scale software solutions, lead cross-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will collaborate to understand functional requirements, support sales and proposal efforts, and drive end-to-end project delivery, including estimation and planning, to ensure successful outcomes.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Functional Transformation on the Business Finance team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Anaplan implementations, including solution architecture, estimation, planning, quality management, and deployment.
* Manage project scope, staffing, timelines, risks, issues, and delivery execution across cross-functional and global teams.
* Serve as a primary client contact, provide strategic guidance, and align solution delivery with business objectives.
* Mentor and develop team members, support knowledge sharing, and help build Anaplan delivery capability across the practice.
* Contribute to practice development through go-to-market support, proposal activity, thought leadership, and capability-building initiatives.

**The team**
Business Finance is part of the Finance Transformation portfolio within Deloitte US India Consulting. Our team advises and implements digital finance strategies and technology solutions, helping clients enhance financial planning, analysis, and enterprise performance through a holistic approach from strategy to technology enablement.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* B. Tech or equivalent from an accredited university (required) / Master’s degree (preferred)
* 10+ years of experience delivering Anaplan implementations, including model design, development, deployment, and Hypercare.
* Experience leading large-scale, multi-phase Anaplan programs across business functions or geographies.
* Experience translating business requirements into multidimensional Anaplan models.
* Experience integrating Anaplan with enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Workday using native capabilities, application programming interfaces (APIs), or middleware tools.
* Experience conducting user acceptance testing (UAT) and preparing design, test, training, and administration documentation.
* Anaplan Certified Model Builder Level 1, Level 2, Anaplan Way, Level 3, and Anaplan Certified Solution Architect credentials.
* Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech) or equivalent from an accredited university.

**Preferred:**

* Anaplan Certified Master Anaplanner credential.
* Anaplan Data Orchestrator (ADO) certification.
* Experience supporting Anaplan Center of Excellence (CoE) initiatives, including governance, security, model standards, and model lifecycle management.
* Experience with Anaplan PlanIQ, Optimizer, Workflow, or Anaplan XL.
* Experience supporting request for proposal (RFP) responses for Anaplan solution opportunities.
* Master's degree.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

jobs.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Salesforce India Professional Services partners with enterprise customers to design, implement, and scale transformative Salesforce solutions. With deep platform expertise and a strong focus on business outcomes, we work with some of India's most complex and strategic organisations — making a real global impact from one of Salesforce's highest-priority growth markets.
  
  
**The Experience:**

As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior leader and a foremost expert in delivering business value from the Salesforce platform. This is a fully billable, high-impact role. You will be the Delivery Leader on strategic and complex customer engagements, and you will own the health, margin and outcomes of a multi-program portfolio.

You bring an India Financial Services background. You have delivered projects for banks, NBFCs, insurers and other FS clients, and you understand the domain and its regulatory context.

You are the strategic advisor and the point of accountability. You will drive platform adoption, demonstrate ROI, mitigate revenue and license attrition risk, and deliver agentic and generative AI programs on time, within budget and with quantifiable outcomes. You see risk before it lands and leave the portfolio and the team stronger than you found them. Keeping a project green is not enough.

  
  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing:**

* Program and portfolio governance: Own program governance, value-realization and recovery plans for strategic accounts, across multi-cloud and enterprise AI roadmaps in Indian FS (lending, onboarding, servicing, collections). Run the portfolio on live data, not static RAG status: margin variance, revenue, pipeline, billing milestones, bookings and delivered margin. Flag margin erosion and scope creep early.
* Executive stakeholder management: Work with C-level stakeholders to build trust, define success metrics and show measurable ROI. Lead Steering Committees and executive forums, and own executive-level escalations.
* Customer alignment: Challenge aggressive timelines and customer dependencies directly with the customer. Get their formal response recorded in the Delivery Review document.
* Risk, scope and compliance: Manage risks, dependencies and scope changes. Translate technical issues (AI compliance, data readiness, security boundaries) into business implications. Drive audits and written confirmations from PMs, architects and partner leads, with zero tolerance for issues such as unauthorized client-code pushes.
* Commercial and contract management: Support pre-sales in scoping and change management, and find expansion opportunities. Size the change-management and delivery effort for generative AI and digital agent rollouts. Define and oversee engagement models (T&M, Fixed Price) and keep delivery compliant with MSA/SOW terms.
* Delivery excellence and process discipline: Manage commitments, milestones and scope. Champion an AI-first delivery and engineering approach, and track program health, team velocity and efficiency. Make sure staffing, DSR and SWE processes are followed, not just reminded. Keep delivery review canvases and status artifacts complete and current, without being chased.
* Cross-functional influence and expertise: Guide customer, partner (SI) and internal teams (MuleSoft, UI/UX, technical PODs). Be a deep expert on the Salesforce platform, including new products, custom development, integration and data migration.
  

  

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience and domain: You have 15+ years in consulting or strategic advisory roles, managing large, complex SaaS/CRM implementations. You have an India Financial Services background (banking, NBFC/lending, insurance or wealth), have delivered projects there, and know FS processes, regulation and customer landscapes.
* Technical grounding: Some technical hands-on background is preferred, from development, solution architecture or technical lead roles. It lets you challenge estimates and designs and earn credibility with architects and developers.
* Platform expertise: You know Salesforce implementation patterns, integration, custom development and data migration. You understand Agentforce use cases and Data Cloud dependencies.
* Commercial and financial command: You are comfortable with PSA financials (margin, EVA, billing, forecast, utilization). You can explain a margin movement and act on it.
* Executive presence: You communicate exceptionally well, build C-level relationships, handle difficult conversations and negotiate high-stakes outcomes. You have recovered strategic accounts and driven adoption in at-risk environments.
* Ownership: You surface risks and gaps yourself and don't wait for reminders or escalations.
* People leadership: You have led pre-sales and delivery teams across geographies and cultures. You support learning, career growth, well-being, and diversity and inclusion. You coach people toward becoming well-rounded leaders and manage a workable span of control.
* Methodology and mindset:You have mastered Agile and Hybrid delivery, adapting these frameworks to the iterative testing loops of generative AI. As a self-starter, you will lead consultants and influence stakeholders across a matrixed organization. From a management perspective, you will champion an AI-First engineering methodology while tracking program health, team velocity, and overall efficiency.
  

  

**Education and certifications:**

* A degree or equivalent experience. You hold at least one of PMI-ACP, PMP, PgMP or Prince2.
* A Salesforce certification is an asset, and an AI Associate or related AI/ML delivery credential is highly valued.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

About This Role

**10 to 12 years of experience**  
**Skills: Strategic Account Management, Financial Services Domain Expertise, Client Relationship Management, Enterprise Sales & Commercial Ownership, Revenue Management & Sales Pipeline Management, Executive Stakeholder Management**

Sr. Director, Client Service (FIT)

**Location:** New York, USA

Bounteous is a premier end-to-end digital transformation consultancy dedicated to partnering with ambitious brands to create digital solutions for today’s complex challenges and tomorrow’s opportunities. With uncompromising standards for technical and domain expertise, we deliver innovative and strategic solutions in Strategy, Analytics, Digital Engineering, Cloud, Data & AI, Experience Design, and Marketing.

Our Co-Innovation methodology is a unique engagement model designed to align interests and accelerate value creation. Our clients worldwide benefit from the skills and expertise of over 5,000+ expert team members across the Americas, APAC, and EMEA. By partnering with leading technology providers, we craft transformative digital experiences that enhance customer engagement and drive business success.

We are seeking a Senior Director, Client Service, based in New York, to join our growing Financial Services (FIT) Business Unit. This role is responsible for building and expanding strategic relationships with enterprise financial services clients, driving account growth, developing new opportunities within existing accounts, and ensuring exceptional client satisfaction.

The ideal candidate brings strong financial services industry knowledge, a proven track record of commercial account ownership within technology consulting or digital transformation services, and the ability to build relationships with senior business and technology executives. Experience driving growth across digital engineering, cloud, data, AI, and enterprise transformation initiatives is highly valued.

Role and Responsibilities

* Oversee and grow a portfolio of strategic financial services client accounts, comprising $5MM+ in annual revenue.

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with executive leaders and senior business and technology stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and other key decision-makers.

* Drive organic account growth by identifying, developing, and expanding opportunities within existing financial services clients.

* Partner with clients and internal teams to design and deliver innovative digital transformation, engineering, cloud, data, and AI solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

* Develop a deep understanding of clients' business strategies, technology landscapes, industry challenges, and transformation priorities across banking, payments, insurance, capital markets, and other financial services sectors.

* Develop and execute strategic account plans focused on revenue growth, relationship expansion, client retention, and long-term partnership development.

* Identify opportunities to expand Bounteous' services across client organizations, including digital engineering, cloud modernization, data platforms, AI, customer experience, and marketing technology.

* Build and manage a qualified pipeline of account expansion opportunities, partnering with solutioning, engineering, and delivery teams to develop proposals and secure new business.

* Collaborate with practice and competency leaders to deliver integrated solutions across strategy, data, experience, and engineering.

* Guide cross-functional teams from solution design through delivery and optimization, ensuring alignment with client objectives and business outcomes.

* Navigate complex client organizations, influence executive decision-making, and participate in key planning and strategic initiatives.

* Understand and address client priorities, business challenges, and concerns while maintaining strong client satisfaction and retention.

* Oversee Statement of Work development, contract negotiations, renewals, and account expansion in partnership with finance, legal, delivery, and engineering teams.

* Partner closely with Program Delivery teams to ensure successful execution, client satisfaction, and alignment with contractual commitments, budgets, and strategic outcomes.

* Maintain accurate account revenue forecasts, sales pipeline visibility, and growth projections within Salesforce.

* Stay informed on financial services industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving client needs to proactively identify opportunities for innovation and account growth.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* 10+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, client services, or strategic account leadership, with significant experience supporting financial services clients.

* Demonstrated success managing and growing enterprise financial services accounts with direct commercial ownership, revenue accountability, and account expansion responsibilities.

* Strong understanding of the financial services industry, including banking, payments, insurance, capital markets, or fintech.

* Experience selling and expanding technology consulting services across digital engineering, cloud, data, AI, and enterprise transformation.

* Established relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and other executive decision-makers.

* Proven ability to develop strategic account plans, identify growth opportunities, manage sales pipelines, and negotiate commercial agreements.

* Experience collaborating with delivery, engineering, and solutioning teams to successfully execute complex client engagements.

* Strong executive presence, business acumen, communication, and negotiation skills.

* Experience operating within a matrixed consulting or technology services organization.

* BA/BS degree or equivalent relevant professional experience preferred.

Apply now

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.

**About the Role**
------------------

This role sits within the Corporate Research & Analysis (R&A) team, supporting the International segment and combining portfolio management responsibilities (80%) with people leadership responsibilities (20%).

  

You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of complex corporate and institutional clients, including Group Relationship Point (GRP), Credit Point (CP), and Authorized Point (AP) relationships. Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

**Business**

• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**About Submer**  
  
**At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.**

**Your impact**

Submer India is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead and build the Finance function in India. This is a growth- and investment-oriented role with particular responsibility for capital strategy, fundraising and the financial architecture supporting enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion.

The CFO will own the India capital agenda within approved mandates, working with India and Group leadership to secure financing and lead transactions through financial closure. The role requires an accomplished senior finance leader with demonstrated CFO-level responsibility and a proven record of personally leading and closing capital-raising transactions, preferably within technology, infrastructure, digital infrastructure, datacentres, engineering, energy or other high-growth and capital-intensive businesses.

The successful candidate will combine capital-raising capability with strong financial stewardship, governance and compliance. The CFO must understand the complete business lifecycle, from establishment and capitalisation through growth, scaling, restructuring and potential strategic transactions and/or potential exit, and be able to operate in an entrepreneurial technology and infrastructure environment.

**What you'll do**

**1. Strategic Financial Leadership**
=====================================

* Act as a key member of the India leadership team and provide strategic financial leadership to support Submer's growth and long-term enterprise value.
* Develop and execute the financial and capital strategy for the India business, linking enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion to appropriate sources of funding.
* Partner with business and operational leadership on investments, expansion plans and commercial opportunities, providing financial insight, strategic decisions and constructive challenge.
* Build scalable financial structures, processes, controls and planning capabilities suitable for a high growth organisation
* Build long term business planning and value creation.

**2. Investment, Fundraising and Capital Raising**
==================================================

* Lead the development and execution of capital-raising strategies for Submer's India business and strategic initiatives, aligned with approved plans and funding mandates.

* Lead India investor and lender engagement, financial presentations and, 'fund-sourcing to fund-raising to investment' plans and subsequent discussions; *(coordinate with Group finance and support Group-led transactions under the agreed mandate.)*

* Lead financial due diligence readiness, strategic investment, financial structuring and financing negotiations through financial closure, coordinating legal, tax, business and technical inputs and obtaining required approvals.
* Agree capital-raising milestones with leadership and report on funding secured, transaction progress, financing terms and deployment of proceeds; maintain appropriate investor and lender reporting.

**3. Business Lifecycle and Growth Strategy**
=============================================

Guide the business through its financial lifecycle and ensure that funding structures and financial capabilities evolve with its stage of development. This includes:

* Business establishment, entity structuring, financial planning and initial capitalisation.
* Early-stage growth, scaling, fundraising and infrastructure or project expansion.
* Financial governance, commercial growth, profitability and long-term value creation.
* Mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, restructuring and business transformation.
* Transaction readiness and potential exit planning.

Align corporate growth capital, project or asset financing and subsequent refinancing or strategic transactions with business needs, risk appetite and approved return objectives.

**4. Financial Planning, Analysis and Performance Management**
==============================================================

* Lead annual budgeting, long-term financial planning, forecasts and scenario modelling.
* Monitor financial and operational performance against approved plans
* Analyze profitability, cash flow, capital requirements and investment returns.
* Track business and project performance against approved investment cases, identify variances and recommend corrective action.

* Identify and mitigate financial and business risks, including financing covenant compliance and related-party exposures.

**7. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management**

* Monitor capital expenditure and investment commitments and optimise the use of capital across approved business, for infrastructure- and project-based requirements.

jobs.title: Director Development
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.




**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

**Finastra: Who are we?**

Formed in 2017 by the combination of Misys and D+H, we provide the broadest portfolio of financial services software in the world today—spanning Lending, Payments and Universal Banking businesses.

Our solutions enable customers to deploy mission critical technology on premises or in the cloud. With our scale and geographical reach we drive valued solutions and opportunity for customers regardless of size or geography. Through our open, secure, and reliable solutions, we empower customers to accelerate growth, optimize cost, mitigate risk and continually evolve to meet their changing needs.

  

**Universal Banking business:**

In June 2026, Finastra agreed to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with the sale expected to complete in early 2027. This role is part of the CTO Leadership Team for Universal Banking and will play a critical part in shaping the engineering organization of the new Universal Banking business. You will join Finastra initially and, on completion of the sale, your employment will transfer with the Universal Banking business to its new ownership.

  

**Role Summary**

The Lending Engineering Director is a Grade 9, M4 (Director) leadership role accountable for the engineering of the Universal Banking Lending product line. Managing through others, the Director leads a multi-disciplinary engineering organization of squads and squad leads, and owns end-to-end software delivery, from requirements and design through build, test, release, deployment and production operations, using an agentic AI-first engineering model. Operating independently within business and functional policies, the Director sets engineering direction and allocates resources across programmes and services. As a member of the CTO Leadership Team, the Director partners with Product, GTM and Services, and represents Lending engineering up to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT).

  

**Role Impact**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

The Director of Product Management is a managerial position that supports the global growth of USP’s material products including Reference Standards, Analytical Reference Materials, Pharmaceutical Analytical Impurities, Certified Reference Materials and the Materials Strategy Program across the USP Novel Medicines, Generics, and Consumer Health business units.

**Description**

Financial Controller – Entrance Control Middle East is responsible for leading the finance function, ensuring financial integrity, regulatory compliance, effective financial planning, and sustainable business performance. The role acts as a strategic business partner to the Managing Director and leadership team, providing financial insights to support commercial decisions, profitability, operational efficiency, and business growth. The position has overall responsibility for financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow and working capital management, tax compliance, financial controls, risk management, audit coordination, and the development of robust finance processes across the region. The role requires a combination of strategic financial leadership, strong technical accounting expertise, commercial acumen, and an in-depth understanding of UAE financial and tax regulations. It also requires close collaboration with global finance teams, business unit leaders, sales, service, operations, procurement, and other relevant stakeholders.

jobs.title: Implementation Director
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead end-to-end implementation and transformation programs for strategic Pismo clients, from contract signature and mobilization through go-live and post-launch stabilization.
* Serve as the primary executive point of contact for client leadership teams, building trusted relationships with C-suite, business, operations, technology, and transformation stakeholders.
* Drive governance, delivery strategy, program execution, dependency management, and risk mitigation across complex multi-workstream initiatives.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, Information Security, Risk, and Commercial teams to ensure successful delivery against client commitments.
* Establish executive steering committees and governance forums, providing clear visibility into program progress, milestones, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.
* Navigate complex organizational environments to align stakeholders, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain momentum across large-scale transformation programs.
* Champion implementation excellence while ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, and accelerated time-to-value.
* Support clients through change management, platform adoption, and operational readiness as they transition onto Pismo's cloud-native infrastructure.
* Capture lessons learned and implementation best practices to continuously strengthen Visa and Pismo's delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

  

* Over 15 years of experience in technology-driven financial services, with a strong focus on leading large-scale implementation and transformation projects for global fintech's and banks.
* Detailed technical knowledge of payments ecosystem in GCC countries, more specifically implementation and certification of Jaywan and AEP Switch in UAE
* Technical knowledge of payments and banking platforms operating in the cloud in a microservice architecture, with REST/JSON API’s and data streaming.
* Educational background in solutions architecture and software engineering. Cloud certifications are a plus.
* Having completed a core banking, payments transformation implementation from contract signature to production live.
* Expertise in building and scaling high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style that emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, and a culture of accountability.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-market projects on time and within scope, leveraging advanced project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, and hybrid models) and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
* Recognized for forging strong, trust-based relationships with C-level executives, clients, and cross-functional partners, ensuring alignment and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Adept at translating business strategy into actionable plans, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision-making and KPI management.
* Russian speaker is highly desirable

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Within the Installed Base Domain organization, we are looking for a Value Stream Leader - Connectivity Systems to define and drive the strategic vision, roadmap, and execution of the Connectivity Systems value stream. Establish and maintain end-to-end visibility of the Installed Base from manufacturing through customer deployment and operation. Ensure connectivity data becomes a trusted business asset supporting customer value creation, service excellence, and digital growth initiatives.
* Systems Lifecycle Management: Establish a comprehensive framework for tracking systems throughout their entire lifecycle from a customer-centric perspective. Define business capabilities, data requirements, and governance needed to support visibility and lifecycle management across connected products and systems. Partner with business and digital stakeholders to identify opportunities for lifecycle optimization and enhanced customer experience.

Partner with Data Experts, Data Architects, E2E Business Architects, and IB Digital teams to translate business needs into actionable delivery plans. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and deployment activities in collaboration with Project Managers, Deployment Teams, and Delivery Leaders. Ensure solutions deliver measurable business value and meet stakeholder expectations.
* Strategic Roadmap Management: Co-create and maintain the annual Connectivity Systems roadmap in alignment with business objectives and digital transformation priorities. Balance short-term business needs with long-term strategic goals and architecture direction. Monitor emerging technologies, connectivity trends, and digital capabilities to continuously evolve the roadmap.

Ensure initiatives are delivered according to agreed priorities, timelines, and expected outcomes.

What your typical day would look like? We are seeking a highly technical, visionary, and hands-on Leaders to champion our full-stack AI Centers of Excellence (CoEs). In this leadership role, you will sit at the intersection of advanced AI solutioning, hyperscaler ecosystems (specifically GCP/AWS/Azure), and robust full-stack engineering. You will be responsible for designing and deploying end-to-end Agentic AI systems, bringing both deep technical execution and executive-level solutioning to our clients. If you are passionate about moving beyond simple wrappers to engineer robust, enterprise-grade cognitive architectures, this role is for you. As part of this role, you will:

  

* **Drive Hyperscaler CoE Innovation:** Architect and scale full-stack GenAI solutions heavily integrated with hyperscaler ecosystems, with a deep focus on GCP (Vertex AI), Anthropic (Claude/Cortex), and adjacent modern AI stacks.

* **Deliver Strategic Solutioning:** Partner closely with senior leadership and client stakeholders to translate intricate business challenges into scalable, production-ready AI blueprints.
* **Mentor and Build Elite Teams:** Cultivate, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of AI full-stack engineers and data scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence and aggressive innovation.

  

**EXPERTISE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

  

**Who do we expect ?**

  

* **Experience:** 15+ years of technical engineering experience, with at least 4+ years of dedicated leadership in leading NLP, Deep Learning, and Generative AI applications.
* **Hyperscaler & AI Ecosystem Depth:** Extensive hands-on experience with GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, GKE) , Anthropic model suites, and deep familiarity with frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI/Autogen for agentic setups.
* **Core GenAI Skills:**Proven expertise in building production RAG frameworks, advanced prompt optimization, and applying parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, PEFT).
* Strong background in full-stack architecture, featuring elite Python skills, API/Microservices design (FastAPI, Django, or Flask), and exposure to modern UI engineering patterns for AI interactions. Infrastructure & MLOps Mastery:Proficient with Docker, Kubernetes, and automated CI/CD infrastructure, ensuring reliable scaling, low latency, and robust mitigation against LLM vulnerabilities (hallucinations, security bias).
* **Data Engineering Literacy**:Solid fundamentals in distributed computing, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector), and cloud data warehouse ecosystems.
* **Leadership & Influence:**Strong executive presence, capable of fluidly pivoting from technical deep-dives with engineers to strategic product roadmap discussions with enterprise buyers.

  

**You are important to us, lets stay connected!**

  

Every individual comes with a different set of skills and qualities so even if you dont tick all the boxes for the role today, we urge you to apply as there might be a suitable/unique role for you tomorrow. We are an equal-opportunity employer. Our diverse and inclusive culture and values guide us to listen, trust, respect, and encourage people to grow the way they desire.

  

**Note:** The designation will be commensurate with expertise and experience. Compensation packages are among the best in the industry. Additional Benefits: Health insurance (self & family), virtual wellness platform, and knowledge communities.
