jobs.title: Sr Applied Scientist - Semantics
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**   

AuxoAI is seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to design and deploy structured knowledge systems that enable reliable, schema-grounded AI and agent reasoning. This role sits at the intersection of large language models, knowledge graphs, semantic architectures, and hybrid retrieval systems. The ideal candidate will build systems that transform unstructured data into structured knowledge representations, enforce semantic constraints, and enable hybrid symbolic-neural reasoning in production environments. You will play a key role in designing scalable semantic infrastructures that support advanced AI use cases such as GraphRAG pipelines, structured extraction, and agent reasoning workflows. You will work on problems where existing architectures may not be sufficient and will experiment with new approaches that combine machine learning, knowledge graphs, semantic constraints, and classical AI techniques to build reliable, production-grade systems. Location - Mumbai / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurgaon (Hybrid - 3 Days a week in Office)

  
  
**Responsibilities**   

* Design schema-guided information extraction systems using zero-shot and few-shot structured prompting, constrained decoding approaches such as JSON schema enforcement or grammar-based decoding, and function-calling or tool-driven extraction techniques.
* Develop recursive or multi-stage extraction pipelines capable of handling nested entities, hierarchical structures, and cross-document relationships.
* Build ontology-driven systems using frameworks such as LinkML, OWL, SHACL, or similar schema modeling tools, and implement knowledge representations using RDF triples or labeled property graphs.
* Design and optimize entity resolution algorithms using techniques such as blocking strategies, embedding similarity, and rule-based matching.
* Develop ontology alignment techniques and graph embedding models such as Node2Vec or TransE-style approaches where appropriate.
* Design hybrid retrieval architectures combining dense vector retrieval, sparse retrieval techniques, and graph traversal algorithms such as BFS, DFS, path ranking, and neighborhood expansion.
* Build validation systems that enforce schema conformance, detect semantic inconsistencies, and reduce hallucinated or invalid structured outputs.
* Integrate structured knowledge systems into GraphRAG pipelines, agent planning frameworks, and tool-selection workflows.
* Deliver production-grade semantic systems with clear targets for latency, scalability, reliability, and data integrity.

  
  
**Requirements**   

* 5+ years of experience building production AI or machine learning systems.
* Strong experience designing and implementing knowledge graphs or ontology-driven architectures.
* Hands-on experience implementing structured extraction techniques, including grammar-constrained decoding, JSON schema enforcement, or AST-style parsing approaches.
* Experience building entity resolution systems beyond simple embedding similarity methods.
* Experience working with graph query languages such as SPARQL or Cypher and optimizing graph query performance.
* Familiarity with RDF, OWL, or property graph data models and semantic data architectures.
* Strong Python engineering skills, with emphasis on data validation, schema integrity, and system reliability.
* Experience designing hybrid symbolic and neural AI systems.

  
  
**Nice to Have**   

* Experience implementing graph algorithms such as PageRank, community detection, or shortest-path algorithms for reasoning chains.
* Experience building graph-enhanced retrieval systems such as GraphRAG.
* Experience designing compositional semantic extraction pipelines.
* Experience implementing reasoning engines or rule-based inference systems.
* Experience benchmarking and evaluating structural extraction accuracy and consistency.

  
  
Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

jobs.title: Professor Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)
jobs.description:
**PROFESSOR COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING (CSE)**

**Specialization:** Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms & Graph Theory

**Department:** Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)  
 **Location:** Hyderabad  
 **Reporting To:** Head of the Department / Principal  
 **Position:** Professor

**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To provide academic leadership and deliver quality teaching and research in Computer Science & Engineering, with specialization in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory.

The Professor will be responsible for teaching undergraduate and postgraduate students, guiding research scholars, mentoring faculty members, promoting research and innovation, and contributing to the academic and research development of the department.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Teaching & Academic Responsibilities**

* Teach Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory to undergraduate and postgraduate engineering students.
* Prepare course plans, lecture materials, assignments, tutorials and assessment methodologies.
* Teach machine learning concepts, supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, model evaluation and predictive modelling.
* Explain data collection, preprocessing, statistical analysis, data visualization and analytical techniques.
* Teach algorithm design techniques, computational complexity, optimization and problem-solving methods.
* Explain graph structures, graph algorithms, network analysis and graph-based applications.
* Conduct laboratory sessions, programming assignments, technical demonstrations and project-based learning activities wherever applicable.
* Evaluate student performance and provide academic guidance and mentoring.
* Implement Outcome-Based Education (OBE), including Course Outcomes (COs), assessment and attainment analysis.
* Contribute to curriculum improvement and the development of effective teaching and learning practices.

**B. Research & Development**

* Conduct research in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Algorithm Design, Graph Theory and related emerging technologies.
* Publish quality research papers in reputed peer-reviewed journals and international conferences.
* Apply for funded research projects, grants and consultancy opportunities from government agencies and industry.
* Guide Ph.D. research scholars, postgraduate dissertations and undergraduate research projects, subject to university recognition and eligibility.
* Encourage interdisciplinary research, innovation, patents and industry collaboration.
* Establish research collaborations with reputed academic institutions and research organizations.
* Contribute to the development of research laboratories and departmental research activities.

**C. Academic Leadership & Departmental Responsibilities**

* Mentor junior faculty members and support their teaching, research and professional development.
* Contribute to curriculum development, academic planning and continuous improvement.
* Participate in Board of Studies, academic committees and institutional development activities.
* Coordinate workshops, seminars, conferences, technical events and Faculty Development Programmes (FDPs).
* Support NBA, NAAC, AICTE and other accreditation and quality assurance activities.
* Contribute to departmental academic administration, research planning and institutional development.
* Promote industry-academia collaboration and student skill development initiatives.

**3. REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS**

**A. Machine Learning**

* Supervised and Unsupervised Learning
* Regression, Classification and Clustering
* Feature Engineering and Feature Selection
* Neural Networks and Deep Learning Fundamentals
* Model Training, Validation, Testing and Evaluation
* Ensemble Learning Techniques
* Predictive Modelling and Performance Optimization
* Python and Machine Learning Libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch

**B. Data Analytics**

* Data Collection, Cleaning and Preprocessing
* Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
* Statistical Analysis and Hypothesis Testing
* Data Visualization and Interpretation
* Python / R Programming
* SQL and Database Management
* Data Analytics Libraries such as Pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib
* Business Intelligence Tools such as Power BI, Tableau or equivalent
* Predictive Analytics and Data-Driven Decision-Making

**C. Design and Analysis of Algorithms**

* Data Structures and Algorithm Design
* Time and Space Complexity Analysis
* Asymptotic Notations
* Sorting and Searching Algorithms
* Divide and Conquer Techniques
* Greedy Algorithms
* Dynamic Programming
* Backtracking and Branch and Bound
* Graph Algorithms
* NP-Completeness and Computational Complexity
* Algorithm Optimization and Performance Analysis

**D. Graph Theory**

* Graph Structures and Representations
* Directed and Undirected Graphs
* Graph Traversal Algorithms (BFS and DFS)
* Connectivity, Trees and Spanning Trees
* Shortest Path Algorithms
* Minimum Spanning Tree Algorithms
* Graph Coloring and Matching
* Network Flow and Graph Optimization
* Graph-Based Modelling and Network Analysis
* Applications of Graph Theory in Computer Science

**4. REQUIRED EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS**

**Undergraduate Qualification**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology or an equivalent relevant discipline.

**Postgraduate Qualification**

* M.E. / M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or an equivalent relevant discipline.

**Doctoral Qualification**

* Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science or a relevant allied discipline.

**Preferred Teaching and Research Specializations**

* Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
* Data Analytics and Data Science
* Design and Analysis of Algorithms
* Graph Theory and Graph Algorithms
* Computational Complexity and Optimization
* Applied Machine Learning and Predictive Analytics

*Educational qualifications and eligibility shall be subject to applicable AICTE, UGC, Osmania University and institutional recruitment norms.*

**5. EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Teaching, research and professional experience as prescribed under applicable AICTE/UGC and university norms for appointment to the position of Professor.
* Proven teaching experience in undergraduate and postgraduate Computer Science & Engineering programmes.
* Demonstrated ability to independently handle Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory.
* Experience in guiding postgraduate dissertations and Ph.D. research scholars, as permitted under university regulations.
* Strong research publication record in reputed peer-reviewed journals and conferences.
* Experience in academic leadership, curriculum development and faculty mentoring.
* Experience in funded research projects, consultancy, industry collaboration and institutional development will be preferred.

**6. REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Strong knowledge of core Computer Science & Engineering subjects.
* Expertise in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Algorithm Design and Graph Theory.
* Strong programming and analytical skills using Python, R, SQL and relevant development tools.
* Ability to develop and demonstrate machine learning models and data analytics applications.
* Strong understanding of algorithm design, complexity analysis and graph-based problem-solving.
* Excellent teaching, communication, mentoring and academic leadership skills.
* Strong research, analytical and technical problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to guide research scholars and contribute to funded research and consultancy activities.
* Ability to independently handle all four identified subjects.
* Ability to mentor faculty members and contribute to departmental academic and research development.

Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. We support integration of renewables, digital engineering, and global compliance standards to ensure reliable and sustainable energy delivery.

The BIM team drives digital transformation by creating accurate 3D models, enabling clash detection, and supporting Scan-to-BIM workflows. Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo, and collaboration on global projects-ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.

* Hands-on experience in Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), including project setup in Revit, layout preparation, support structure modelling, concrete structures reinforcement detailing, power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
* Familiarity with National Grid standards is a significant advantage.
* Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo, and other BIM-related tools.
* Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC) and experience with Scan-to-BIM workflows.
* Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.

 **About you**  

*Technical Competencies*

*Essential*

* Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo.
* Strong understanding of CAD/BIM standards and drawing protocols.

* Experience with EDMS and drawing control protocols.
* Capable of implementing GDC BMS QSE procedures.
* Knowledge of project programming and resource utilization.

*Desirable*

* Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
* Experience with 3D modelling and BIM standards.
* Familiarity with BEP and Xrefs.

*Behavioural Competencies*

* Strong communication and report-writing skills.
* Team-oriented with leadership potential.
* Detail-oriented and quality-focused.

jobs.description:
****Job Description******Overview**  

Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization.

The Protection Control (PC) Design team plays a critical role in ensuring the safe operation, monitoring, automation, and protection of power system assets. The team develops engineering designs for 11kV,33kV,132kV,275Kv and 400kV substations, including protection schemes, control systems. Opportunities include working on complex international projects, developing detailed engineering deliverables, supporting multidisciplinary coordination, and driving design excellence through digital engineering tools and industry best practices. This role is ideal for professionals passionate about substation protection and control engineering, electrical system reliability, digital transformation, and delivering innovative solutions for the evolving energy sector.

AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical Protection Control (PC) Lead Designer with 5-10 years of substation design experience and strong proficiency in AutoCAD to join our Bangalore office. This role involves supporting the delivery of Protection Control engineering and CAD deliverables for 132 kV to 400 kV AIS and GIS substations, covering both greenfield and brownfield projects across domestic and international markets.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing high-quality PC design outputs, including protection schematics, control and relay panel drawings, wiring diagrams, interconnection diagrams, AC/DC schematics, cable schedules, and Substation documentation. Working closely with Protection Engineers and multidisciplinary project teams, the role requires ensuring compliance with international standards, client specifications, and project quality requirements.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to complex projects across Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewable Energy and nuclear sectors, while supporting the digital transformation of substations through modern engineering practices and innovative design solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical understanding of substation protection and control systems, excellent drafting skills, and a commitment to delivering engineering excellence.

* Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
* Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.

* Proficiency in AutoCAD and Raster Design; exposure to MicroStation, Revit, or other engineering design tools is advantageous and experience in preparing protection schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, interconnection diagrams, and cable schedules.
* Good understanding of IEC, IEEE, utility, and client-specific standards related to substation design.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Protection Engineers, Primary, Civil, Telecom, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Experience in preparing, checking, and reviewing PC drawings while ensuring quality, accuracy, and compliance with project requirements.
* A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
* Familiarity with National Grid (UK) standards is a significant advantage.
* Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
* Exposure to international substation projects and utility standards is an advantage.
* Strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to mentor junior designers and support project delivery.

 **About you**  

*Technical Competencies*

*Essential*

* Proficiency in AutoCAD Raster Design
* Excellent drafting and detailing skills.
* Strong understanding of substation protection and control systems.
* Strong understanding of CAD/PC standards and drawing protocols.
* Ability to prepare and check PC Interface drawings.
* Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD standards, project procedures, and drawing control requirements

*Desirable*

jobs.title: Principal Solution Architect - Distribution Technology
jobs.description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
We are seeking a Principal Solution Architect to provide architecture and hands-on technical leadership across Distribution Technology platforms and strategic initiatives. The role is responsible for translating business and technology requirements into secure, scalable, resilient and maintainable solutions spanning Microsoft Azure, data platforms, API and integration architecture, cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps, digital platforms and AI-enabled solutions.This is not a conceptual architecture position. The architect is expected to be hand on and implement solutions, working across architecture, infrastructure, application development, data engineering, security, production support and business teams to take solutions from design through implementation and operational readiness.
  
  
**Major Duties And Responsibilities**
Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership
  
  
Own end-to-end solution architecture & implementation for complex Distribution Technology initiatives, from discovery and option analysis through detailed design, implementation, deployment and production stabilization.
  
  
Translate functional and non-functional requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable application, integration, data and cloud architectures.
  
  
Define architecture patterns and reusable solutions that can be adopted across multiple applications and technology teams.
  
  
Implement complex use cases & provide hands-on technical guidance during implementation and troubleshoot complex cross-platform issues.
  
  
Conduct design reviews and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, resiliency and engineering standards.
  
  
Work across application, data, infrastructure, security, network, DevOps and production-support teams to resolve technical dependencies.
  
  
**Azure Cloud Architecture and Engineering**
Architect and implement cloud solutions using Microsoft Azure services.
  
  
Lead application and platform modernization, including cloud migration and environment upgrades.
  
  
Design solutions using Azure Functions, App Services, Databricks, databases, Azure Front Door, Application Gateway and API Management (APIM).
  
  
Define cloud infrastructure, networking, ingress, DNS, API exposure and security integration patterns.
  
  
Partner with infrastructure and cloud engineering teams on provisioning, configuration and operational readiness.
  
  
Drive reusable cloud architecture patterns across Distribution applications.
  
  
**API and Integration Architecture**
Design & implement secure API and service integration for internal and externally consumed capabilities.
  
  
Define appropriate use of API gateways, ingress components, DNS, authentication, routing and security controls.
  
  
Design integrations across application, data, SaaS and enterprise technology platforms.
  
  
Support externally exposed APIs through appropriate edge, network and security architecture.
  
  
Diagnose and resolve complex integration issues spanning multiple technology layers.
  
  
**Data Platform and Data Integration**
Architect & implement data movement and integration across operational databases, enterprise data platforms and downstream applications.
  
  
Design batch and pipeline-based data ingestion solutions and establish reliable end-to-end data flows.
  
  
Work with Snowflake, Databricks, relational databases and ETL/data pipelines.
  
  
Define data structures, views and interfaces consumed by applications and analytics platforms.
  
  
Partner with enterprise data and application teams on entity, client and product data integrations.
  
  
Support data lineage, data quality and troubleshooting across complex flows.
  
  
**DevSecOps and Engineering Enablement**
Define and improve automated CI/CD patterns for cloud applications and services.
  
  
Work with enterprise DevOps teams to automate build, deployment and environment workflows.
  
  
Promote infrastructure automation, repeatable deployments and environment consistency.
  
  
Establish engineering practices that improve deployment reliability and reduce manual operational effort.
  
  
Provide architecture and technical guidance on source control, deployment pipelines, configuration and runtime environments.
  
  
**Strategic Platforms and Emerging Technology·**
Provide architecture leadership for strategic NTAM Distribution initiatives involving digital, data and AI capabilities.
  
  
Collaborate with enterprise AI and platform teams on infrastructure and integration requirements for GenAI-enabled applications.
  
  
Evaluate emerging technology through prototypes and proof-of-concepts while keeping architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
Develop reusable architecture approaches for new capabilities rather than creating initiative-specific solutions wherever possible.
  
  
Production Reliability and Operational Support
  
  
Provide senior technical support for complex production incidents and platform issues.
  
  
Identify root causes and coordinate resolution across application, infrastructure, data and upstream/downstream teams.
  
  
Design solutions for operability, monitoring, maintainability and supportability from the outset.
  
  
Improve existing manual operational processes through automation.
  
  
Ensure successful transition from project delivery into sustainable production support.
  
  
**Technical Leadership and Collaboration**
Act as a senior technical partner to product owners, project managers, engineers, architects, security teams and business stakeholders.
  
  
Mentor engineers and provide architecture and design guidance through complex implementation challenges.
  
  
Lead technical discussions and help teams move from problem identification to pragmatic implementation.
  
  
Document architecture patterns, decisions and implementation guidance for reuse across teams.
  
  
Influence technology direction without requiring direct authority over all contributing teams.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

jobs.title: Solution Architect -VP

You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
  
  
To be successful as a VP - Solution Architect at Barclays you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Strong experience in creating technical documents such E2E Design / High Level Design / Architectural Vision.
* Strong experience in relevant technologies (Java/.Net/Mainframe/DB2/MSSQL).
* Experience in application integration technologies (MQ, C:D, APIs).
* Experience in application infrastructure both on premises, external, and Public Cloud (AWS).
* Experience in Project Management both Agile and Waterfall.
* Able to demonstrate previous evidence of drive, energy, commitment and enthusiasm.
* Experienced technical Solution Architect.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Understanding of Trade and Working Capital domain.
* Professional certifications e.g. TOGAF.
* Experience with financial instruments deposits, loans, and treasury.
* Strong data and database architecture expertise across enterprise relational and NoSQL platforms.
* Proven leadership in regulatory driven design, ensuring auditability, traceability, model transparency, and compliance (e.g., Basel III).
* Understanding of Banking and Financial Services Industry.

Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership, including mentoring architects, influencing roadmaps, and driving cross functional alignment.
  
  
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures.
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Senior SAP & ERP Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
**Senior SAP & ERP Transformation Lead**

**Experience:** 1012+ Years  
 **Qualification:** B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent  
 **Preferred Expertise:** SAP, ERP Architecture, ERP Migration, Process Re-engineering and System Integration

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced SAP & ERP Transformation professional with deep end-to-end knowledge of SAP's technical and functional architecture, who can assess, rationalise and eventually lead the migration of the organisation's existing SAP ecosystem to an alternative ERP platform.

The individual will be responsible for understanding the existing SAP landscape across modules, mapping interdependencies between processes, identifying redundancies and recommending an appropriate future-state ERP architecture.

The role requires a strong combination of technical programming capabilities, functional SAP expertise, business process understanding and ERP migration experience. The individual should be capable of evaluating how a change in one module, process or configuration impacts other interconnected business functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End SAP Architecture & Expertise**

* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the existing SAP landscape, including its modules, configurations, customisations, workflows and integrations.
* Demonstrate strong techno-functional knowledge across SAP modules such as:

+ SAP MM – Materials Management
+ SAP PP – Production Planning
+ SAP SD – Sales & Distribution
+ SAP FI/CO – Finance & Controlling
+ SAP QM – Quality Management
+ SAP PM – Plant Maintenance
+ SAP WM/EWM – Warehouse Management
+ SAP HCM – Human Capital Management

* Understand the interdependencies between modules and assess the downstream and upstream impact of system-level changes.
* Review existing custom developments, ABAP code, interfaces, reports and system configurations.

**2. ERP Migration & Transformation**

* Lead the assessment and migration strategy for transitioning from the existing SAP environment to an alternative ERP platform.
* Evaluate suitable ERP solutions such as Oracle ERP, ERPNext or other enterprise platforms based on business requirements.
* Develop a comprehensive migration roadmap covering data, processes, applications, integrations and infrastructure.
* Identify functionalities that can be migrated, redesigned, consolidated or eliminated.
* Ensure data integrity, business continuity and minimal operational disruption during migration.
* Lead migration planning, testing, validation, deployment and post-implementation stabilisation.

**3. Business Process Re-engineering**

* Map and document existing end-to-end business processes across departments.
* Identify redundant, overlapping, outdated or inefficient processes.
* Design, restructure, consolidate or eliminate processes wherever required.
* Develop future-state workflows aligned with business requirements and operational efficiency.
* Ensure that changes in one business process are evaluated for their impact on other interconnected functions.

**4. Technical & Development Expertise**

* Possess strong understanding of SAP technical architecture, ABAP programming, debugging and custom code development.
* Understand APIs, database architecture, data structures, integrations and middleware.
* Assess the feasibility of replicating or redesigning existing SAP functionalities in the new ERP environment.
* Work with technical teams to develop customised solutions, interfaces and automation wherever required.

**5. Stakeholder Management & ERP Governance**

* Work closely with Finance, HR, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Sales, Projects and other business functions.
* Conduct functional assessments and gather business requirements from stakeholders.
* Establish centralised control over ERP-related projects, changes and process improvements.
* Develop system documentation, process maps, impact assessments and migration governance mechanisms.
* Coordinate with implementation partners, consultants and internal IT teams.

  

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 10–12+ years of relevant experience in SAP consulting, ERP architecture, ERP transformation or large-scale ERP migration.
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, IT or a related engineering discipline preferred.
* Strong techno-functional expertise across multiple SAP modules.
* Hands-on experience with ABAP programming, debugging, system configuration and integration.
* Demonstrated experience in ERP migration, preferably from SAP to Oracle, ERPNext or other enterprise ERP platforms.
* Strong understanding of cross-functional business processes and system interdependencies.
* Experience in process mapping, process redesign and business process re-engineering.
* Ability to independently assess existing systems and recommend appropriate technology and process solutions.
* Strong project management, analytical and stakeholder management capabilities.

  

**Key Expectations from the Role**

The successful candidate should be able to:

1. Understand the existing SAP ecosystem end-to-end without depending entirely on external consultants.
2. Map all existing modules, processes, customisations and system interdependencies.
3. Identify what needs to be retained, modified, consolidated or discontinued.
4. Assess the impact of any proposed change across the entire ERP ecosystem.
5. Recommend the most suitable alternative ERP platform and migration approach.
6. Develop and execute a structured migration roadmap with minimal business disruption.
7. Establish a centralised ERP architecture and governance framework for the organisation.

  

**The ultimate objective is to move from a fragmented and heavily dependent SAP environment towards a streamlined, integrated and scalable ERP ecosystem.**

jobs.title: BI Lab Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

Ecolab seeks a business-centric analytics professional who excels at turning ambiguous questions into actionable insights and has deep expertise in evolving those insights into scalable, production-ready solutions.

This role is the leader of a small team that sits at the intersection of business strategy, data, and product thinking. The primary strength of this role is the ability to quickly understand business context, translate it into meaningful metrics and analyses, and deliver relevant outputs that move decision-making forward.

In addition to leading the team, this individual will work iteratively with a variety of stakeholders across the enterprise. The day-to-day may include rapidly prototyping analyses, tools, or visualizations, refining them with stakeholders, and ultimately identifying which solutions should be scaled. As solutions mature, they will partner with BI developers and data engineers to operationalize them.

The person in this role will either facilitate the start of scaled solutions or they may contribute to hands-on delivery of scaled solution.

Success in this role is defined not by technical complexity, but by the ability to deliver relevant, impactful, data solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Translate business needs into data-driven solutions**
  + Engage stakeholders to understand goals, context, and constraints
  + Identify the most relevant questions, metrics, and drivers of value
* **Rapidly prototype insights and analytical tools**
  + Move quickly from problem definition to gathering data to delivering an insight.
  + Deliver early versions of analyses, dashboards, models, or lightweight tools either via PowerPoint, PowerBI, Streamlit, or custom AI tools.
  + Iterate based on feedback to refine usefulness and clarity

* **Apply the appropriate analytical approach**
  + Determine when to use visualization, statistical analysis, modeling, or simple heuristics to a business problem.
  + Balance speed, rigor, and usability based on the situation (including the maturity of the question and the needs of the business).
* **Perform data transformation and analysis**
  + Use SQL or Python to source, clean, and transform data into useable data for analysis. If engaged in scaling data transformation, leverage dbt to create a scaled and tested data model for consumption.
* **Design meaningful metrics and outputs**
  + Define metrics that align with real business outcomes. Work with stakeholders to understand gaps in metric definitions or propose functional alternatives.
  + Ensure outputs are interpretable, actionable, and relevant to business needs.
* **Evolve prototypes into scalable solutions**
  + Translate prototypes into clear requirements for BI developers and data engineers
  + Partner cross-functionally to scale solutions into production
  + Sometimes contribute to scaled products.
* **Operate flexibly between guidance and execution**
  + Provide direction and oversight when resources allow
  + Contribute hands-on development when needed in resource-constrained environments
* **Drive insight-led decision-making**
  + Use outputs to guide and advance stakeholder conversations
  + Continuously refine questions and approaches through iteration
* **Team Leadership**
  + Coach direct reports and dotted line analysts on ways to improve solution development.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data science
* 3-5 Years of Direct People Management Experience
* Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and transformation
* Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, or prototyping
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar)
* Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into analytical approaches and solutions
* Experience working directly with stakeholders and iterating on analytical outputs
* Strong problem-framing and prioritization skills, with a focus on business impact

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with dbt for data transformation and modeling
* Experience building lightweight applications or prototypes using tools such as Streamlit.
* Familiarity with semantic models in Snowflake
* Experience with AI-enabled analytics tools such as Snowflake Cortex Agent or Databricks Genie.
* Experience implementing or supporting data quality testing frameworks.
* Exposure to product-oriented thinking in analytics (e.g., scaling dashboards, tools, or data products)
* Ability to translate exploratory work into structured requirements for engineering teams
* Experience with GitHub or other CI/CD pipeline tools.
* Experience using Claude Code or similar GenAI development tools.

Experience in dealing with Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) Notices and relevant Acts is desirable.

**Position: Data Transformation Analyst**

**Shift Timings : 12 PM to 9 PM (cab facility will be provided)**

**Job Type : Permanent**

  
  

**Job Summary**

The Data Analytics professional is responsible for analyzing procurement and spend data to provide actionable insights that support strategic sourcing, cost optimization, supplier management, and business decision-making. The role focuses on transforming complex data into meaningful dashboards, reports, KPIs, and recommendations for procurement and business stakeholders.

  

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Analyze procurement, spend and savings data across **suppliers, categories, business units, regions,** and **time periods** to identify trends, opportunities, and potential areas for cost optimization.
* Develop, maintain and enhance **Spend and Savings Analytics dashboards and reports** using tools such as **Power BI, Excel, SQL, and data visualization platforms**.
* Consolidate, cleanse, validate, and classify spend data from multiple systems and data sources to improve reporting accuracy and consistency.
* Perform **spend classification and category analysis** to provide greater visibility into organizational spending patterns.
* Support for the modernization of the reporting landscape, including migration of Power BI products to Databricks Unity Catalog.
* Track and report key procurement metrics and **KPIs**, including spend by category, supplier concentration, sourcing coverage, savings performance, and procurement compliance.
* Partner with **Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Category Management, Finance, and other business stakeholders** to understand analytical and reporting requirements.
* Identify opportunities for **supplier consolidation, sourcing initiatives, and cost reduction** using data-driven analysis.
* Conduct supplier-level analysis to highlight spend concentration, supplier fragmentation, and opportunities for improved supplier management.
* Create executive-level dashboards and presentations translating analytical findings into **clear business insights and recommendations**.
* Establish data validation and quality-control processes to ensure the reliability and consistency of procurement reporting.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual procurement reporting cycles and ensure timely delivery of dashboards and metrics.
* Automate recurring reports and analytical processes where possible to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Work with data and technology teams to resolve **data-quality, integration, mapping, and reporting issues**.
* Maintain reporting documentation, business definitions, KPI logic, and standardized reporting methodologies.
* Support ad-hoc analysis requested by procurement leadership and other stakeholders.

  

**Technical Skills**

jobs.title: Head of Transformation, Field Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description   
   **About the Team**  

The Strategy and Transformation team for the Field Operations organization at Uber sets the vision and strategy for Field Ops, runs agent operations, undertakes our most complex and transformative projects, and drives the optimization of our global operations. We execute this future-state vision across five core pillars: Special Projects, Strategy and Programs, Business Planning and Improvement, Transformation, and Analytics. Within Transformation, we act as the catalyst for large-scale structural change, redefining our operating models, optimizing our global footprint, and fostering a high-performance culture that empowers our globally distributed workforce to thrive.

  **About the Role**  

As the Head of Transformation, you will lead the Transformation Office for the entire Field Ops organization. You will be the central force driving our most critical organizational shifts, taking ownership of key workstreams spanning our footprint, operating model, people, technology, and culture.

In this highly visible leadership role, you will set the overarching agenda and narrative for the transformation, ensuring alignment across the business. You will build the robust tracking and reporting infrastructure necessary to measure success and define the target culture that underpins our future state. Operating in a highly matrixed environment, you will manage complex, interdependent initiatives involving multiple internal and external stakeholders. You are a seasoned leader with exceptional executive presence, capable of influencing senior management and driving large-scale change across a highly distributed global network.

This is not a traditional PMO or program management role. We are looking for a leader who can combine strategic thinking with operational executionsomeone who can define the future state, influence executive stakeholders, and personally lead complex transformation initiatives from concept through implementation.

  **What You''ll Do**  

* **Transformation Office Leadership:**   Direct the central Transformation Office, overseeing end-to-end strategy and execution for core workstreams including footprint, operating model, people, tech, and culture.
* **Agenda Narrative Setting:**   Define the strategic agenda and author the overarching narrative for the transformation, ensuring clear alignment and purpose across the organization.
* **Culture Definition:**   Set the target culture and cultural narrative, ensuring structural changes are supported by the right behaviors and mindsets.
* **Infrastructure Tracking:**   Build and manage a rigorous tracking, reporting, and governance infrastructure to monitor the health and progress of all transformational initiatives.
* **Stakeholder Executive Influence:**   Manage complex, highly interdependent cross-functional initiatives, leveraging strong reporting and influencing abilities to align senior management and diverse stakeholders.
* **Drive AI Technology Transformation:** Partner across Product, Engineering, and Operations to identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and technology to reduce manual work, improve operational efficiency, and enable scalable growth.

  **Basic Qualifications and Experience**  

* Bachelor''s or Postgraduate degree.
* 10 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 5+ years specifically dedicated to leading large-scale change and transformation programs in a large, distributed organization.
* **Must Have:**   Prior experience in management consulting combined with a background in direct operating roles.

  **Preferred Experience**  

* Led enterprise-wide operating model transformations within complex global organizations.
* Experience driving productivity, cost optimization, or organizational effectiveness programs.
* Built governance models for multi-workstream transformation portfolios.
* Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience partnering directly with C-level executives or executive steering committees.
* Experience leading change management and organizational capability-building initiatives.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. **Job Title: Medical Writer – CDMA**

**Department:** Medical Affairs / Scientific Communications  
**Education:** MBBS / BDS / PhD / Master’s in Pharmacy or a related field  
**Scope:** Global

**Role Objective / Purpose**

* To develop high-quality scientific content and documentation across therapeutic areas by conducting in-depth literature reviews, synthesizing data, and delivering clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate materials.
* The role involves contributing to both short- and long-term projects in the consumer healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors, including medical, safety, pre-clinical, clinical, regulatory, educational, and promotional content.
* Additional responsibilities include editing, proofreading, reviewing, referencing, and verifying content to ensure adherence to high medical writing standards.
* The role ensures timely delivery of project milestones while maintaining quality, compliance, and business value.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Literature Reviews and Evidence Mapping**

* Conduct comprehensive secondary research/literature reviews and prepare overarching summaries using effective search strategies across scientific databases (e.g., PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library) and open-source platforms.
* Analyze and interpret clinical and scientific data to extract actionable insights.
* Stay current with trends, treatment guidelines, and regulatory updates in both OTC and Rx domains.

**Medical and Scientific Content Development**

* Leverage scientific expertise to create high-quality communication materials in the OTC and Rx space.
* Research, write, edit, organize, interpret, curate, and quality-check various types of scientific content across multiple formats and channels.

  + Literature reviews
  + Manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals
  + Abstracts, posters, and slide decks for scientific conferences
  + Treatment guideline summaries
  + Publication summaries and white papers
* Ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and compliance with applicable guidelines (e.g., ICMJE, CONSORT).

**Content Review and Quality Assurance**

* Review medical, promotional, and scientific materials in accordance with internal SOPs and external guidelines.
* Verify references and ensure content is plagiarism-free.
* Ensure clear, factual, and effective presentation of data and discussions.
* Maintain and apply templates, formats, and styles to ensure compliance with industry and client standards.

**Project Execution**

* Understand and define client requirements during project initiation, including objectives and timelines.
* Develop scientifically accurate and medically relevant content across therapeutic areas, adhering to branding and regulatory guidelines.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring quality and client satisfaction.
* Respond to and deliver ad-hoc client requests within agreed timelines.
* Collaborate with medical writing colleagues, the graphics team, and clients as needed.

**Other Responsibilities**

* **Mentorship:** Actively mentor team members to support effective task execution and goal achievement.
* **Values and Behaviors:** Consistently demonstrate WNS values and foster positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* **Personal Development:** Identify learning and development needs in collaboration with the line manager and pursue relevant training opportunities.

**Key Performance Indicators**

**Process-Related**

* **Domain Expertise:** Quickly build subject matter expertise in assigned therapeutic areas.
* **Efficiency:** Develop effective search strategies, organize data for analysis, and prepare medical and scientific content.
* **Accuracy:** Validate sources, identify data gaps, and ensure scientific rigor.
* **Quality:** Deliver well-structured, grammatically sound, and visually engaging documents using appropriate templates and tone.

**People-Related**

* Demonstrate strong teamwork, collaboration, and professionalism.
* Actively participate in team meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and training initiatives.

**Required Competencies & Skills**

**Must Have**

* Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical, OTC, and consumer healthcare landscape.
* Clear grasp of medical, scientific, and statistical terminology and concepts.
* Robust knowledge of various types of clinical studies, the structure, and formats of different manuscript types (e.g., SLR, TLR, Meta-analysis), along with their relevance and application in evidence synthesis and utilization.
* Proven experience in scientific writing and literature analysis.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and online research tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail, critical thinking abilities, and the capacity to work independently.
* Demonstrated accountability, adaptability, and effective time management.

**Good to Have**

* Familiarity with regulatory documentation and compliance in US/EU markets.
* Exposure to text mining, data visualization tools, and scientific storytelling.
* Experience with reference management (e.g., EndNote, Zotero, Mendeley) and statistical (e.g., RevMan, SPSS, GraphPad Prism, R, SAS) tools.
* Knowledge of proprietary tools such as DataVision, PubPro, and Veeva Vault.

  
**Qualifications**

• BDS/ MDS/PhD with 6-8 years’ experience• Understanding of any specialty area of medicine (preferred Oral health) or an overall understanding of the medical field.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The **Data\Information Management Int Analyst** will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi. AIM's objective is to generate actionable intelligence for business leaders. In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. This includes monitoring sprint cycles to track milestone adherence, maintaining capacity planning models to ensure balanced workload distribution, and assisting with skills-matrix assessments to align team capabilities with testing demand across all phases of regulatory validation.

  
  

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Assist in organizing and maintaining dedicated testing data marts and data pipelines.
* Expertise in data management principles, SQL, SAS programming for data extraction, manipulation and validations. Guide and mentor junior members in team in this area.
* Use of data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and experience working with Business Intelligence platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). To act as SME in this area and go-to person for the team.
* Research and identify data inconsistencies, trends, or reporting gaps to support root-cause analysis.
* Automate current process to remove manual effort
* Develop workflows and automation logic using SAS, SQL, Workflow tools
* Conduct in-depth analyses of current operational processes to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement.
* Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities
* Work closely with internal and external business partners in building, implementing, tracking and improving decision strategies
  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 5+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Technical Skills: Expertise in data management principles, SQL, SAS , Python programming for data extraction and manipulation, and database management systems. Including Tableau, and other BI tools.

* Strong coding expertise in SAS & SQL, Autosys package.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.

* Soft Skills: Ability to multi-task effectively and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  

  

*Note: This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.*

Senior UiPath RPA Developer / Technical Lead
  
Experience Minimum 5+ years of hands-on RPA experience with strong UiPath expertise
  
Role Level Senior Developer / Technical Lead
  
Primary Focus UiPath delivery, SAP automation, intelligent document processing and production support
  
Employment Type Full-time

* Own end-to-end design, development, deployment, support and continuous improvement of enterprise UiPath automations.

* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills using UiPath logs, Orchestrator logs and application-level diagnostics.

* Strong hands-on experience automating SAP GUI processes using UiPath UI Automation and SAP scripting.

* Hands-on experience with UiPath Document Understanding for document classification, extraction, validation and post-processing.
* Working knowledge of ML Extractor, Generative Extractor, keyword-based classification, taxonomy design and document validation workflows.

* Analyze business requirements and convert them into scalable, maintainable and supportable UiPath solutions.
* Design and develop reusable workflows, libraries and components while following enterprise coding, naming, logging and security standards.
* Perform impact analysis and implement enhancements without introducing regression issues in existing production automations.
* Own unit testing, peer review, SIT/UAT support, deployment, hypercare and post-production issue resolution.
* Monitor production automations, perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent corrective actions for recurring failures.

* Mentor junior developers, review code/designs and promote reusable engineering practices across the team.

6. Programming, Integration Engineering Skills
  

* Strong VB.NET fundamentals; ability to build reliable custom logic in UiPath.

* Working knowledge of SQL/database operations; VBA, VBScript or PowerShell experience is advantageous.
* Experience with source control and release practices using Git/Azure DevOps/Jenkins or similar CI/CD tooling is preferred.

7. Delivery Stakeholder Expectations
  

* Operate independently with strong ownership of complex automations and production-critical issues.
* Communicate status, risks, dependencies and technical decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Strong in both new development and enhancement/support of complex production workflows.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**

The primary purpose of an SAP HR / SAP Human Capital Management for SAP S/4HANA (H4S4) Consultant is to design, implement, and maintain a modernized, on-premise or private cloud core HR and payroll transition solution that bridges legacy SAP ERP HCM systems to the next-generation SAP S/4HANA architecture. They act as the bridge between business HR, payroll, and compliance requirements and technical execution within the SAP H4S4 and SuccessFactors ecosystem.

  

Employees in this role define and use design documentation, functional programming specifications, and high-level design documents to implement identified components. Ensure implemented components are documented appropriately, unit tested, and ready for integration into the final product. Present/demonstrate implemented product features through playback sessions and system walkthroughs as required. Provide fixes to defects identified during pre-production and post-production phases in the software development life cycle. Provide work estimates for assigned development work. Guide and explain features, functional objectives, or technologies that are being built to interested parties.

  

Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization—experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely. In this role, you’ll design, build, and optimize enterprise core HR and payroll foundations while modernizing legacy HCM systems to seamlessly transition into next-generation S/4HANA and cloud architectures.

  

**What you will do**

* **Lead Solution Design & Workshops:** Drive requirements-gathering workshops, conduct fit-gap analyses against standard SAP H4S4 and SuccessFactors functionalities, author configuration workbooks, and document business processes and approval workflows.
* **Configure Core HR & Master Data:** Configure and maintain Personnel Administration (PA) and Organizational Management (OM) structures, employee infotypes, hiring/termination actions, and global/local assignments.
* **Manage Time & Payroll Processing:** Design and troubleshoot work schedules, shift planning, absence/attendance recording, and time evaluation rules, while overseeing country- or region-specific payroll runs, wage types, off-cycle workbenches, Payroll Control Centers, and statutory tax/benefit compliance.
* **Enable S/4HANA, Fiori & Talent Modules:** Implement role-based SAP Fiori apps, Employee/Manager Self-Service (ESS/MSS) portals, and SuccessFactors prototypes, while supporting qualification matching, compensation management, learning solutions, and succession planning within H4S4.

* **Build HR Reporting & Analytics:** Develop custom and standard SAP queries, HR Information Systems (HIS), and analytical Fiori dashboards leveraging HANA views.
* **Drive Testing, Cutover & Hypercare:** Author functional specifications, build test scripts, execute unit, SIT, and UAT cycles, manage defect resolution, coordinate cutover planning, and provide post-go-live hypercare and application maintenance support.
* **Deliver Documentation & Knowledge Transfer:** Draft configuration guides and process flows, train key business end-users, and conduct knowledge transfer with developers, project managers, and onshore/offshore teams.

Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required skills and experience**

* Minimum 10+ years of hands-on functional experience in SAP HR/HCM, SAP ERP, or SAP SuccessFactors, including full-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or migrations.
* At least 3–5 years of experience operating specifically in a senior consultant, technical lead, solution designer, or architectural leadership role.
* Deep functional mastery of Core HR (Personnel Administration and Organizational Management), Personnel Time Management, and regional Payroll processing (wage types, Payroll Control Center, and statutory compliance).

* Strong proficiency in SAP Fiori role-based HR applications, ESS/MSS portals, HR Information Systems (HIS), and HANA-based analytical reporting.
Proven track record authoring functional specifications, managing ETL/data migrations (LSMW, BDC, MDG), and leading SIT, UAT, cutover, and hypercare phases across the full project lifecycle.  

  

**Preferred skills and experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* **Hybrid Cloud & Talent Integration:** Practical experience prototyping, configuring, and integrating SAP SuccessFactors modules with on-premise/private cloud H4S4 environments.
* **Professional Certifications:** Relevant SAP certifications in SAP HCM, SAP S/4HANA (H4S4), or SAP SuccessFactors.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity and completeness of financial and operational records across accounts, products and transaction platforms. The role provides critical control over the end-to-end reconciliation lifecycle by identifying, investigating and resolving breaks, exceptions and discrepancies in a timely manner, thereby reducing financial, operational and regulatory risk.

The role supports the effective operation of reconciliation processes covering Nostro accounts, General Ledger and suspense accounts, trade and position records, card and retail banking transactions, and other operational control accounts. Working across multiple business functions, the role ensures that reconciliation outcomes are achieved within agreed service levels while maintaining adherence to reconciliation policies, control standards and governance requirements.

The role also contributes to process optimisation and change initiatives by supporting system enhancements, reconciliation platform implementations, business analysis activities and automation opportunities that strengthen operational efficiency, scalability and control effectiveness.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Reconciliation Control & Exception Management**  
• Perform reconciliations across cash, Nostro, General Ledger, suspense, trade, position and retail transaction accounts to ensure books and records are complete and accurate.
  
• Investigate, analyse and resolve reconciliation breaks, exceptions and unmatched items within agreed timelines to minimise operational and financial risk.
  
• Escalate aged, material or high-risk exceptions through appropriate governance channels to enable timely resolution and management oversight.
  
• Maintain accurate reconciliation evidence, audit trails and supporting documentation to support operational control and regulatory requirements.
  
**Financial Control & Risk Management**  
• Apply reconciliation policies, operational procedures and control frameworks to ensure compliance with internal and external requirements.
  
• Identify emerging risks, recurring exceptions and control weaknesses, recommending actions that improve reconciliation effectiveness and reduce operational losses.
  
• Monitor reconciliation ageing, exception volumes and service levels, ensuring timely reporting of key control indicators and risk exposures.
  
• Support business continuity, operational resilience and risk mitigation activities, including testing and execution of contingency plans.
