**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

An SAP Integration Developer (BTP Integration Suite / CPI / PI/PO) acts as the central connective tissue of an enterprise’s IT ecosystem. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining seamless end-to-end data flows and process integrations between SAP systems (S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, C/4HANA, Ariba) and non-SAP cloud or on-premise applications.

With your vast knowledge of SAP and industry, you assist top-tier clients in their SAP digital transformation efforts. Your role entails providing guidance and executing SAP digital transformation initiatives. You also conceptualize, create, improve and optimize solutions using SAP development tools and platforms. Additionally, you work alongside global teams and partners across various functions to deliver solutions. You define and update solution and technology roadmaps, and architecture documents.

  

In this role, you will design, build, and optimize high-throughput interfaces running on SAP Process Orchestration (PI/PO) and SAP BTP Integration Suite. Concurrently, you will lead the refactoring and modernization of legacy interfaces to modern APIs, event-driven pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns, enabling seamless data flow between core SAP S/4HANA systems and broader cloud or third-party enterprise platforms.

  

Lead enterprise integration assessments, interface architecture, and migration of legacy middleware to modern cloud integration platforms. Translate complex business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective integration solutions. Own interface development from design through implementation and transition to operations, balancing long-term integration strategy with day-to-day stability, maintainability, and business continuity.

  

Professionals in this role author and leverage detailed technical design documentation, mapping specifications, and interface runbooks to build robust data flows across hybrid landscapes. Ensure all integration components are thoroughly documented, rigorously unit-tested, and validated for seamless end-to-end processing across connected systems. Lead interface walkthroughs and playback demonstrations with functional teams and client stakeholders. Triage, isolate, and remediate integration defects during pre-production testing cycles, cutovers, and hypercare support. Provide precise development effort estimates and guide project teams on integration patterns, BTP capabilities, and technical trade-offs.

  

Bring your deep integration engineering background to an organization modernizing enterprise application ecosystems, playing a central role in connecting critical business processes. You will collaborate alongside a global community of SAP and cloud specialists driving the future of hybrid connectivity—professionals who value knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and open collaboration.

  

**What you will do**

* **Integration & Modernization Strategy:** Lead discovery and assessment of legacy PI/PO landscapes, evaluate interface technical debt, and build migration roadmaps to transition workloads toward SAP BTP Integration Suite.
* **Architecture & Interface Governance:** Establish enterprise integration guidelines, select optimal communication patterns (hub-and-spoke, API-led, event-driven), enforce error-handling standards, and ensure interface compliance with corporate security mandates.
* **Cloud & Hybrid Integration:** Architect, develop, and tune end-to-end integration flows across SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration/CPI, API Management, Integration Advisor, Open Connectors, Event Mesh).
* **Core SAP & Third-Party Connectivity:** Build and support mission-critical interfaces linking SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, and C/4HANA with third-party SaaS and on-premise systems (e.g., Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow).
* **Protocol, Mapping & Security Management:** Implement data transformations using Groovy Script, XSLT, and Graphical Mapping; configure enterprise security standards including OAuth 2.0, SAML, Principal Propagation, SSL/TLS, and Keystore management.
* **Technical Leadership & Delivery:** Lead client design workshops, conduct code and mapping reviews, manage cutover/go-live risks, mentor junior developers, and coordinate interface testing between functional consultants and external partner counterparts.

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a structured pathway to expand your career, from Integration Consultant to Principal Integration Architect. We provide unique opportunities to engage with hybrid architectures and hyperscaler-connected ecosystems, paired with dedicated learning resources and support to achieve professional certifications across modern SAP and cloud platforms.

You will partner with top-tier clients across a wide range of industries—from banking and retail to manufacturing and healthcare. Whether your ambition is to deepen your focus on enterprise iPaaS architectures or broaden your leadership across complex multi-cloud digital transformations, you can build that trajectory here. You will contribute to critical business initiatives, influence technology roadmaps, and cultivate relationships with diverse technical communities while mastering modern integration practices.

**Who You Are**

You bring seasoned hands-on technical proficiency in SAP integration and possess the delivery track record to back it up. Equally critical: you possess a continuous learning mindset, an analytical approach to solving complex interface issues, and a customer-first focus dedicated to operational resilience. You thrive in open, globally distributed teams and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **8–10+ years** of hands-on experience in SAP integration engineering, middleware architecture, and interface delivery.
* **4+ years** of dedicated design and development experience on **SAP BTP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI)** .
* Proven track record in full-lifecycle **SAP PI (7.3/7.4) and PO (7.5)** implementations, dual-stack/single-stack administration awareness, and interface remediation.
* Solid experience delivering integration architecture for **SAP S/4HANA implementation and roll-in projects** , including legacy-to-cloud migrations.
* Deep proficiency in advanced mapping techniques: **Groovy Scripting, XSLT, Graphical Mapping, Value Mapping, and Custom Functions** .
* Comprehensive expertise across standard integration protocols and data structures: **OData (V2/V4), REST, SOAP/WSDL, IDoc, RFC, EDI/EDIFACT, AS2, SFTP, AMQP, JSON, and XML** .
* Strong grasp of BTP platform connectivity, including **SAP Cloud Connector** , Destination Services, Cloud Integration Automation Framework, and multi-tenant subaccount structures.
* Solid background in integration security: certificate and key lifecycle management, **OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, mutual TLS, and Principal Propagation** .

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience establishing automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, automated interface

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The Opportunity**

This document covers two role profiles for Finacle Core Banking transformation programs: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager and Business Analyst – Senior.

**Role Profile 1: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager**

  

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a techno-functional leader with prior experience in Infosys Finacle Core Banking and strong expertise in banking business analysis, requirements management, solution mapping, process design, API and interface analysis, data mapping, integration coordination, and banking data models. The role supports Finacle implementation, transformation, migration, upgrade, and modernization programs.

**Role -** Techno-Functional Consultant – Finacle Core Banking

**Level -** Manager

**Experience -** 8+ years in banking; 5+ years in business analysis or techno-functional consulting

**Domain -** Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work as a Lead or Senior Business Analyst and techno-functional consultant in banking transformation programs.
* Lead requirements workshops, process discovery sessions, and solution discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, solution requirements, and system design inputs.
* Drive requirements analysis, gap assessment, configuration advisory, and solution mapping across Finacle and surrounding banking applications.
* Prepare and review BRDs, FRDs, user stories, use cases, process flows, data mappings, and interface specifications.
* Coordinate across Business, Technology, Development, Testing, Infrastructure, Data Migration and Vendor teams.
* Provide functional and technical clarifications to integration, migration and testing teams.
* Maintain traceability across requirements, specifications, test scenarios and delivered solutions.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go-Live and Hypercare activities.
* Lead functional workstreams, support delivery governance, manage risks and engage senior stakeholders as required.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking architecture, ecosystem, system configuration and banking data models.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, integration patterns, service-oriented architecture, data mapping, migration, reconciliation, data quality and interface analysis.
* Understanding of Digital Banking, Mobile Banking, Open Banking, API-led architectures, microservices, cloud, DevOps and RPA concepts.
* Experience designing Java-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front-end interfaces, menus and client-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong banking knowledge across deposits, loans, cash management, collections, payments, forex, trade finance, liquidity, KYC, cards, treasury and wealth management.
* Knowledge of payment and settlement systems including SWIFT, TARGET2, EBA and ISO 20022.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* MBA, MCA, BE, BTech or equivalent qualification with banking industry experience.

* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
The Senior Enterprise Architect will drive Zand Bank’s strategic evolution by defining, maintaining, and evolving the enterprise architecture to deliver key business outcomes, accelerate technology innovation, and enable seamless integration across platforms and processes. This role will also be pivotal in shaping and advancing the organization’s enterprise-scale AI strategy, by integrating AI capabilities into the architectural vision and technology roadmap. As the pivotal orchestrator between business strategy and technical execution, the Enterprise Architect fosters collaboration, governance, and continuous improvement to advance Zand’s growth and digital transformation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Shape Architectural and AI Vision:**
  Develop, maintain, and communicate the architectural and AI vision, principles, standards, and reference models supporting a digital-first, AI-enabled organization.
* **Deliver Blueprints:**
  Create architectural blueprints and target state architectures across data, application, technology, and security domains.
* **Governance & Compliance:**
  Lead architectural governance, evaluating and guiding major technology initiatives for strategic alignment and compliance.
* **Technology Scouting:**
  Assess emerging technologies, , including AI/ML advances, trends, and regulatory changes; recommend adoption and integration where valuable.
* **Business & IT Bridge:**
  Serve as the strategic interface between IT and business, translating strategy and requirements into effective architectures that optimize value and manage risk.
* **AI Roadmap Leadership:**
  Develop and continuously evolve an AI roadmap in alignment with business goals—identify opportunities for AI-driven solutions, prioritize AI initiatives, and ensure robust data, ethics, and governance practices are in place for responsible AI adoption and scaling.
* **Champion AI Adoption**
  : Guide the integration of AI technologies into business processes and digital platforms, enabling automation, predictive analytics, and improved customer experiences.
* **Project Oversight:**
  Provide architectural oversight to priority programs, including AI related initatives, ensuring designs comply with enterprise standards and security requirements.
* **Collaborative Delivery:**
  Partner with solution architects, engineers, and stakeholders to deliver end-to-end architecture.
* **Technology Transformation:**
  Lead the target-state architecture for digital banking, cloud migration, advanced analytics, and enterprise AI/ML platforms and modern delivery models.
* **Legacy Modernization:**
  Champion modernization and migration initiatives, minimizing disruption and maximizing value.
* **Risk & Security:**
  Ensure architecture meets all regulatory, security, and privacy standards; proactively assess and remediate architectural risks, including those emerging from AI implementations.

**Key Skills, Qualifications & Experience**

*Qualifications & Certification*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP Architect, CISSP, AI/ML or Data Science certifications (preferred)or equivalent certifications.
* Familiarity with relevant frameworks (ITIL, COBIT, etc.).

*Experience*

* 10+ years in enterprise or solution architecture, preferably in banking, financial services, or digital organizations.
* Track record of leading architecture for major digital transformations, cloud initiatives, AI/ML use cases, and technology modernization.

*Technical & Professional Skills*

* Deep knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman, SABSA), with experience in capability modeling, solution roadmaps, and reference architectures.
* Proficiency across multiple domains: applications, data, infrastructure, security.
* Experience designing/architecting AI-powered solutions (e.g., machine learning workflows, generative models, NLP, automation), and familiarity with enterprise AI/ML platforms and tools.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices, API management, event-driven architectures, DevOps, and Agile delivery.
* Understanding of core banking systems, digital ecosystems, and the financial regulatory environment.
* Proven ability to align enterprise stakeholders, influence business-technology roadmaps, and drive change in complex environments.

jobs.description:
Fimple is a product company building a cloud-native, highly composable and extendible platform. It covers the full platform needs of digital, disruptive and new financial players who need to move fast. Our solution is modern, API-native and built around an ecosystem with strong marketplace support, so financial institutions can grow in a fast-changing market.
  
  
We are looking for an Implementation Engineer to join our Fimple Delivery team in Dubai, UAE. Your main goal will be to set up the Fimple banking platform for the bank and configure it in line with the bank’s needs, first during the implementation and then as the bank’s needs grow after go-live. You will be Fimple’s face to the bank’s business teams: working closely with them to understand their business needs, set up the platform to match their banking products and processes, and help them go live successfully.
  
  
You don’t need to know everything on day one. Working closely with and be supported by Fimple’s core banking experts, and learning our platform and Islamic banking products on the job.
  
  
We are not looking for a traditional core banking implementer. We are looking for agile, open-minded people who are curious to learn and improve, don’t just repeat old methods, and always look for a better, faster way to get things done. You should use AI tools in your daily work and turn complex banking needs into simple, practical solutions.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* Open to innovation: you enjoy new technologies and new ways of working, and you don’t cling to old methods
* AI-savvy: you already use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to analyze requirements, write documents, prepare test scenarios, investigate issues and speed up your work
* Solution-oriented: you focus on solving the problem, not on listing obstacles
* Flexible and practical: you adapt quickly when priorities change and look for the simplest solution that works, not the most complicated one
* Ownership mindset: you take responsibility and carry things through to the end
* Fast learner: you pick up new products, domains and tools quickly

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set up the Fimple banking platform for the bank and configure it in line with the bank’s needs, both during the implementation and after go-live
* Act as the day-to-day contact for the bank’s business teams and Fimple’s face to the bank
* Take part in end-to-end core banking implementation projects, from requirement gathering to go-live and post-go-live support
* Run workshops with clients to understand their banking products, business processes and regulatory needs
* Perform gap analysis between client requirements and Fimple platform capabilities, and suggest practical solutions
* Configure and set up banking products and parameters on the platform, such as Islamic financing and deposit products, customer onboarding, limits, fees and charges, and accounting rules
* Use AI-powered tools and automation to speed up analysis, documentation, testing and issue resolution
* Write clear, concise functional documents, including business requirements, functional specifications, configuration workbooks and process flows
* Prepare test scenarios and support SIT and UAT phases with clients
* Work with Fimple’s product, development and QA teams to deliver solutions and handle change requests
* Train client users and create user guides
* Analyze and troubleshoot functional issues during implementation and after go-live
* Suggest improvements to our delivery processes and help build a faster, smarter way of implementing core banking

**Qualifications**

* Fluent English– must
* Arabic – strong plus
* Turkish – plus
* Must be currently living in Dubai, UAE or willing to relocate
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, Banking, or a related discipline
* 3+ years of experience in banking, in banking operations, core banking, loan, trade finance or treasury implementation functional consulting or business analysis
* Solid knowledge of banking business processes, such as retail and/or corporate banking, deposits, lending, payments, general ledger, accounting, customer lifecycle, Trade Finance and Treasury.
* Understanding of how banking systems work, including products, parameters, end-of-day processes and integrations
* Core banking business knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more core banking systems is a must
* Previous Experience in implementing core banking solutions in GCC is a must
* Experience with Islamic banking products is must
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work
* Examples of how you used AI or automation to improve a process or save time
* Basic technical skills: reading APIs (REST/JSON), writing SQL queries, understanding system integrations
* Experience with Agile delivery and tools like Jira or Azure DevOps
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to turn business needs into clear functional requirements
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with a client-focused approach
* No travel restrictions; willing to travel when needed

**Why Join Us**

* Work on modern, cloud-native Islamic core banking implementations in UAE
* Be part of a team that uses AI in daily delivery work
* Freedom to bring new ideas and shape how core banking is implemented
* Be part of Fimple’s international team with growth opportunities across the region
* Hybrid working model
* A growth mindset culture where challenges are learning opportunities

**Summary**

The Manager, Enterprise Transformation will be responsible for leading business transformation, process re-engineering, and operational excellence initiatives across Finance House Group. The role will focus on identifying process inefficiencies, redesigning and optimizing workflows, reducing turnaround times (TAT), eliminating operational bottlenecks, and implementing sustainable improvements that enhance productivity, cost efficiency, customer experience, and overall business performance.

Working closely with Business Heads, Product Managers, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and other stakeholders, the Transformation Manager will drive end-to-end process improvement and digital transformation initiatives. The role will leverage business process re-engineering (BPR), process mining, automation, and data analytics to deliver measurable improvements while ensuring alignment with the Group's strategic objectives, operational priorities, and regulatory requirements.

**Major Responsibilities**

**Business Transformation & Process Re-engineering**

* Lead end-to-end business transformation and process re-engineering initiatives across business units and support functions.
* Assess existing business processes to identify inefficiencies, redundancies, bottlenecks, control gaps, and improvement opportunities.

Our Architecture team is looking for a skilled and experienced Digital Asset Technical Architect to design, implement, and manage a greenfield digital asset ecosystem, focusing on custody management, stablecoin issuance, and seamless integration with our banks mobile banking platform. * Develop operational playbooks, monitoring frameworks, dashboards, and automation capabilities.
* Evaluate and manage technology vendors, blockchain providers, custodians, and strategic partners.

Enterprise Architecture & Strategic Leadership.

* Drive stakeholder engagement, change management, and cross-functional collaboration across business, technology, risk, compliance, and security teams.

* Bachelors or masters degree in computer science, IT, Engineering or related field.
* 8+ years of architecture or platform engineering experience in banking, fintech or digital assets.
* Experience with custody platforms, wallets, tokenisation and stablecoin ecosystems.
* Strong knowledge of blockchain, cryptography, cloud platforms and cybersecurity.
* Expertise in API management, enterprise integration and digital banking ecosystems.

jobs.title: AI Change Management Leader - Banking
jobs.description:
**An opportunity to shape enterprise-wide AI adoption within a leading financial institution.**

Edison Smart is exclusively supporting a leading banking group in the UAE with the appointment of a Senior Manager to establish the institutions AI change and adoption programmes.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing Group Digital & AI function and play a pivotal role in one of the organisation's most important strategic transformation initiatives.

The organisation is making significant investments in Enterprise AI and Generative AI capabilities and is looking for an experienced banking transformation leader to ensure these technologies are successfully adopted, embedded and utilised across the business.

This is not a traditional Change Management position. The successful individual will take ownership of the bank-wide AI Champions and Change programme, building the structures, communities and engagement strategies required to make AI adoption successful at enterprise scale.

**IMPORTANT: This is an international relocation-only opportunity based in UAE. Candidates must be currently based outside the UAE and genuinely willing to relocate.**

The Role

Reporting into the Group Digital & AI function, you will lead the strategy and execution of the organisation's enterprise AI change and adoption programme.

You will work closely with AI Product Owners, senior business stakeholders, HR, Learning & Development and Internal Communications to ensure AI capabilities translate into meaningful changes in how employees work.

Key responsibilities will include:

* **AI Champions Network:**
  Design, establish and lead a bank-wide AI Champions network, developing the operating model, selection criteria, engagement strategy and governance required to drive adoption across multiple business units.
* **Enterprise AI Adoption:**
  Own the change and adoption strategy for enterprise AI and CRM platforms, ensuring successful integration into everyday business operations.
* **Change Strategy:**
  Develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies, assessing organisational readiness, people impacts and potential barriers to adoption.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:**
  Build strong relationships with senior business leaders, securing executive sponsorship and accountability for AI adoption outcomes.
* **Employee Enablement:**
  Partner with Learning & Development to develop AI training programmes, role-based learning pathways, prompt libraries and practical enablement resources.
* **AI Engagement & Communications:**
  Lead internal engagement campaigns, champion forums and communications that build confidence and enthusiasm around AI.
* **Adoption Measurement:**
  Monitor employee engagement, adoption levels and proficiency, identifying areas requiring additional intervention and support.
* **Responsible AI:**
  Ensure AI adoption is aligned with organisational policies, data privacy requirements and responsible AI principles.
* **Product Collaboration:**
  Work closely with AI Product Owners to capture employee feedback and influence future product enhancements.

You will also lead a dedicated team within the Champions & Change function and play an important role in developing the wider enterprise AI adoption operating model.

The Candidate We Want

We are looking for an established change and transformation leader with direct experience within the banking and financial services sector.

**Direct banking experience is essential.**
We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked within leading international banks, ideally within a centralised AI Centre of Excellence (CoE), Chief Data & AI Office, Group Digital & AI function or similar enterprise transformation environment.

The strongest candidates will have been directly involved in establishing, scaling or leading AI adoption programmes within a large banking organisation.

We are particularly interested in people who have:

* Led enterprise-wide AI adoption or Generative AI transformation programmes within a bank.
* Established or scaled AI Champions networks, communities of practice or internal AI ambassador programmes.
* Driven the adoption of AI tools across large, complex and highly regulated organisations.
* Built AI literacy, employee enablement and workforce capability programmes.
* Worked closely with senior leadership, business executives and technology teams.
* Developed change management strategies covering multiple business units and employee populations.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, enterprise AI platforms and CRM technologies.
* A strong understanding of responsible AI adoption within regulated financial services environments.

Essential Requirements

* Minimum 7 years' experience in Change Management, Technology Adoption or Organisational Transformation.
* Minimum 4 years' direct experience within banking or financial services.
* A demonstrable track record of enterprise technology adoption, ideally with a strong focus on AI and Generative AI.
* Experience establishing and managing AI adoption programmes, communities or champion networks.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Communications, Psychology or a related discipline.
* Professional Change Management certification, ideally Prosci or APMG.
* Excellent senior stakeholder engagement, communication and leadership capabilities.
* Experience within a central AI CoE, Chief Data & AI Office or enterprise AI transformation function would be particularly attractive.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to take on a strategically important leadership position at a time when AI is fundamentally changing the banking industry.

You will have the opportunity to:

* Shape how AI is adopted across an entire banking organisation.
* Build and lead an enterprise-wide AI Champions network.
* Work alongside senior AI leadership and enterprise product teams.
* Influence the organisation's long-term AI transformation strategy.
* Establish yourself within one of the Middle East's most ambitious digital and AI environments.

International Relocation – UAE

This position is based in the UAE and is open exclusively to candidates relocating internationally.

For the right individual, this represents an opportunity to take a significant career step while relocating to one of the world's fastest-growing financial and technology hubs.

The UAE offers an established international banking sector, excellent global connectivity and an attractive lifestyle for internationally experienced professionals and their families.

Relocation and employment package details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

Interested?

If you have directly led AI adoption within a major banking organisation and are interested in relocating to the UAE, we would welcome a confidential conversation.

**Apply directly through Edison Smart or contact our team to discuss the opportunity.**

Edison Smart – Connecting exceptional talent with the future of technology.

jobs.title: Snr Solution Architect, UAE Enterprise
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

  
  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a solution for a bank's leadership team, then move into a hands-on working session with an insurer's engineering team to design a resilient, low-latency payments or core banking architecture. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's proposal for a regulatory reporting data platform, write a blog post about a security and compliance pattern you found in the field, or join a call with an AWS service team to push for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team  
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 8+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

DeepLight AI is a specialist AI and data consultancy with extensive experience implementing intelligent enterprise systems across multiple industries, with particular depth in financial services and banking. Our team combines deep expertise in data science, statistical modeling, AI/ML technologies, workflow automation, and systems integration with a practical understanding of complex business operations.

The Regulatory Project Manager is responsible for overseeing core banking projects from inception to deployment.

The role is responsible for the full lifecycle of the project, using hybrid methodologies, and must ensure delivery is aligned with strategic business goals of the organisation. The role works closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact transformation projects The role combines strong technical understanding with exceptional project management skills and business acumen and requires deep domain and technical awareness to successfully navigate the system's complexity.. The Regulatory banking PM role is centered on managing the implementation, transformation, or upgrade of the bank's central IT systems, which are critical to all operations.

As the Regulatory Project Manager, your responsibilities will include;

* Developing and managing comprehensive project plans, defining scope, objectives, deliverables, and milestones. This includes setting deadlines, managing the budget, and ensuring effective resource allocation.

* Executive Sponsors and Bank Management

**Requirements**

* Comprehensive health insurance
* Professional development and certification support

We are seeking an experienced **IT Delivery Leader** to oversee and ensure the successful execution of a portfolio of technology projects, with a preference for candidates who have supported or operated within the pharmaceutical or life sciences sector. This role requires a strategic, delivery-driven leader with exceptional client-facing skills, a deep understanding of enterprise IT delivery models, and the ability to manage and grow relationships with senior stakeholders.

The ideal candidate brings a blend of delivery excellence, portfolio leadership, and domain knowledge in pharma environments.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of IT projects, ensuring on-time, on-budget, and high-quality outcomes
* Establish and manage delivery roadmaps, resource plans, and performance metrics across multiple workstreams
* Coordinate cross-functional teams (client, vendor, onshore) to drive accountability and resolve delivery issues proactively
* Ensure adherence to project governance frameworks, SDLC/Agile methodologies, and compliance requirements (including GxP, where preferrable)
* Leverage and promote adoption of AI in project SDLC
* Identify delivery risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure project continuity and success
* Serve as the primary point of contact for senior client stakeholders, fostering trust and credibility
* Understand client business needs, industry challenges, and strategic objectives to propose value-aligned solutions
* Manage expectations, provide transparent communication, and ensure stakeholder alignment throughout the project lifecycle
* Facilitate executive-level presentations and status reporting, translating complex technical concepts into business-relevant insights
* Provide strong leadership to project managers, business analysts, architects, developers, and QA teams
* Mentor team members, promote continuous improvement, and instill a high-performance delivery culture
* Support talent planning, capability development, and team motivation across distributed teams
* Manage portfolio budgets, forecasts, and financial controls
* Oversee vendor and partner performance, including contract adherence, quality, and service levels
* Drive cost optimization while maintaining high delivery standards

**Requirements**

* 15 to 18 years of experience in IT project or program delivery, including leadership of complex multi-project portfolios
* Extensive experience in Life Sciences/Pharmaceuticals
* Proven experience managing enterprise technology initiatives (e.g., digital transformation, cloud migration, data platforms, application development)
* Strong, demonstrable client stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile/Hybrid methodologies, and IT governance frameworks
* Experience working with cross-functional, global delivery teams
* English language proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

jobs.title: Delivery Lead/ Delivery Manager- Loan Deal Closing
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate, energetic individual to join our Lending Services division. You will be part of team working for prestigious Loan Operations clients based on global geography.

  

Shift Tiimings - (Work from Office) US Shift (6:30 pm 3:30 am)

  

**Role & responsibilities**

  

* Review loan request packages for completeness and accuracy using established underwriting and closing checklists.
* Validate supporting documentation and coordinate return of incomplete packages for correction.
* Submit complete loan packages to Underwriting and maintain workflow status through internal tracking tools.
* Log transactions, update pipeline reports and ensure accurate milestone tracking throughout the loan lifecycle.
* Initiate and track due diligence activities including entity documentation, ownership verification, KYC/CIP requirements, signer validation and collateral documentation.
* Prepare approval condition checklists and coordinate resolution of post-approval requirements.
* Monitor and track outstanding underwriting conditions, documentation exceptions and due diligence items through closing.
* Coordinate with Relationship Managers, Credit, Legal, Operations and clients to confirm closing dates, final loan terms, pricing structures and funding requirements.
* Prepare, review and organize loan documentation packages using LaserPro and related documentation systems.
* Conduct quality control reviews to ensure completeness, accuracy and compliance of all loan documentation prior to closing.
* Track executed documents, monitor outstanding signatures and facilitate timely completion of closing requirements.
* Prepare funding worksheets, payoff calculations, fee schedules and wire instruction packages.
* Initiate funding transactions and wire transfers through OnPoint or equivalent funding platforms while adhering to established controls and procedures.
* Prepare loan boarding packages and servicing documentation for post-closing handoff.
* Book and board loans in Signature or equivalent servicing systems and coordinate transition to servicing teams.
* Perform post-closing validation reviews to ensure critical system fields, financial terms and customer information are accurately captured.
* Track original executed documents, title policies, lien perfection requirements, UCC filings and other collateral-related documentation.
* Maintain ticklers, exception tracking logs, collateral monitoring records and follow-up workflows.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining complete documentation and evidentiary records.
* Prepare MIS, SLA, productivity, pipeline and exception management reports for management review.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and support operational excellence initiatives across loan closing and servicing functions.
* Ensure compliance with bank policies, regulatory requirements, credit approvals and operational risk standards

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

* 8 to 12 + years of experience in Commercial Loan Closing, Loan Documentation.
* Experience working with LaserPro, Abrigo / Sageworks, or comparable documentation and servicing systems.
* Knowledge of KYC/CIP, entity documentation, collateral perfection, UCC filings and loan documentation requirements.
* Ability to interpret credit approvals, loan agreements and legal documentation.
* Candidates should be open to work in night shifts.
* Strong verbal & written communication to effectively communicate with stakeholders.
* Commerce Graduate / MBA (Finance)

Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  
  
Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

The VP of HMD, Pune will lead and develop the local team, own delivery of data onboarding and quality commitments, and work closely with the Mizuho Americas HMD team as one integrated global function. * Escalate delivery risks, dependencies and control issues promptly.

* Ensure changes are tested, documented and implemented with appropriate controls.

* Minimum 15 years of experience in financial services, market data, risk data or data analysis.

jobs.title: Vice President, Technical Lead(FIX Order)- Equities
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate IT Equities Technology
  
  
Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting. Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores—often developing new platforms from the ground up with clear ownership and impact. Role Overview
  
  
The Connectivity team is seeking a Vice President to lead the regional FIX Order and Execution Systems team based in Pune. This is a hands-on team leadership role with responsibility for setting priorities, allocating work, developing engineers, and coordinating the team’s delivery and production support. The team lead must bring proven experience leading technical teams, deep equities trading and FIX connectivity expertise, and a collaborative, accountable working style. The team’s technical scope includes FIX configuration, sell-side broker connectivity, messaging and system-performance analytics, automated testing, and CI/CD implementation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the local Pune regional team day to day: set priorities, allocate work, balance delivery and production-support demands, and maintain clear ownership and escalation paths within the team.
* Develop team capability through coaching, regular feedback, knowledge sharing, and delegation; build a supportive environment where engineers raise risks early and take ownership of outcomes.
* Represent the Pune team in global planning and incident coordination, communicating the local team’s capacity, dependencies, risks, and commitments and coordinating handovers with peer teams in other regions.
* Lead the design, implementation, certification, and production support of FIX order and execution systems.
* Translate front-office trading requirements into FIX session configurations, message mappings, validation rules, and routing logic.
* Configure and support sell-side broker FIX connectivity, including new sessions, client migrations, and production changes.
* Analyze FIX messages and application behavior across the complete order lifecycle.
* Diagnose session management, sequence, validation, order-state, reject, routing, and downstream processing issues.
* Build or enhance tools for connectivity configuration, certification, monitoring, and operational support.
* Analyze message volumes, latency, throughput, burst patterns, queue behavior, and capacity.
* Develop AI-assisted models or tools for generating and prioritizing test scenarios for FIX order and execution systems.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for configuration, code, testing, and deployment.
* Develop applications and automation using Java or Python.
* Define production-readiness criteria, monitoring requirements, support procedures, and rollback plans.
* Lead incident investigation and root-cause analysis for significant connectivity issues.

Required Qualifications
  
  

* Generally, 10 years of FIX engineering experience, with a strong emphasis on hands-on engineering of FIX order and execution systems, together with demonstrated experience leading a technical team.
* Proven experience leading a local technical team, including work allocation, coaching, delivery oversight, and production-support coordination, while collaborating with peer teams in other locations.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve outcomes through others: delegate effectively, give constructive feedback, resolve competing priorities, and build team capability rather than rely on individual intervention.
* Extensive experience with electronic equities trading and front-office FIX order and execution systems.
* Strong knowledge of the FIX protocol, including session and application layers.
* Experience configuring and supporting sell-side broker FIX connectivity.
* Detailed understanding of equity order messages and order-state transitions.
* Experience diagnosing FIX rejects, session failures, sequence issues, mapping problems, and routing defects.
* Experience analyzing messaging performance, latency, throughput, and system behavior.
* Intermediate or stronger development skills in Java or Python.
* Experience with automated build, test, deployment, and CI/CD tooling.
* Strong production-support, incident-management, leadership, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Familiarity with FIX Orchestra, FIX dictionaries, custom tags, and venue-specific extensions.
* Experience with QuickFIX/J, proprietary FIX platforms, ULLINK product suite, or comparable FIX technology; experience with Verifix or other FIX simulation tools.
* Experience with Solace, Kafka, or equivalent messaging platforms.
* Experience applying AI or machine learning to test generation, failure analysis, or operational analytics.
* Experience with Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Elastic.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
  
  
At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
  
  
Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Applied AI
jobs.description:
**The role**
------------

You own a set of enterprise accounts once they go live, and your job is to grow them. That means making sure delivery lands, the client sees results in their own numbers, and each account has a clear plan for what we do next with them.

You work with the client's business leaders on one side and our forward deployed engineers (FDEs) on the other. You run discovery with the client, turn their business logic into a call flow, and hand the FDE a clear spec for the workflow. When the FDE is deep in a complex build, you write the agent prompt yourself.

This is not a sales role. You grow accounts by delivering value the client can measure, and by spotting where else in their business we can do the same.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run discovery. Understand the use case and the client's process, find the real pain point, and agree the north star metric with the client so everyone knows what outcome the agent has to deliver.
* Design the call flow. Translate business logic into a call flow and conversation design, then brief the FDE on the workflow to build.
* Build agents. Write and iterate production prompts, especially when the FDE is busy on a complex workflow.
* Do RCA. When results dip, listen to the conversations, work out why they failed (prompt, data, flow or telephony) and drive the fix.
* Own the client relationship. Be the person the client calls first. Run governance calls, reviews and escalations, and build trust with stakeholders from operations teams up to business heads.
* Make delivery happen. Plan and run the project with the FDEs: scope, timelines, dependencies on the client's tech and data teams, go-lives. Unblock things before they slip.
* Run on numbers. Own the account's metrics (connect rate, conversion, collections, cost per outcome). Build the analysis, explain what moved and why, and turn it into the next change to the agent.
* Build the account roadmap. For every account, write a strategic plan for expansion: new use cases, new teams, more volume. Size each one, build the business case and take it to the client.
* Sell through value. Pitch upsell and cross-sell with evidence from your own account's results, working with sales and leadership on commercials.
* Test and improve. Run A/B tests on agents, prompts and voices, and read them out.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

Two backgrounds have worked best for this role:

* A growth product manager, ideally with about 2 years of consulting before moving into product, or
* A consultant with 3 to 4 years at a top-tier consulting firm.

Either way, you have:

* Strong client handling. You're comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders and can manage difficult conversations.
* Sharp analytics. You can pull and work the data yourself (SQL, spreadsheets) and turn it into a recommendation.
* Project management discipline across several workstreams and people you don't manage.
* Commercial instinct: you can see where an account can grow and make the case for it.
* Clear, short writing.
* Prompt engineering experience. We don't mean using ChatGPT or Claude day to day; we mean you have built agents that carry out a specific task and have run at scale with real users.
* Conversation design sense. You can read a transcript, see where it went wrong, and fix the flow or the prompt.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a voice or conversational AI company, or deploying AI for enterprise clients.
* BFSI background: lending, collections or insurance operations.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or a South Indian language.

  
**Benefits**  

* You own real revenue accounts from day one and work directly with the partner who runs them.
* You'll learn what makes AI agents work in production at scale.
* There's a clear path to running a portfolio of accounts as the team grows.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This document covers two role profiles for Finacle Core Banking transformation programs: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager and Business Analyst – Senior.
  
  
**Role Profile 1: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a techno-functional leader with prior experience in Infosys Finacle Core Banking and strong expertise in banking business analysis, requirements management, solution mapping, process design, API and interface analysis, data mapping, integration coordination, and banking data models. The role supports Finacle implementation, transformation, migration, upgrade, and modernization programs.
  
  
**Role -**
Techno-Functional Consultant – Finacle Core Banking
  
  
**Level -**
Manager
  
  
**Experience -**
8+ years in banking; 5+ years in business analysis or techno-functional consulting
  
  
**Domain -**
Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work as a Lead or Senior Business Analyst and techno-functional consultant in banking transformation programs.
* Lead requirements workshops, process discovery sessions, and solution discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, solution requirements, and system design inputs.
* Drive requirements analysis, gap assessment, configuration advisory, and solution mapping across Finacle and surrounding banking applications.
* Prepare and review BRDs, FRDs, user stories, use cases, process flows, data mappings, and interface specifications.
* Coordinate across Business, Technology, Development, Testing, Infrastructure, Data Migration and Vendor teams.
* Provide functional and technical clarifications to integration, migration and testing teams.
* Maintain traceability across requirements, specifications, test scenarios and delivered solutions.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go-Live and Hypercare activities.
* Lead functional workstreams, support delivery governance, manage risks and engage senior stakeholders as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking architecture, ecosystem, system configuration and banking data models.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, integration patterns, service-oriented architecture, data mapping, migration, reconciliation, data quality and interface analysis.
* Understanding of Digital Banking, Mobile Banking, Open Banking, API-led architectures, microservices, cloud, DevOps and RPA concepts.
* Experience designing Java-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front-end interfaces, menus and client-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong banking knowledge across deposits, loans, cash management, collections, payments, forex, trade finance, liquidity, KYC, cards, treasury and wealth management.
* Knowledge of payment and settlement systems including SWIFT, TARGET2, EBA and ISO 20022.
* Strong client-facing communication, leadership, stakeholder management, analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

Senior Executive – Finance & Accounts (Client Servicing)

**Company:** Floraison India Strategic Consulting Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Jayanagar 3rd Block, Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Work Mode:** In-Office  
**Experience:** 3+ Years  
**Number of Openings:** 2

**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Salary:** As per company standards

About the Role

Floraison India Strategic Consulting Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a dynamic and experienced Senior Executive – Finance & Accounts to join its Client Servicing vertical.

This is not a typical back-end accounting role. The selected candidate will work as a financial consultant for a portfolio of small to medium-sized corporate clients, including domestic and global businesses.

The role involves managing end-to-end financial activities for assigned clients, covering daily bookkeeping, monthly statutory compliances, payroll, financial reporting, book closure and annual finalisation.

The ideal candidate should have strong accounting and taxation knowledge, excellent communication skills and the ability to independently manage multiple client engagements.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Accounting & Bookkeeping

* Handle daily bookkeeping and accounting of expenses on an accrual basis.
* Ensure all financial transactions are accurately recorded and categorised.
* Manage the complete accounts payable cycle, including vendor invoice verification and GST compliance on bills.
* Prepare and maintain weekly vendor registers and coordinate timely payments.
* Raise domestic and export invoices.
* Reconcile invoices and customer collections to ensure proper cash flow management.
* Maintain and reconcile General Ledger accounts, including intercompany accounts and other balance sheet accounts.

2. Banking, Reconciliations & Cash Management

* Manage client bank accounts and cash flows.
* Prepare monthly fund request statements.
* Execute bank transfers and monitor daily liquidity.
* Perform monthly Bank Reconciliations (BRS) and foreign exchange reconciliations.
* Update and maintain fixed asset registers.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies between bank statements and accounting records.
* Ensure all sub-ledgers are aligned with the General Ledger at weekly and monthly intervals.

3. Monthly Closing & Financial Reporting (MIS)

* Manage month-end closing activities.
* Record depreciation, prepayments and accrual provisions.
* Prepare and finalise monthly Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss Statements.
* Prepare detailed MIS reports for assigned clients.
* Participate in monthly client calls.
* Present financial reports, budget variances and operational insights to client SPOCs.

4. Statutory Compliance & Taxation

**GST and Indirect Taxation**

* Handle GST computations and remittances.
* Manage Input Tax Credit (ITC) adjustments.
* Apply for GST refunds and manage GST return filings.

**Direct Taxation**

* Prepare monthly TDS statements and manage timely remittances.
* Handle quarterly advance tax planning, computations and payments.
* File e-TDS returns.
* Provide proactive tax-related guidance and tax-saving strategies.

**Year-End Finalisation & Audit**

* Manage annual books of accounts closure.
* Prepare Schedule III financial statements, including notes and accounting policies.
* Coordinate statutory audits.
* Provide required explanations and documentation to auditors.
* Resolve audit queries and ensure smooth audit sign-off.

5. Comprehensive Payroll & Labour Law Management

* Manage end-to-end payroll processing for assigned clients.
* Calculate salaries, employee benefits and reimbursements accurately.
* Handle monthly statutory remittances and filings related to:
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Employee State Insurance (ESI)
* Shops & Establishments (S&E)
* Gratuity
* Professional Tax (PT)
* Ensure accurate salary TDS deductions and timely deposits.
* Manage Form 16 issuance and related payroll compliance.
* Provide guidance and support on applicable labour law requirements under central and state regulations.

6. Global Client Engagement & Strategic Communication

* Act as the primary point of contact (SPOC) for Indian entities of global subsidiaries.
* Interact confidently with Board Directors, senior leadership and global stakeholders.
* Explain Indian financial, taxation and regulatory frameworks in a clear and actionable manner.
* Respond proactively to parent-company queries relating to financial performance, risks and compliance.
* Maintain timely and accurate information flow between clients and internal teams.
* Build professional client relationships through clear communication and ownership of responsibilities.

Required Skills & QualificationsTechnical Expertise

* Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts.
* Experience in a professional services environment, preferably a CA firm or consulting firm.
* Strong understanding of Indian accounting practices and standards.
* Good knowledge of GST laws and Income Tax provisions.
* Hands-on experience with accounting software such as:
* Tally
* QuickBooks
* Zoho Books
* Experience with payroll software such as:
* GreytHR
* KEKA
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel is mandatory.
* Practical experience in accounting, taxation, payroll and statutory compliance.

Essential Skills

* Strong client-first mindset and ability to manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Confidence in interacting with global parent companies and local stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to assess tax implications of business decisions and provide sound professional opinions.
* Strong ownership, time management and organisational skills.
* Proactive approach towards client servicing and financial operations.

Why Join Floraison?

At Floraison, you will work in a high-growth business and strategic consulting environment where you are more than just an accountant—you are a strategic partner to clients.

The organisation values disciplined, self-motivated professionals who take proactive ownership of their work and contribute to delivering high-quality financial and consulting services.

Requirements
  
  

* 6-10+ years of relevant experience within an investment bank, restructuring advisory practice, financial advisory firm or leading professional services organisation.
* Strong transaction experience across restructuring advisory, special situations, leveraged finance, debt advisory or corporate finance.
* Excellent financial modelling, valuation and analytical skills.
* Strong understanding of debt products, capital structures, credit markets and restructuring solutions.
* Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams and execute transactions in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience interacting with senior management teams, boards, lenders and investors.
* Exceptional presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing and developing junior team members.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related discipline.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.

As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

* The Executive Director, Client Coverage, Public Sector is the strategic adviser and relationship lead for a portfolio of major public sector clients, primarily across the Middle East and Pakistan. The role is accountable for developing senior client relationships, originating and delivering relevant solutions across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking, and achieving sustainable revenues and returns while maintaining strong credit, financial crime, conduct and regulatory risk discipline. * Build senior relationships up to ministerial and C-suite level, anticipate client needs, originate new business and position the Bank as a consistent strategic partner rather than a transactional provider.

**Integrated Client Solutions**

* Mobilise Transaction Banking, Financial Markets, Global Banking, structuring, advisory and industry partners to deliver relevant solutions, deepen inbound flows and selectively deploy balance sheet where supported by appropriate ancillary returns and Group economics.

**Collaboration And Execution**

* Maintain effective relationships with Country and Cluster leadership, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Client Management and product teams; ensure timely meeting notes, coordinated execution and high-quality client outcomes across the Bank network.

**Role Scope**

* This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. The role holder is expected to contribute to team capability, knowledge sharing, diversity initiatives and the development of colleagues through informal coaching and collaboration.

**Individual Contribution and Team Leadership**

* Operate as a senior individual contributor, providing leadership through client judgement, execution discipline and collaboration across the regional Public Sector franchise.
* Invest in personal development, share knowledge and support the development of colleagues through coaching, inclusive teamwork and participation in learning and diversity initiatives.

* 10+ years of relevant banking experience, preferably in senior relationship management, origination or sales covering public sector, sovereign, financial institution or development-finance clients.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex client relationships, originating cross-product opportunities and coordinating execution across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking.

* Strong knowledge of credit, AML, CDD, conduct and regulatory requirements. Any market-specific licence required to undertake banking business must be maintained.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.

.
